zh_title: 台积电反弹，台湾股市小幅上涨 - 焦点台湾
summary: 中新社台北10月27日电 交易商称，台湾股市周二在拉锯交易时段后小幅收高，因合约芯片制造商台积电(TSMC)从早前的疲软中反弹，推动大盘进入积极区域。台湾证券交易所基准指数在 45,676.67 点至 46,585.45 点之间波动，最终上涨 54.80 点，至 46,096.23 点，涨幅为 0.12%。营业额总计 9,765.5 亿元新台币（299.6 亿美元）。美国科技股隔夜上涨后，市场开盘走高，但随后的抛售将台交所推低至前期水平。
content:
中新社台北10月27日电 交易商称，台湾股市周二在拉锯交易时段后小幅收高，因合约芯片制造商台积电(TSMC)从早前的疲软中反弹，推动大盘进入积极区域。

台湾证券交易所基准指数在 45,676.67 点至 46,585.45 点之间波动，最终上涨 54.80 点，至 46,096.23 点，涨幅为 0.12%。营业额总计 9,765.5 亿元新台币（299.6 亿美元）。

交易商称，美国科技股隔夜上涨后，市场开盘走高，但随后抛售将台交所推低前收盘价，随后逢低买入者开始买入台积电，特别是在交易时段尾盘。

国泰期货分析师蔡明汉表示，“从今天的走势来看，我认为大盘在经历了近期的波动之后，一直在盘整，因此当指数出现技术性反弹时，投资者倾向于锁定利润。”

蔡说：“幸运的是，对台积电基本面的信心没有改变，因为它保持了相对于同行的领先地位，促使投资者逢低买入该股。”

占当地市场总市值超过40%的台积电，在触及新台币2,380.00元低点后，上涨0.63%，收于新台币2,400.00元。其复苏帮助台交所将跌幅缩小了约 160 点，并推动半导体分类指数上涨 0.46%。
内存芯片供应商也吸引了逢低买盘，旺宏涨3.52%，收于新台币103.00元；南亚科技飙升6.52%，收于新台币441.00元。

智能手机芯片设计公司联发科技逆势下跌 1.25%，收于新台币 3,960.00 元。

其他科技板块中，iPhone组装商和人工智能(AI)服务器制造商鸿海精密工业股份有限公司(Hon Hai Precision Industry Co.)上涨1.02%，收于新台币247.50元；电源制造商台达电子(Delta Electronics Inc.)下跌3.21%，收于新台币1,510.00元。

交易商表示，旧经济股票在盘整中涨跌互现。

怡亨纺织跌 0.40%，收于新台币 323.00 元；马卡乐特工业公司跌 0.90%，收于新台币 207.00 元。

南亚塑胶股价下跌1.16%，收于新台币297.50元；台塑股价上涨0.81%，收于新台币74.40元。食品品牌统一企业收涨0.75%，至新台币80.20元；味全食品收涨0.87%，至新台币11.55元。

金融板块上涨0.74%，富邦金控收涨2.21%，收于新台币162.00元；国泰金控收涨0.44%，收于新台币114.00元；玉山金控收跌0.60%，收于新台币49.45元。
蔡说：“尽管出现反弹，但市场情绪仍保持谨慎，因为投资者等待微软、谷歌母公司 Alphabet 和亚马逊等美国主要云服务提供商的业绩，以获得更清晰的人工智能支出情况。”

据台湾证券交易所称，外国机构投资者周二在主板净售出价值新台币 81 亿美元的股票。

（弗兰西斯·黄）

Enditem/sfj

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 27 (CNA) Taiwan shares closed slightly higher Tuesday after a seesaw trading session, as contract chipmaker Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. (TSMC) rebounded from earlier weakness to lift the broader market into positive territory, dealers said.

The Taiex, the Taiwan Stock Exchange's benchmark index, ended up 54.80 points, or 0.12 percent, at 46,096.23 after moving between 45,676.67 and 46,585.45. Turnover totaled NT$976.55 billion (US$29.96 billion).

The market opened higher after an overnight rally in U.S. technology stocks, but selling later pushed the Taiex below the previous close before bargain hunters moved in to pick up TSMC, particularly late in the trading session, dealers said.

"Judging from today's movement, I think the broader market has been consolidating after recent volatility, so when the index staged a technical rebound, investors tended to lock in profits," Cathay Futures analyst Tsai Ming-han said.

"Fortunately, faith in TSMC's fundamentals remained unchanged because it has maintained its lead over its peers, prompting investors to buy the stock on the dip," Tsai said.

TSMC, which accounts for over 40 percent of the local market's total capitalization, rose 0.63 percent to close at NT$2,400.00, after hitting a low of NT$2,380.00. Its recovery helped the Taiex trim its losses by about 160 points and pushed the semiconductor subindex 0.46 percent higher.

Memory chip suppliers also attracted bargain hunting, with Macronix International Co. rising 3.52 percent to end at NT$103.00 and Nanya Technology Corp. soaring 6.52 percent to close at NT$441.00.

Bucking the upturn, smartphone chip designer MediaTek Inc. fell 1.25 percent to end at NT$3,960.00.

Elsewhere in the tech sector, iPhone assembler and artificial intelligence (AI) server maker Hon Hai Precision Industry Co. rose 1.02 percent to close at NT$247.50, while power supply maker Delta Electronics Inc. fell 3.21 percent to end at NT$1,510.00.

Old-economy stocks were mixed amid the consolidation, dealers said.

Eclat Textile Co. lost 0.40 percent to close at NT$323.00, while Makalot Industrial Co. ended down 0.90 percent at NT$207.00.

Nan Ya Plastics Corp. fell 1.16 percent to close at NT$297.50, while Formosa Plastics Corp. added 0.81 percent to end at NT$74.40. Food brand Uni-President Enterprises Corp. closed up 0.75 percent at NT$80.20, and Wei Chuan Foods Corp. ended up 0.87 percent at NT$11.55.

In the financial sector, which rose 0.74 percent, Fubon Financial Holding Co. closed up 2.21 percent at NT$162.00 and Cathay Financial Holding Co. ended up 0.44 percent at NT$114.00, while E. Sun Financial Holding Co. fell 0.60 percent to close at NT$49.45.

"Despite the rebound, market sentiment stayed cautious as investors waited for results from major U.S. cloud service providers including Microsoft, Google's parent Alphabet and Amazon for a clearer picture of AI spending," Tsai said.

Foreign institutional investors sold a net NT$8.10 billion worth of shares on the main board Tuesday, according to the Taiwan Stock Exchange.

(By Frances Huang)

Enditem/sfj

content:
中新社台北10月27日电 央行表示，境外机构投资者资金净流出是近几个月新台币兑美元大幅贬值的重要因素。

央行在定于周三举行的听证会之前向立法院提交的一份书面报告中表示，自7月初以来，外国机构投资者的资金净流出为543亿美元。

央行表示，同期，新台币兑美元贬值约2%。

央行表示，今年上半年，外国机构投资者资金净流出233亿美元，在中东军事紧张局势升级以及美联储鹰派担忧的背景下，台币面临更大的下行压力。

它补充说，为了缓解当地外汇市场的波动，央行在六个月期间卖出的资金比买入的资金多了170.4亿美元。

央行表示，从7月到10月21日，对美国和伊朗之间军事冲突的担忧再度升温，加上人工智能支出担忧导致全球科技股遭到抛售，对台湾证券交易所的基准指数Taiex造成压力，促使外国机构投资者从台湾金融市场撤出更多资金。
这四个月期间，外国机构投资者的股票净卖出额为新台币 1.25 万亿元，相当于约 387 亿美元。央行表示，包括资本利得和现金股息在内的资金净流出总额达到约543亿美元。

央行表示，尽管出现资金外流，但与其他几种非美元货币相比，新台币仍保持相对稳定。

据央行数据，从1月1日到10月21日，新台币兑美元贬值3.23%，而衡量美元兑一揽子主要贸易伙伴货币的美元指数则上涨3.49%。

央行表示，同期，新台币的跌幅不如瑞士法郎（下跌3.89%）、欧元（下跌4.35%）和泰铢（下跌6.29%）明显。

报告称，台湾是一个小型开放经济体，外汇市场相对薄弱，严重依赖贸易，因此央行有必要进行干预以稳定汇率。

央行补充称，其目标是使新台币相对于欧元、韩元和日元的波动保持在相对狭窄的范围内，帮助台湾出口商稳定价格和获得订单，同时支持更广泛的经济。

（潘子瑜、黄芳芳摄）

结局/AW

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 27 (CNA) Net fund outflows by foreign institutional investors have been a major factor behind the Taiwan dollar's sharp depreciation against the U.S. dollar in recent months, the central bank said.

In a written report submitted to the Legislative Yuan ahead of a hearing scheduled for Wednesday, the central bank said foreign institutional investors recorded net fund outflows of US$54.3 billion since the beginning of July.

During the same period, the Taiwan dollar depreciated about 2 percent against the U.S. dollar, the central bank said.

In the first half of this year, foreign institutional investors recorded net fund outflows of US$23.3 billion, adding downward pressure on the Taiwan dollar amid escalating military tensions in the Middle East and concerns about a hawkish U.S. Federal Reserve, the central bank said.

To ease volatility in the local foreign exchange market, the central bank sold US$17.04 billion more than it bought during the six-month period, it added.

From July through Oct. 21, renewed concerns about military conflict between the United States and Iran, along with a global sell-off in technology stocks amid AI spending concerns, weighed on the Taiex, the Taiwan Stock Exchange's benchmark index, prompting foreign institutional investors to withdraw more funds from Taiwan's financial markets, the central bank said.

During the four-month period, foreign institutional investors recorded net stock sales of NT$1.25 trillion, equivalent to about US$38.7 billion. Their total net fund outflows, including capital gains and cash dividends, reached about US$54.3 billion, the central bank said.

Despite the outflows, the Taiwan dollar remained relatively stable compared with several other non-U.S. dollar currencies, the central bank said.

From Jan. 1 through Oct. 21, the Taiwan dollar depreciated 3.23 percent against the U.S. dollar, while the U.S. dollar index, which measures the greenback against a basket of major trading partners' currencies, rose 3.49 percent, according to the central bank.

During the same period, the Taiwan dollar's decline was less pronounced than those of the Swiss franc, which fell 3.89 percent, the euro, which dropped 4.35 percent, and the Thai baht, which tumbled 6.29 percent, the central bank said.

Taiwan is a small, open economy with a relatively shallow foreign exchange market and a heavy reliance on trade, making central bank intervention necessary to stabilize the currency, the report said.

The central bank added that it aims to keep fluctuations of the Taiwan dollar within a relatively narrow range compared with those of the euro, South Korean won and Japanese yen, helping Taiwanese exporters stabilize prices and secure orders, while supporting the broader economy.

(By Pan Tzu-yu and Frances Huang)

Enditem/AW

# Taiwan CDC cites health token initiative for vaccination uptick

10/27/2026 06:00 PM

[](jsvscript:)[](jsvscript:)[](javascript:void(0))[Listen](javascript:)

CDC Director-General Lo Yi-chun. CNA photo Oct. 27, 2026

Taipei, Oct. 27 (CNA) The Centers for Disease Control (CDC) said Tuesday that vaccination rates for influenza, COVID-19 and pneumococcal disease have risen in Taiwan this year for both publicly funded and self-paid vaccines, partly due to a health token initiative launched Oct. 1.

Between Oct. 1 and Oct. 26, about 2.725 million adults aged 18 and older had received publicly funded flu vaccinations, while 288,000 had paid out of pocket for the shots, the CDC said in a news release.

The figures represented increases of about 7 percent and 70 percent, respectively, from the same period last year, the agency said.

For COVID-19, about 1.176 million people had received publicly funded vaccinations and 188 had paid out of pocket, up 35 percent and 58 percent, respectively, from the same period in 2025.

For pneumococcal disease, 104,000 people had received publicly funded vaccinations and 3,000 had paid out of pocket between Oct. 1 and 26. The figures were 3.5 times and 2.4 times those recorded during the same period last year, respectively, the CDC said.

Under the health token initiative, people receive 450 tokens for getting a flu shot, 900 for a COVID-19 vaccination and 600 for a pneumococcal vaccination.

Between Oct. 18 and 24, Taiwan recorded 101,746 outpatient and emergency department visits for influenza-like illness, down 18 percent from the previous week, mainly because clinics were closed due to Typhoon Champi, the CDC said.

From Oct. 20-26, 85 new severe flu cases and 28 flu-related deaths were reported, it added.

CDC Director-General Lo Yi-chun (羅一鈞) said at a regular news conference that vaccination is the best way to reduce the risks of transmission, severe illness and death from both influenza and COVID-19.

The second phase of the publicly funded flu and COVID-19 vaccination programs, expanding eligibility to people aged 50 to 64 without chronic illnesses, is scheduled to begin Nov. 2, Lo said.

In addition to getting vaccinated, Lo urged the public to maintain good personal hygiene, including washing their hands, wearing masks when experiencing respiratory symptoms and staying home when ill.

People experiencing warning signs such as shortness of breath, labored breathing, altered consciousness or low blood pressure should seek immediate medical attention, he added.

(By Chen Chieh-ling and Wu Kuan-hsien)

## 女性影展台灣競賽揭曉！短片《防颱準備》奪金獎 風雨中展現女性韌性

2026-10-27 18:41 經濟日報／ 記者[侯思蘋](https://udn.com/news/reporter/NDExODc=)／台北即時報導  電影 ![Image 1: 2026台灣國際女性影展閉幕大合影。圖／台灣國際女性影展提供](https://pgw.udn.com.tw/gw/photo.php?u=https://uc.udn.com.tw/photo/t3/2026/10/27/35459554.jpg&M=1&s=Y&x=0&y=0&sw=1280&sh=853&sl=W&fw=930&exp=3600&w=930)

2026台灣國際女性影展閉幕大合影。圖／台灣國際女性影展提供

2026台灣國際[**女性**](https://udn.com/search/tagging/2/%E5%A5%B3%E6%80%A7)[**影展**](https://udn.com/search/tagging/2/%E5%BD%B1%E5%B1%95)閉幕暨台灣競賽頒獎典禮25日晚間於光點華山[**電影**](https://udn.com/search/tagging/2/%E9%9B%BB%E5%BD%B1)館登場，即便風雨來臨，仍不減影展的熱度與影迷的支持。巧合的是，台灣競賽「金獎：佑爾康品味講究獎」由香港導演陳穎文短片《防颱準備》摘下，片名與當前天候相互呼應，也讓這份得獎喜訊更添時事趣味。

今年女性影展台灣競賽共有19部影片入圍角逐大獎，直面移工、戰爭、跨性別等複雜議題，展現豐沛的創作能量。決審陣容囊括國內外資深學者、電影工作者，得獎名單於閉幕典禮盛大揭曉。主持人開場時提及，女性影展走過33年並不容易，而今年在颱風過後迎來閉幕，更讓人感受到影展一路走來「堅定而有韌性」的精神。

眾所矚目的台灣競賽頒獎名單，由香港導演陳穎文的《防颱準備》奪得「金獎：佑爾康品味講究獎」，評審陳明秀（Mia Chen Ming-Hsiu）、安努奇卡・德安德拉德（Annouchka de Andrade）、洪卲寅（Hong So-in）一致給予高度肯定。決選評審代表陳明秀在共同致詞中提到「評審團在這次的觀影過程中被深深感動，從參賽作品中看到了對於社會多元的包容，也感受到年輕創作者的活力。」也讚賞金獎《防颱準備》的情感力道，細膩勾勒了兩個世代的台港女性情誼，當風暴來襲時，深刻映照出女性的韌性與抵抗。

在接下金獎獎盃時，陳穎文驚訝表示自己並未預料到能夠奪得如此大獎，感性提到女性影展是此作品第一個入圍的影展，意義重大。也特別感謝台灣以及故鄉香港，表示兩地帶給她的養分成就了她。

銀獎頒予許慧如導演的《她的碎片》與施方婷、温晉豪導演的《餘波》。《她的碎片》揉合多元素材與檔案影像，在時間的跨度中為導演、母親與外婆的情感留下動人紀錄。雖然《她的碎片》導演許慧如不克參加這次的頒獎典禮，仍然為現場帶來致詞，表示女性的聲音在歷史中常常被遺忘，這次能夠拍攝這樣記錄「失去」的電影是一大幸事，也感謝所有願意在電影中出鏡的女性。

評審亦盛讚《餘波》，以緬甸戰火下的日常故事邀請觀眾在艱困時刻仍然跨越國界，想像更包容的未來。導演施方婷在得獎感言感性表示：「希望可以繼續拍下去，在世界各地繼續拍。」

評審團特別提及獎則由《恨女的逆襲》、《你不在這個蛋糕裡》拿下。《恨女的逆襲》主角林怡婷去年（2025）入圍金馬獎最佳新演員，今年女性影展評審亦熱烈肯定，直呼「注意！年輕一代登場了！」。導演李宜珊上台領獎時，表示這是《恨女的逆襲》的第一個影片獎。她感性表示，之前的短片作品都有投件，未來也會持續投件！

陳亭叡導演甫入圍2026金馬影展最佳動畫短片的《你不在這個蛋糕裡》大玩黑色幽默，成功擄獲評審的心。本片在後同婚年代持續關注女同志反抗歧視的力量，把歡笑與解放一同帶進戲院。發表感言時，導演陳亭叡開心分享女性影展對她有深刻影響，從女影實習生的身分，到今年的女影主視覺設計主視覺，女影是教會她許多事情的地方。

會外賽推出兩大獎項，其中台灣影評人協會推薦獎再度由《餘波》拿下，導演一晚驚喜抱回兩座獎項。評審讚許片中精準的調度，在有限的環境中拍出動人生命力。

而代表觀眾票選獎的王道女子力獎則獻給陳冠君導演執導的《一生二命》。影片中對跨性別生命之路的溫柔刻畫，將掙扎與困境化作感人影像，悉數傳遞給觀眾。頒獎現場，導演陳冠君攜手主角Birdy一同上台領獎，導演提及如果沒有Birdy，這部片就無法存在。

即使展期迎來颱風，仍不減觀眾對女性影展的支持與熱情。第33屆女性影展在志工、贊助夥伴及各界影迷的支持下，持續透過電影匯聚多元觀點，讓不同女性的生命經驗與創作得以被看見，順利落幕。策展人陳慧穎也感謝每一位在風雨中同行的工作夥伴，表示儘管放映艱辛，但電影價值就在於不斷的被播放、觀看。這樣的信念讓影展得以順利舉行，這場關於性別與影像的相遇將持續非分擾動。

title: Shenandoah Hiking, Winery, And Sunsets Weekend, Fri, Oct 30, 2026, 7:00 AM   | Meetup
summary: **Summits And Sips** Imagine finally treating yourself to a girls’ weekend. Only instead of sitting on someone’s living room floor fielding texts from your partner (“WHERE IS MY PRESCRIPTION NASAL SPRAY”) you’re hiking the Appalachian Trail
content:
**Summits And Sips**

Imagine finally treating yourself to a girls’ weekend. Only instead of sitting on someone’s living room floor fielding texts from your partner (“WHERE IS MY PRESCRIPTION NASAL SPRAY”) you’re hiking the Appalachian Trail. Eating picnics you didn’t have to pack. And tossing back Virginia wine with women who make you laugh until a you pee a little. Trade the daily hustle for mountain magic with the ultimate long weekend hiking in Shenandoah National Park.

This is a more laid-back hiking adventure––active without being hardcore. We’ll explore sections of the Appalachian Trail by day, including Mary’s Rock, Whiteoak Canyon, and Hawksbill Mountain. And we’ll savor golden sunset hikes to Bearfence and Stony Man before our evening PJ parties.

Our SHE-nanigan Shuttle will be conveniently parked to save us from sweary uphill climbs, whisking us away to our trailheads, an afternoon wine tasting, and our picturesque lodges with local, chef-made meals. This much beauty and sisterhood in one long weekend will feel illegal. But we promise the park rangers won’t kick us out.

title: How Saudi Arabia’s mBridge Exit Exposes the Limits of China’s Financial Warfare Strategy
zh_title: 沙特阿拉伯退出 mBridge 如何暴露中国金融战战略的局限性
source: 亚利桑那州立大学的《小战争杂志》
summary: 2026年9月19日，沙特阿拉伯公开宣布已提前一年多完成参与中国主导的mBridge央行数字货币（CBDC）计划。沙特中央银行 (SAMA) 表示，其参与主要限于 mBridge 的概念验证阶段，该阶段于 2025 年 5 月 13 日完成。这一声明的延迟至关重要，因为它表明参与新兴支付基础设施并不一定会转化为长期的制度和/或地缘政治联盟。 mBridge 是一项由中国人民银行发起的举措
content:
2026年9月19日，沙特阿拉伯公开宣布已提前一年多完成参与中国主导的mBridge央行数字货币（CBDC）计划。沙特中央银行 (SAMA) 表示，其参与主要限于 mBridge 的概念验证阶段，该阶段于 2025 年 5 月 13 日完成。这一声明的延迟至关重要，因为它表明参与新兴支付基础设施并不一定会转化为长期的制度和/或地缘政治联盟。 mBridge 是一项由中国人民银行、香港金融管理局、泰国银行、阿拉伯联合酋长国中央银行以及之前的 SAMA 参与的倡议。 mBridge 最初由国际清算银行创新中心领导，利用批发 CBDC 取消中间代理银行，目标是在独立于美元金融生态系统运营的同时降低运营成本和交易费用。 SAMA 退出 mBridge 引发了人们对全球经济体应对跨境支付未来的不同方式的质疑。中国拥有自己的替代支付基础设施，并且该基础设施的采用率正在上升。对于东亚两个最大经济体中国和日本来说，这提出了一个有趣的问题，特别是因为日本在经济上与中国紧密相连，但在战略上与美国保持一致。
考虑到这一点，日本不愿接受中国和其他形式的跨境支付网络，这说明了在技术上提供替代金融体系与使其具有吸引力以与现有金融关系并行使用之间的鸿沟。 中国的 mBridge 推动 中国的 mBridge 推动是其在国际层面扩大跨境支付以追求去美元化的更广泛努力的关键支柱。 mBridge 之前在整个亚洲（包括香港、泰国和澳门）的联系，再加上阿联酋和沙特阿拉伯等国家的国际支付，证明了 mBridge 的国际影响力。沙特阿拉伯退出该项目凸显出，虽然该项目在技术上可能可行，但参与 mBridge 并不一定会转化为长期的政治承诺，这一退出表明了围绕旨在减少对美元基础设施依赖的支付基础设施的地缘政治敏感性。中国的数字人民币和更广泛的人民币支付基础设施的国际影响力正在扩大，特别是在“一带一路”倡议参与者中。最近一次人民币计价交易的增加是在2026年9月24日，当时基加利银行连接到中国的CIPS跨境支付网络。
此举使基加利银行成为卢旺达和东非/中非第一家这样做的金融机构，突显了与中国人民币支付基础设施的联系不断增强。虽然CIPS和环球银行金融电信协会(SWIFT)履行不同的职能，但它们确实并行运作，CIPS提供跨境人民币交易清算和结算的基础设施，SWIFT提供金融信息传递。这种区别很重要，因为由于 c 等因素，它可能会导致机构将中国支付功能添加到其现有基础设施中。

【原文 English Original】
On September 19, 2026, Saudi Arabia publicly announced that it had completed its participation in the China-led mBridge central bank digital currency (CBDC) program over a year earlier. The Saudi Central Bank (SAMA) said its participation was primarily limited to mBridge’s proof-of-concept phase, which was completed on May 13, 2025. The delay in this announcement is critical as it demonstrates that participation in emerging payment infrastructure does not necessarily translate into long-term institutional and/or geopolitical alignment. mBridge is an initiative that counted the People’s Bank of China, Hong Kong Monetary Authority, Bank of Thailand, Central Bank of the United Arab Emirates, and previously, SAMA. Originally led by the Bank for International Settlements Innovation Hub, mBridge leveraged wholesale CBDCs to remove intermediate correspondent banks, with the goal of lowering operational costs and transaction fees while operating independently of the U.S. dollar financial ecosystem. SAMA’s departure from mBridge raises questions about the different ways global economies are approaching the future of cross-border payments. China is its own alternative payment infrastructure, with adoption of that same infrastructure on the rise. For China and Japan, which are East Asia’s two largest economies , this presents an interesting problem, especially because Japan is economically intertwined with China but strategically aligned with the U.S. With this in mind, Japan’s reluctance to embrace China’s and other forms of cross-border payment networks illustrates the divide between making an alternative financial system technically available versus making it attractive for adoption for parallel usage with existing financial relationships. China’s mBridge Push China’s mBridge push is a key pillar in its broader efforts to expand cross-border payments on an international level in pursuit of de-dollarization. mBridge’s previous connections throughout Asia – including Hong Kong, Thailand, and Macau – when combined with international payments in countries like the UAE and Saudi Arabia, demonstrate the international reach of mBridge. The departure of Saudi Arabia from the project highlights that while the project may be technically feasible, participation in mBridge does not necessarily translate into long-term political commitment, with this withdrawal demonstrating the geopolitical sensitivity surrounding payment infrastructure designed to reduce reliance on dollar-based infrastructure. China’s digital yuan and broader renminbi (RMB) payment infrastructure are increasing in their international reach , particularly among Belt and Road Initiative participants. This increase in RMB-denominated transactions was most recently seen on September 24, 2026 , when the Bank of Kigali connected to China’s CIPS cross-border payment network. This move made the Bank of Kigali the first financial institution in Rwanda and east/central Africa to do so, highlighting the increased connection to China’s RMB payment infrastructure. While CIPS and Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication (SWIFT) perform different functions, they do operate alongside one another, with CIPS providing infrastructure for clearing and settling cross-border RMB transactions, and SWIFT providing financial messaging. This distinction is important because it could result in institutions adding Chinese payment capabilities to their existing infrastructure due to factors like customer demand or political pressure. Therefore, rather than replacing one global system with another, the more plausible development is the gradual accumulation of overlapping payment systems. Japan’s Alternative Path Japan is pursuing cross-border payments innovation through different institutional architecture, leveraging its existing relationships and domestic innovation to do so. This stands in contrast to China’s development of an alternative payments network centered around Beijing. Japan’s participation as a leader in Project Agora , which counts over eight central banks, including the Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Bank of England, and Bank of Korea, and over 40 leading financial institutions, demonstrates this approach. In this light, Japan’s participation in Project Agora shows how it views cross-border payments as a problem connecting cross-jurisdictional financial infrastructure, with interoperability a prime concern for Japan. Japan’s growing stablecoin ecosystem adds another layer to this model, with its regulatory clarity enabling private-sector payment instruments to work alongside conventional banking infrastructure. PM Takaichi’s ascension to office in late 2025 coincided with the establishment of the Japanese Yen Coin (JPYC) stablecoin, which made history as the first regulated yen-pegged stablecoin, with Ripple receiving approval to launch its Ripple USD (RLUSD) stablecoin less than a year later in mid-2026. Furthermore, Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi has been supportive of Web3 initiatives, pledging increased government funding and regulatory clarity to Web3 startups. Most recently, Japan’s SBI Group and South Korea’s Kyobo Life Insurance completed a direct yen-to-won stablecoin cross-border pilot, enabling a direct fund transfer without using the dollar as an intermediate currency. While Japan is not necessarily practicing active de-dollarization, it is developing additional settlement options that can reduce its dependency on the dollar for particular transactions. At the same time, these moves highlight Japan’s desire to preserve access to dollar-centered markets when that access remains economically or strategically valuable. Ensuring Financial Interoperability China and Japan’s bilateral trade volume totaled $310 billion in 2025, with Japan ranking as one of China’s top four trade partners. With such a large trade volume, Chinese and Japanese institutions require payment systems that are interoperable. As a result, the growth of CIPS, Japan’s participation in international payment initiatives, and the expansion of regional payment networks could result in a more interconnected Asian financial system rather than a single replacement for the dollar. This level of interoperability raises the question of sanctions effectiveness, particularly in today’s dynamic political environment. Some Chinese banks are currently facing U.S. sanctions over ties to Iran, with this being a hot-button issue due to CIPS’s existence outside of Western sanctions regimes. This creates a regulatory problem for banks, which must integrate with different payment rails while still navigating different regulatory regimes and ensuring financial resiliency. Despite China being incentivized to build CIPS to internationalize RMB payment infrastructure while simultaneously promoting de-dollarization, and Japan needing to preserve access to U.S.-led financial systems while it also develops payment systems of its own, the growing multitude of overlapping systems will require much more interoperability to ensure that cross-border payments remain functional. As a result, payment system diversification can provide states and institutions with increased resiliency but can also increase the complexity of managing financial risk. Conclusion Saudi Arabia’s departure from mBridge highlights the choices facing Asian economies, particularly as China continues to expand its own payment initiatives in the spirit of de-dollarization, while also needing to ensure that this same network can connect to the broader financial system. In contrast, Japan has clear financial resilience as one of China’s major trading partners, but as one of America’s major political partners. As a result, the emerging Asian payments landscape may become a network of overlapping payment rails, particularly as banks and businesses select infrastructure based on factors like transaction costs, geopolitical considerations, and interoperability. As payment infrastructure becomes increasingly intertwined with economic security, resilience, and strategic competition, interoperability itself may become a form of strategic capacity. Countries that can connect multiple financial systems while preserving regulatory control and operational resilience may possess greater freedom of action than those dependent on a single payment architecture. The post How Saudi Arabia’s mBridge Exit Exposes the Limits of China’s Financial Warfare Strategy appeared first on Small Wars Journal by Arizona State University .

title: Civil servants file lawsuit against colleague accused of pocketing HK$33m Mark Six group jackpot
zh_title: 公务员对同事提起诉讼，被控侵吞马克六号集团3,300万港元奖金
summary: 包括12名现任食物环境卫生署（食环署）公务员在内的14人就办公室彩票纠纷向一名同事提起诉讼，涉及3,300万港元的六号大奖。 2023 年，香港赛马会的博彩分部。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。据当地媒体报道，食环署卫生督察凌俊廷被指控将“马克六”的全部奖金收入囊中，他和 14 名同事共同购买了 9 月 5 日抽奖的彩票，赢得了 3,300 万港元。 14名原告上周提起诉讼，称李
content:
包括12名现任食物环境卫生署（食环署）公务员在内的14人就办公室彩票纠纷向一名同事提起诉讼，涉及3,300万港元的六号大奖。 2023 年，香港赛马会的博彩分部。资料照片：Kyle Lam/HKFP。据当地媒体报道，食环署卫生督察凌俊廷被指控将“马克六”的全部奖金收入囊中，他和 14 名同事共同购买了 9 月 5 日抽奖的彩票，赢得了 3,300 万港元。据 The Collective 周一援引传票令状报道，14 名原告上周提起诉讼，称根据 Ling 的贡献，他只应获得约 421 万港元的分配。他们请求法院颁布禁制令，禁止令某处理彩票奖金，宣布被告账户内约2891万港元属于原告，并判令被告退还资金。根据传讯令状，原告人包括食环署市场拓展科的12名公务员。其中包括高级警司鲍仲安、副协调员陈家俊和区慧霞。 4月至5月期间，资历最高的原告Pau开始在同事中团购马克六号彩票，以鼓舞团队士气。
他们的约定是，每个人都会选择彩票号码并出资购买彩票，如果中奖了，奖金将按照每个人的贡献比例分配。凌从一开始就自愿代表团队购买彩票，同事们也会回报他的捐款。该团体在第一笔投注中赢得了 1,760 港元，团队同意保留奖金以资助未来的门票购买。高等法院。资料照片：Tom Grundy/HKFP。 9月初，波城发起了第五次马克六号门票团购。原告出资额介乎20至300港元，被告声称出资210港元，总金额达1,650港元。被告筹集资金后购买了两张门票。 9月5日晚，抽奖前，Ling通过WhatsApp向部分原告发送了购买彩票的截图。然而，当抽奖结果显示彩票中奖约3300万港元后，凌在工作场所表示不会与同事分享奖金。随后他请了假，也没有回复同事的消息。逮捕及警方调查 9月9日，一名参与纠纷的同事向警方报案。据当地媒体报道，两天后，警方以涉嫌盗窃罪逮捕了一名 36 岁男子。
警务处处长周一祖告诉媒体，警方已冻结嫌疑人的银行账户，并正在调查案件。嫌疑人已获保释。 HKFP已联系警方询问调查进展。

【原文 English Original】
Fourteen people, including 12 civil servants currently working at the Food and Environmental Hygiene Department (FEHD), have filed a lawsuit against a colleague over an office lottery dispute involving a HK$33 million Mark Six jackpot. A betting branch of Hong Kong Jockey Club in 2023. File photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP. Ling Chun-ting, an FEHD health inspector, is accused of pocketing all the Mark Six winnings after he and 14 coworkers jointly purchased lottery tickets for the September 5 draw which won HK$33 million, local media reported. The 14 plaintiffs filed the lawsuit last week, arguing that Ling should only have been allocated around HK$4.21 million based on his contribution, The Collective reported on Monday, citing the writ of summons. They have requested that the court grant an injunction restraining Ling from handling the lottery winnings, declare that around HK$28.91 million in the defendant’s account belongs to the plaintiffs, and order the defendant to return the funds. According to the writ of summons, the plaintiffs include 12 civil servants in the Market Development Division at the FEHD. Among them are Senior Superintendent Pau Chung-on and deputy coordinators Andrew Chan and Au Wai-ha. Between April and May, Pau, the most senior plaintiff, started a group purchase of Mark Six lottery tickets among colleagues to boost team morale. It was their mutual understanding that each person would select lottery numbers and contribute to purchase lottery tickets, and if they won, any winnings would be distributed in proportion to each person’s contribution. Ling volunteered to purchase the tickets on behalf of the team from the beginning, and colleagues would pay him back for their contributions. The group won HK$1,760 on their first bet, and the team agreed to keep the prize money to fund future ticket purchases. The High Court. File photo: Tom Grundy/HKFP. In early September, Pau initiated the fifth group purchase of Mark Six tickets. The plaintiffs contributed amounts ranging from HK$20 to HK$300 and the defendant claimed to have contributed HK$210, bringing the total sum to HK$1,650. After collecting the funds, the defendant purchased two tickets. On the evening of September 5, prior to the draw, Ling sent screenshots of the purchased tickets to some of the plaintiffs via WhatsApp. However, after results of the draw showed the tickets had won around HK$33 million, Ling indicated in the workplace that he would not share the winnings with his colleagues. He later took leave and did not respond to messages from colleagues. Arrest and police investigation On September 9, one of the colleagues involved in the dispute reported the case to the police. Two days later, police arrested a 36-year-old man on suspicion of theft, local media reported. Commissioner of Police Joe Chow told the press that police had frozen the suspect’s bank accounts and were investigating the case. The suspect was released on bail. HKFP has reached out to the police to enquire about the progress of the investigation.

title: The AI “enthusiasm” gap is a dangerous misnomer

summary: > 如果留给特朗普政府特权，人工智能可能会侵蚀美国的言论自由。中国还提供了人工智能如何进一步限制和先发制人的反乌托邦预览。政府目前[使用（在新窗口中打开）](https://www.aspi.org.au/report/the-partys-ai-how-chinas-new-ai-systems-are-reshaping- human-rights/)人工智能来扫描和审查大量文本和视觉数据，而中国公司正在开发技术，使国家能够[重塑（在新窗口中打开）窗口）]（https://www.nytimes.com/2025/08/06/us/politics/china-artificial-i
content:
> 如果留给特朗普政府特权，人工智能可能会侵蚀美国的言论自由。

中国还提供了人工智能如何进一步限制和先发制人的反乌托邦预览。政府目前[使用（在新窗口中打开）](https://www.aspi.org.au/report/the-partys-ai-how-chinas-new-ai-systems-are-reshaping- human-rights/)人工智能来扫描和审查大量文本和视觉数据，而中国公司正在开发技术，使国家能够[重塑（在新窗口中打开） window)](https://www.nytimes.com/2025/08/06/us/politics/china-artificial-intelligence-information-warfare.html)通过个性化宣传舆论和[预测（在新窗口中打开）](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/06/01/us/politics/china-ai-predicting-dissent.html)哪些人将成为未来的持不同政见者。
“差距”一词意味着有一些东西需要填补，美国落后了，美国人应该尽快给予坚定的支持。这假设中国超过美国的威胁所造成的后果将远远大于缺乏公开辩论所造成的后果。这种成本效益分析是值得怀疑的。低成本中国模型的激增，包括[DeepSeek和Z.ai（在新窗口中打开）](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/07/chinese-ai-models-costs-us-openai-anthropic.html)发布的模型，正在[成本计算（在新窗口中打开）窗口）]（https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/26/china-ai-global-adoption.html）美国公司的市场份额以及[出口（在新窗口中打开）]（https://sccei.fsi.stanford.edu/publication/political-censorship-large-language-models-originating-china）[政治偏见（在新窗口中打开） window)](https://www.reuters.com/world/china/us-scrutinizes-chinese-ai-ideological-bias-memo-shows-2025-07-09/)和[提供（在新窗口中打开）](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/05/31/world/china-surveillance-solomon-islands-trump-nepal.html)监视工具专制国家。
然而，虽然中国对公共数据的获取具有扩展优势，但正是开放权重设计使其模型免费可用，从而支持了其扩散。有几种方法可以让美国公司获得更多的数据访问权，同时保护民主和隐私。其中包括[合成数据生成（在新窗口中打开）](https://hai.stanford.edu/ai-definitions/what-is-synthetic-data)，它从[模仿（在新窗口中打开）](https://www.weforum.org/stories/artificial-intelligence/data-ai-training-synthetic)真实场景的算法和模拟模型创建信息。国内辩论和监管的缺乏不会抵消中国开放模式的迭代优势。它可能会从内部瓦解美国的民主。

如果让特朗普政府拥有特权，人工智能可能会侵蚀美国的言论自由，特朗普政府[一再（在新窗口中打开）](https://www.aclu.org/news/free-speech/government-Pressure-to-suspend-jimmy-kimmel-was-an-abuse-of-power)违反了宪法对[言论自由（在新窗口中打开）]的保护。窗口）]（https://www.cnn.com/2026/10/13/politics/judge-gives-cnn-white-house-access-media-ban）。这种威胁使得围绕人工智能的公开辩论成为辩论权的元保障。
特朗普政府还可能使用数字工具在选举中操纵舆论，这是它所采用的策略

【原文 English Original】
> AI may erode freedom of expression in the US if left to the prerogative of the Trump administration.

China additionally offers a dystopian preview of how AI can further curtail and pre-empt public expression. The government currently [uses (Opens in new window)](https://www.aspi.org.au/report/the-partys-ai-how-chinas-new-ai-systems-are-reshaping-human-rights/) AI to scan and censor swathes of textual and visual data, while Chinese companies are developing technology that would allow the state to [reshape (Opens in new window)](https://www.nytimes.com/2025/08/06/us/politics/china-artificial-intelligence-information-warfare.html) public opinion through personalised propaganda and [predict (Opens in new window)](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/06/01/us/politics/china-ai-predicting-dissent.html) which individuals will become future dissidents.

The word “gap” implies that there is something to fill, that the US is behind and Americans should hasten towards unflagging support. This presumes that the threat of China outpacing the US would inflict consequences far greater than those resulting from a lack of public debate. Such a cost–benefit analysis is questionable. The proliferation of low-cost Chinese models, including those released by [DeepSeek and Z.ai (Opens in new window)](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/07/chinese-ai-models-costs-us-openai-anthropic.html), is [costing (Opens in new window)](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/09/26/china-ai-global-adoption.html) US companies market share as well as [exporting (Opens in new window)](https://sccei.fsi.stanford.edu/publication/political-censorship-large-language-models-originating-china)[political biases (Opens in new window)](https://www.reuters.com/world/china/us-scrutinizes-chinese-ai-ideological-bias-memo-shows-2025-07-09/) and [supplying (Opens in new window)](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/05/31/world/china-surveillance-solomon-islands-trump-nepal.html) surveillance tools to autocracies.

However, while China’s access to public data has [afforded (Opens in new window)](https://sccei.fsi.stanford.edu/china-briefs/has-access-government-data-given-chinas-ai-firms-innovation-edge) it a scaling edge, it is the open-weight design that has made its models freely available, supporting its proliferation. Several approaches could allow US companies greater data access while preserving democracy and privacy. They include [synthetic data generation (Opens in new window)](https://hai.stanford.edu/ai-definitions/what-is-synthetic-data), which creates information from algorithms and simulation models that [mimic (Opens in new window)](https://www.weforum.org/stories/artificial-intelligence/data-ai-training-synthetic) real-world scenarios. A lack of domestic debate and regulation would not offset the iterative advantage of China’s open models. It could unravel American democracy from the inside.

AI may erode freedom of expression in the US if left to the prerogative of the Trump administration, which has [repeatedly (Opens in new window)](https://www.aclu.org/news/free-speech/government-pressure-to-suspend-jimmy-kimmel-was-an-abuse-of-power) violated the constitutional protection of [free speech (Opens in new window)](https://www.cnn.com/2026/10/13/politics/judge-gives-cnn-white-house-access-media-ban). Such a threat makes public debate surrounding AI a meta-safeguard for the very right to debate.

The Trump administration may also use digital tools to manipulate public opinion in elections, a tactic it employed – through [human trolls (Opens in new window)](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/national-security/russian-trolls-who-interfered-2016-u-s-election-also-made-n1013811) – that predates the widespread and incisive competencies of AI. The risk of AI undermining free elections further underscores a need for public debate, which has animated [both sides (Opens in new window)](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/05/03/us/politics/democrats-republicans-ai.html) of the aisle.

Describing Chinese support for AI as the result of “optimism” and “enthusiasm” quietly counsel against such debate. Used to compare the US and China in what is characterised as a [zero-sum race (Opens in new window)](https://www.bloomberg.com/graphics/2026-us-china-ai-race/) between the countries to dominate AI, these phrases suggest that the American public should surrender judgement calls surrounding regulatory guardrails. They imply that Americans’ concerns do not serve their self-interest. The irony of these descriptors lies in their exclusionary effects within the hawkish, binary framework of “us versus them”.

Given the Chinese government’s control over technology companies and their deployment of AI, “them” is clearly defined. “Us”, however, could mean tech executives who express societal aspirations for their R&D, politicians, civil society, or media in the United States. The appraisal of the American public’s concerns as a competitive disadvantage insinuates that the public should remove itself from decisions that will have significant political consequences.

Taking public pressure out of the equation may benefit AI executives and a White House that favours unilateral action. It is unlikely to benefit the American people, whose agency may be ephemeral as a result.

# 河口湖台湾女游客命案 死者丈夫涉嫌共同杀人被羁押禁见

茉莉花综合报道 2026年10月27日 11:58

姓井的台湾女游客10月19日在日本山梨县富士河口湖町一家饭店遇刺身亡；她的丈夫李姓男子去日本处理她的后事，24日晚间搭机返台，在小港机场入境时被台南地检署的专案小组拘提。台南地检署10月27日说，检察官讯问后初步认定，李男涉嫌和井女虚伪结婚、鼓吹她单独赴日旅游，并为她投保高额保险，涉犯使公务员登载不实、共同杀人和诈欺取财未遂等罪嫌重大，又有逃亡、灭证之虞；台南地方法院26日裁定羁押禁见。

受影响的首先是井女在台湾的家属；这宗命案也从日本警方一地调查，变成台日两地同时侦办。日本警方10月19日以涉嫌违反《枪炮刀剑类持有取缔法》，逮捕了和死者同在一个房间的27岁杨姓台湾女子，认为她可能知道死者的死亡经过。台南地检署说，杨女曾因帮助诈欺（提供人头账户）被判刑；检警还发现，死者、李男和杨女三人的户籍都在台南。

台南地检署说，10月22日下午接到刑事警察局国际科报请指挥后，随即分案组成专案小组；24日、25日，专案小组持法院核发的搜索票，搜索李男住处等7处，拘提、传唤李男和证人共7人。专案小组查到，李男为井女投保的旅平险保单里，最大的两笔分别是新台币1000万元和2000万元，合计3000万元，并掌握李男曾和杨女接触的纪录。检方说，两人之间怎么联络、怎么分工，还要进一步调查；李男是否出钱指使杨女杀人，具体案情还要台日警方厘清。

河口湖命案从日本到台湾的侦办经过

1.   10月17日 井女随旅行团赴日，行程到21日

title: CPC Fifth Plenum to Advance Comprehensive Party Discipline
zh_title: 中共五中全会推进全面从严治党
summary: 中国 中国共产党二十届五中全会将讨论推进全面从严治党。官方媒体称，这加强了党的领导，落实了习近平的建党思想。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 27 日香港时间 10:11 · 阅读 2 分钟第五篇中国共产党第二十届中央委员会全体会议在北京开幕
content:
中国
中国共产党二十届五中全会将讨论推进全面从严治党。官方媒体称，这加强了党的领导，落实了习近平的建党思想。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 27 日，香港时间 10:11 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

据香港电台报道，中国共产党第二十届中央委员会第五次全体会议在北京开幕，主要议题是研究持续推进全面从严治党若干重大问题。

党办《人民网》发表评论文章称，此举对于巩固党的执政地位、履行党的使命任务具有重要意义。文章强调，党的领导和党的建设是事业发展的根本保证。
文章指出，全面从严治党要求全面覆盖党的建设各个方面，带动各党建工作同向而行、优势互补。报告称，现在超过500万个基层党组织“就像身体指挥武器、手臂指挥手指”，党的创造力、凝聚力、战斗力显着增强。

文章补充说，在中国共产党成立105周年之际，中央领导集体明确了习近平的建党思想。会议指出，坚持全面从严治党是习近平建党思想“十四个坚持”的重要内容，是新时代党的建设的战略指引。

文章进一步指出，在新长征路上，自觉用习近平建党思想谋划推进党的建设，党员干部自觉遵守党的政治纪律和规矩，齐心协力，一定能够创造无愧于党、无愧于人民、无愧于时代的成就。

The Chinese Communist Party's fifth plenum of the 20th Central Committee will discuss advancing comprehensive party discipline. State media says this strengthens party leadership and implements Xi Jinping's party-building ideology.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

27 Oct 2026 at 10:11 HKT · 2 min read

The fifth plenary session of the 20th Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party (CPC) has opened in Beijing, with a major agenda item being the study of persistently advancing comprehensive party discipline on several major issues, according to state broadcaster Radio Television Hong Kong (RTHK).

An opinion article on the party-run _People's Daily Online_ stated that this move is of great significance for consolidating the party's ruling position and fulfilling its mission and tasks. The article emphasised that party leadership and party building are fundamental guarantees for the development of the cause.

The article noted that comprehensive party discipline requires full coverage of all aspects of party building, driving all party-building efforts to work in the same direction and combine their strengths. It said that more than five million grassroots party organisations are now “like the body commanding the arms, and the arms commanding the fingers”, and that the party's creativity, cohesion and combat effectiveness have been significantly enhanced.

On the occasion of the 105th anniversary of the CPC's founding, the central leadership has clarified Xi Jinping's party-building ideology, the article added. It said that insisting on comprehensive party discipline is an important aspect of the “fourteen insistences” of Xi Jinping's party-building ideology and serves as the strategic guideline for party building in the new era.

The article further stated that on the new Long March, by consciously using Xi Jinping's party-building ideology to plan and advance party construction, and by having party members and cadres voluntarily observe party political discipline and rules and march in unison, they will certainly be able to create achievements worthy of the party, the people and the era.

title: China’s lab-grown diamond makers pivot to AI and chip sectors
zh_title: 中国实验室培育钻石制造商转向人工智能和芯片行业
summary: 以河南嘉瑞福为首的中国合成钻石生产商正在从珠宝转向半导体冷却和人工智能基础设施等高科技用途。随着数据中心和芯片制造商需求的增长，这一转变可能会给中国在中美技术竞争中带来新的影响力。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 27 日 10:28 HKT · 2 分钟阅读时间200 万克拉实验室培育钻石中的 70% 产出了
content:
商务
以河南嘉瑞福为首的中国合成钻石生产商正在从珠宝转向半导体冷却和人工智能基础设施等高科技用途。随着数据中心和芯片制造商需求的增长，这一转变可能会给中国在中美技术竞争中带来新的影响力。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 27 日 10:28 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

冯灿军工厂每年生产 200 万克拉实验室培育钻石，其中约 70% 目前用于珠宝首饰。但这位企业家押注中国人造金刚石行业的未来在于为半导体、人工智能服务器和其他高科技应用提供先进材料。

“我希望到 2030 年将我的产品中用于功能材料的份额提高到 50% 以上，同时将用于珠宝行业的份额减少到最多 30%，”冯说。
随着竞争加剧和价格面临压力，占全球供应量一半左右的中国实验室培育钻石生产商正在将目光投向宝石以外的领域。这一转变可能会赋予该行业在中美技术竞争中更大的战略意义。如果合成钻石在人工智能基础设施的半导体和热管理领域得到更广泛的应用，中国的生产主导地位可能会成为美国供应链的另一个弱点。

咨询公司 Ken Research 的项目经理马南·戈恩卡 (Manan Goenka) 表示：“现在，这一转变已成为钻石行业的决定性结构性故事，并且对全球技术供应链产生直接影响。”

分析师认为热管理是近期的机会，而使用金刚石作为半导体材料距离广泛的商业应用还很远。据中国媒体报道，华为和台积电正在探索用于芯片冷却的人造金刚石，而联想则在中国推出了一款消费笔记本电脑，据称该笔记本电脑使用了金刚石-铜冷却材料。 6 月，英特尔首席执行官 Lip-Bu Tan 表示，他个人投资了 Diamond Foundry，这是一家实验室培育的钻石制造商，致力于开发芯片级钻石晶圆。
一些中国生产商开始根据需求进行投资。据 6 月份提交的文件显示，河南黎粮钻石公司计划将最初为扩大宝石级钻石生产而筹集的 10 亿元人民币（1.4918 亿美元）资金转移到新的功能性钻石项目。据宁波材料技术与工程研究所称，今年 4 月，中国研究人员开发的金刚石-铜冷却模块将芯片模块的传热提高了 80%，并将芯片性能提高了 10%。

北京已采取行动将该技术纳入其出口管制制度，并于 2024 年将相关机械和关键部件置于限制之下。中国于 2025 年在其清单中增加了更多的人造金刚石产品，尽管根据去年 10 月达成的美中协议，实施推迟了一年。 “更广泛的含义是，合成钻石可能越来越多地成为围绕半导体、稀土和先进制造业的战略贸易政策对话的一部分，”戈恩卡说。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

【原文 English Original】
Business
Chinese synthetic diamond producers, led by Henan-based Jiaruifu, are shifting from jewellery to high-tech uses such as semiconductor cooling and AI infrastructure. The transition could give China new leverage in the US-China technology rivalry, as demand from data centres and chip makers grows.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

27 Oct 2026 at 10:28 HKT · 2 min read

Around 70 per cent of the 2 million carats of lab-grown diamonds produced annually at Feng Canjun’s factory currently go into jewellery. But the entrepreneur is betting that the future of China’s synthetic diamond industry lies in supplying advanced materials for semiconductors, AI servers and other high-tech applications.

“I am looking to raise the share of my products used in functional materials to more than 50 per cent by 2030 while reducing the share going to the jewellery sector to a maximum of 30 per cent,” Feng said.

China’s lab-grown diamond producers, which account for around half of the world’s supply, are looking beyond gemstones as competition intensifies and prices come under pressure. The shift could give the industry greater strategic significance in the US-China technology rivalry. If synthetic diamonds become more widely used in semiconductors and thermal management in AI infrastructure, China’s production dominance could emerge as another supply-chain vulnerability for the US.

“The transition is now the defining structural story in the diamond industry and one with direct implications for global technology supply chains,” said Manan Goenka, engagement manager at Ken Research, a consultancy.

Thermal management is viewed by analysts as a nearer-term opportunity, while the use of diamonds as a semiconductor material is further away from widespread commercial adoption. Chinese media have reported that Huawei and TSMC are exploring synthetic diamonds for chip cooling, while Lenovo has launched a consumer laptop in China that it says uses a diamond-copper cooling material. In June, Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan said he personally invested in Diamond Foundry, a lab-grown diamond maker developing chip-grade diamond wafers.

Some Chinese producers are beginning to invest in anticipation of demand. Henan Liliang Diamond plans to redirect 1 billion yuan ($149.18 million) in funds originally raised to expand gem-grade diamond production to a new functional-diamond project, according to a June filing. In April, diamond-copper cooling modules developed by Chinese researchers improved heat transfer from chip modules by 80 per cent and raised chip performance by 10 per cent, according to the Ningbo Institute of Materials Technology & Engineering.

Beijing has already moved to incorporate the technology into its export control regime, placing related machinery and key components under restrictions in 2024. It added more synthetic diamond products to its list in 2025, though implementation was postponed for a year under a US-China deal reached last October. “The broader implication is that synthetic diamonds could increasingly become part of the strategic trade-policy conversation surrounding semiconductors, rare earths and advanced manufacturing,” said Goenka.

title: Chinese University of Hong Kong to bid for Northern Territory university campus plots, president says
zh_title: 校长称香港中文大学将竞标北领地大学校园地块
summary: 香港中文大学校长吕约翰教授表示，北领地大学城项目将有助扩大香港八所公立大学的版图。他呼吁增加政府贷款，指出 100 亿港元只能建造五座建筑物，并警告单独的招标时间表会增加计划 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), 主编 2026 年 10 月 27 日 10:50 HKT · 2 分钟阅读 北领地大学校园前三块土地
content:
香港
中大校长吕约翰教授表示，北领地大学城项目将有助扩大香港八所公立大学的版图。他呼吁增加政府贷款，指出100亿港元只能建造五栋大楼，并警告分开的招标时间表会增加计划

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 27 日 10:50 香港时间 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

位于洪水桥的北领地大学城项目的前三块土地目前正在公开招标，投标将于今年年底结束。香港中文大学（中大）校长吕约翰教授已确认大学将参与竞标过程。

卢教授接受《明报》采访时表示，他相信大学城项目将让香港八所公立大学扩大足迹，增加对社会的影响。不过，他指出，政府将位于洪水桥、新田和打鼓岭的三个大学城校区划分为不同的招标期，这增加了大学规划的难度。
卢教授形容大学城的规模并不是特别大，应该在“理想与现实”之间取得平衡。他预计，在该地区设立校区的海外院校数量不会很多。

卢教授以“精品酒店”来比喻，表示香港的大学虽然声誉良好、国际排名较高，但弱点是空间有限。他认为，如果大学想做一些可以“改变世界”的事情，校园的规模很重要，因为它影响到可以容纳多少研究人员，进而影响专利和学术论文的数量。他表示相信大学城将有助于克服空间不足的问题。

在融资方面，卢教授表示，学校将审慎管理财务，量力而行。虽然政府提供了100亿港元的贷款额度，但他指出，个人贷款有上限，而且建设成本很高。他估计100亿港元只能兴建五栋楼，并表示希望政府增加贷款额。
当被问及重建学生会的问题时，卢教授表示，学校正在起草学生会章程的标准化模板，以允许学生向警方登记其社团。不过，他表示这一过程没有时间表，也不能承诺在任期内重建学生会。

CUHK president Professor John Lu says the Northern Territory University City project will help expand the footprint of Hong Kong's eight public universities. He calls for larger government loans, noting HK$10 billion can only build five buildings, and warns separated bidding timelines increase plann

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

27 Oct 2026 at 10:50 HKT · 2 min read

The first three plots of land for the Northern Territory University City project, located in Hung Shui Kiu, are currently open for tender, with bids closing at the end of this year. Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) president Professor John Lu has confirmed that the university will participate in the bidding process.

In an interview with the Ming Pao, Professor Lu said he believes the university city project will allow Hong Kong's eight public universities to expand their footprint and increase their impact on society. However, he noted that the government has separated the three university city campuses — located in Hung Shui Kiu, San Tin and Ta Kwu Ling — into different tender periods, which adds to the difficulty of planning for universities.

Professor Lu described the size of the university city as not particularly large, saying that a balance should be struck between “ideals and reality”. He predicted that the number of overseas institutions that would set up campuses there would not be high.

Using a “boutique hotel” as an analogy, Professor Lu said that while Hong Kong's universities have strong reputations and high international rankings, their weakness is limited space. He argued that if universities want to do things that can “change the world”, the size of the campus matters because it affects how many researchers can be accommodated, which in turn influences patents and the number of academic papers produced. He expressed confidence that the university city would help overcome the problem of insufficient space.

On financing, Professor Lu said the university would manage its finances prudently and only bid within its means. Although the government has provided a HK$10 billion loan facility, he noted that there is a cap on individual loans and that construction costs are high. He estimated that HK$10 billion could only build five buildings, and expressed hope that the government would increase the loan amount.

When asked about the re-establishment of the student union, Professor Lu said the university is drafting a standardised template for student union constitutions to allow students to register their societies with the police. However, he said there is no timetable for this process and that he could not promise to re-establish the student union during his tenure.

title: Nearly 30 per cent of surveyed SEN children have self-harmed, study finds
zh_title: 研究发现近30%的受访SEN儿童有过自残行为
summary: 香港协康会和香港浸会大学的一项调查发现，100名有特殊教育需要的儿童中，有29%有过自残行为。研究人员表示，主动为孩子寻求支持的父母可以降低自残的风险，并且正在试用一款针对父母的新应用程序 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 27 日 11:13 HKT · 阅读 2 分钟 一项调查发现，近 30% 的儿童患有特殊教育
content:
香港
协康会和香港浸会大学的一项调查发现，100名有特殊教育需要的儿童中，有29%有过自残行为。研究人员表示，主动寻求孩子支持的父母可以降低自残的风险，一款针对父母的新应用程序正在试用

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 27 日 11:13 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

一项调查发现，接受调查的有特殊教育需要（SEN）的儿童中，近30%有过自残行为。协康会联同香港浸会大学社会工作学系进行“SEN儿童自残警示征兆调查”，收集了100个SEN家庭的数据。研究发现，29 名儿童表现出自残行为，最常见的形式是打自己或扇自己耳光，其次是咬自己。
研究人员指出，一些父母在孩子经历情绪困扰时，倾向于立即将孩子从这种情况中移开或避免刺激源。虽然这些行为通常是出于保护孩子的愿望，但研究表明，如果长期使用，可能会对孩子管理情绪的能力产生负面影响。研究还发现，父母越愿意主动与孩子一起寻求支持，孩子自残的风险就越低。

分析显示，父母的幸福感越高，孩子的生活质量就越好。反过来，孩子生活质量的提高也有助于减少自残行为。另外，浸大获卫生局医疗健康研究基金资助，专为特殊教育需要儿童的家长开发一款名为“阳光之旅”的流动应用程序。

该应用针对家长常见的七种负面情绪，提供专业的心理教育、应对策略和放松练习。它包括日常情绪记录、生理状态跟踪和提醒功能，以及心理健康信息，帮助家长建立更有效的情绪调节技能。该应用程序目前正处于研究阶段，研究将于 11 月初开始。
该计划计划招募90名SEN儿童家长先行试用该应用程序，收集反馈以进行改进。预计明年初正式上线。

Researchers said parents who proactively seek support with their children reduce the risk of self-harm, and a new app for parents is being trialle

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

27 Oct 2026 at 11:13 HKT · 2 min read

A survey has found that nearly 30 per cent of children with special educational needs (SEN) who were surveyed had engaged in self-harming behaviour. The Heep Hong Society, together with the Department of Social Work at Hong Kong Baptist University (HKBU), conducted the SEN Children Self-Harm Warning Signs Survey, gathering data from 100 SEN families. It found that 29 children had exhibited self-harming behaviour, with the most common form being hitting or slapping themselves, followed by biting themselves.

The researchers noted that some parents, when their children experience emotional distress, tend to immediately remove the child from the situation or avoid the source of stimulation. While these actions are often motivated by a desire to protect the child, the study indicated that if used long term they may negatively affect the child's ability to manage emotions. The research also found that the more willing parents are to proactively seek support together with their child, the lower the risk of the child engaging in self-harm.

Analysis showed that the higher the parents' sense of well-being, the better the quality of life for their children. In turn, a higher quality of life for the child helped reduce self-harming behaviour. Separately, HKBU has received funding from the Health Bureau's Medical Health Research Fund to develop a mobile application called 'Journey with Sunny' specifically for parents of SEN children.

The app addresses seven common negative emotions faced by parents and provides professional psychological education, coping strategies and relaxation exercises. It includes daily mood recording, physiological state tracking and reminder functions, as well as mental health information, to help parents build more effective emotional regulation skills. The app is now in the research phase, with a study set to begin in early November.

The programme plans to recruit 90 parents of SEN children to trial the app first, collecting feedback for improvements. It is expected to be officially launched early next year.

# Hong Kong retail, tourism benefit from sports events, festivals, group says

Sino Group executives said Hong Kong's tourism and retail sectors have benefited from the government's event economy, with mainland visitor numbers rising about 30 per cent year-on-year during Mid-Autumn and National Day holidays. Hotel occupancy exceeded 80 per cent during the Golden Week.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 27 Oct 2026 at 13:18 HKT · 1 min read

Share:

[](https://wa.me/?text=Hong%20Kong%20retail%2C%20tourism%20benefit%20from%20sports%20events%2C%20festivals%2C%20group%20says%20https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/business/Hong-Kong-retail-tourism-benefit-from-sports-events-festival-0fc278 "WhatsApp")[](https://t.me/share/url?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/business/Hong-Kong-retail-tourism-benefit-from-sports-events-festival-0fc278&text=Hong%20Kong%20retail%2C%20tourism%20benefit%20from%20sports%20events%2C%20festivals%2C%20group%20says "Telegram")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/business/Hong-Kong-retail-tourism-benefit-from-sports-events-festival-0fc278 "Facebook")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/business/Hong-Kong-retail-tourism-benefit-from-sports-events-festival-0fc278&text=Hong%20Kong%20retail%2C%20tourism%20benefit%20from%20sports%20events%2C%20festivals%2C%20group%20says "X")[](mailto:?subject=Hong%20Kong%20retail%2C%20tourism%20benefit%20from%20sports%20events%2C%20festivals%2C%20group%20says&body=Hong%20Kong%20retail%2C%20tourism%20benefit%20from%20sports%20events%2C%20festivals%2C%20group%20says%0Ahttps%3A//clb.org.hk/en/business/Hong-Kong-retail-tourism-benefit-from-sports-events-festival-0fc278 "Email")

Sino Group finance president and co-managing director Chow Sing-man said on 27 October that tourist arrivals in Hong Kong have risen this year, helped by international sports events, concerts, financial forums and exhibitions. Mainland visitor numbers during the Mid-Autumn Festival and National Day holidays increased about 30 per cent compared with the same period last year, while non-mainland visitors also showed good growth, she said.

Overnight visitors are also gradually increasing, Chow said, with all hotels under the group reporting occupancy rates above 80 per cent during the National Day Golden Week. To attract more overnight guests, she said the hotel business has introduced concert packages, travel guides and mystery boxes, and will continue to improve service quality according to the needs of different markets and age groups.

Chief commercial officer Cai Bilin said Hong Kong's retail sector is developing steadily, benefiting from the government's event economy, such as the Halloween month. The "sports economy" has also boosted sales of related merchandise, with foot traffic at the group's shopping malls rising, he said. Cai expressed confidence that the momentum would continue into next year.

Asked about the possibility of developing student dormitories, Cai said the group has studied converting existing properties for a year, but found the costs and vacancy periods during renovation were not ideal for stakeholders. Bidding for new land would also require consideration of whether it could enhance value for shareholders, he added.

1789年法国大革命，像今天一样，巴黎底层市民涌上街头，推翻了法国一千多年的君主制，由雅各宾派接管了政权。雅各宾派首脑、残暴的罗伯斯比尔以理性与美德为名义，把巴黎变成了一座屠杀场。短短一年的时间，设在共和广场的断头台铡刀，日夜不停地落下，砍掉了7万多个脑袋。数以万计的无辜者，从国王路易十六、王后玛丽·安托瓦内特，一直到普罗大众、农民、修女，仅仅是因为不够革命，便被送上了刑场。最先掉脑袋的是一名律师，理由就是，罗伯斯比尔年轻时曾经追过一个女孩没成功，女孩后来嫁给了这个律师，当年我想追的女人没追上，我追不上的就要毁掉他们。

真实的法王路易十六善良、博学、勤奋与道德自律，他精通英语和拉丁语，对历史、地理、海洋学以及物理学有极浓厚的兴趣。他与祖父路易十五以及许多前任法王不同，路易十六在婚姻中相当忠诚，没有任何公开的情妇或宫廷绯闻，性格温和且颇具同情心。在面对革命风暴时，他多次拒绝向法国民众开枪。这种不愿流血的仁慈，最终导致他失去了对政局的控制。

王后玛丽·安托瓦内特尊贵而克制，在被捕囚禁于圣路易岛监狱及面对革命法庭的审判时，面对控方极其荒谬且污蔑性的控诉，她的辩驳赢得了在场许多人的敬佩。1793年10月被送上断头台时，她神态镇定自若，表现出了皇室应有的尊严。

跟中共镇压地主、资本家是一脉相承的:所谓地主、资本家，不就是有钱人吗？穷人有好人，但也有坏人；有钱人有坏人，但更多好人，因为富足，会得到更好的培育与教养，素质更高，他们实际上是社会城乡的士绅与民族精英。

雅各宾派还摧毁了传统秩序，斩断天主教信仰、和传统道德以及历史根基的一切的联系。正是这场崇尚暴力、否定一切传统道德价值和神圣秩序的革命，为共产主义思潮的诞生提供了土壤。

半个世纪之后，1848年德国人马克思《共产党宣言》发表，共产党产生了，并将法国大革命视为共产主义革命的伟大序幕。1848年，欧洲爆发了革命浪潮，1871年巴黎公社爆发，跟现在打砸抢一样，狂热的公社成员纵火烧毁了巴黎杜伊勒里宫、巴黎市政厅等等无数珍贵的历史建筑，并公开处决了巴黎总教区大主教。自此法国就成了欧洲共产主义邪恶思想的大本营了，也成了后来欧洲左翼势力的大本营。

共产邪灵它要在东西方同时布局。为了毁灭人类，邪灵操纵其在人间的代表，先是勾画了一个大同社会的美好愿景，然后选择不同的人间代理，以不同的方式散布歪理邪说，极其狡诈地实施毁灭人类的计划。如果说在苏联、中国等国家，共产邪灵采用的是暴力夺权、杀戮等方式，破坏传统文化、败坏人的道德，最后达到毁灭人类的目的，那么在西方所谓的“自由世界”，共产邪灵采用的则是渗透的方式，用千变万化的欺骗手法，变异其宗教、文化，控制其政治、经济、社会组织，最终也达到败坏人、毁灭人的目的。

**美国共产党人罗伊.辛汉姆及其“地下****党****”成长史**

8月7号《纽约时报》刊登了一篇长篇报导，4个记者做了几个月的调查挖掘，把中共在海外西方世界的一个地下党组织挖出来了，其首脑就是美国共产党人罗伊.辛汉姆。

大家记得在2021年10月底，当时很多香港人逃到英国去定居吗？结果英国有多个华人团体，实际都是亲共团体，在中国城那儿举行一个所谓反对歧视华人的集会，在那儿声援中共。那么反对这帮集会者的在伦敦的港人，就集会起来做对立性的抗议，结果亲共侨团就突然就伸手打人，冲到对面港人人群中对他们拳打脚踢，并且带着金属物品藏在衣服里作为武器。有的港人被打到头破血流，最后送到医院去救治。此事当时喧嚣一时。今年2月份，美国新一届国会特别成立了“中国特别委员会”，举行听证。听证时有三个美国白人站起来抗议，说什么中国不是敌人之类的。那三个人标写着“Code Pink”（**粉红代码**），即他们来自“粉红代码”这个组织。 “粉红代码”是谁呢？是美国共产党人罗伊.辛汉姆的妻子朱迪‧埃文斯的组织。但从现在开始，你就应该知道得一清二楚了，无论“粉红代码”，还是在伦敦打人的这些团体，都是中共在海外的资助的，以美国为中心的一个中共的地下党组织的成员、组织和行动。

辛汉姆1954年出生在美国的康涅狄格州，他比习近平只小了一岁。辛汉姆的老爸叫安奇.辛汉姆，是斯里兰卡政治学家和历史学家，后来移民到美国，去到纽约城市大学布鲁克林学院教政治学，他是早期“不结盟运动”的一个重要参与者。

什么叫“不结盟运动”？就是冷战时代，这边是华约，那边是北约，大家都在站队，有些国家像南斯拉夫的铁托，印度、埃及就说，我们谁也不靠，我们就抱团来个不结盟，叫“不结盟运动”。辛汉姆的老爹被认为是“不结盟运动”的一个重要人物，所以辛汉姆从小在饭桌上听到的，都是如何反帝、如何革命的东西。所以18岁时，在同龄人忙着谈恋爱、申请大学的时候，他加入了革命黑人工人联盟，这是一个搞黑人民族主义和[毛泽东](https://www.secretchina.com/news/gb/tag/%E6%AF%9B%E6%B3%BD%E4%B8%9C)思想的一个美国组织，信的是毛泽东思想，宣言的第一句话就是：要对种族主义、资本主义、帝国主义进行无情的斗争。1972年，辛汉姆被派到底特律克莱斯勒工厂工作，被FBI盯上，说白了他就是个美国共产党人，他是委内瑞拉当初的独裁者查韦斯的忠实粉丝，同时也是毛泽东的忠实的粉丝。他认为查韦斯把委内瑞拉建成了一个非常民主的地方，认为中国正在西方传授这样一个道理，是既有自由市场调节，又能长期规划的双轨制的世界，比西方更好。

罗伊.辛汉姆软件很厉害， 1993年在芝加哥创办了Thoughtworks公司，帮大公司写软件、搭系统的一个外包公司。客户倒都是大名鼎鼎的，像微软、甲骨文，还有好几家大银行，和英国的卫报。后来变成一个上市的软件公司，在最全盛的时候有4，500员工，在18个国家有49个办事处。

2001年，辛汉姆作为一个不断壮大的美国软件公司的老板，来到了华为，成了中国华为公司的战略技术顾问，而且一干就是7年。于是，辛汉姆和中共的缘分，早在这个时候就开始了。而这个关系还远不止于此。

2017年辛汉姆跟朱迪‧埃文斯结婚，埃文斯就是“粉红代码”（Code Pink）组织的创始人。它最早是一个反战组织，早年还强烈地批评中共，呼吁中共停止残酷镇压女性。但是婚后就开始转向了，再也不批评中共了。

2017年结婚之后，辛汉姆就把他的公司卖了大概将近8亿美元。他说要把这个钱来资助他要做的事业。他拿出了基金和中共政府的媒体机关密切合作，花了将近3亿美元，来资助中共在全球范围的大外宣，并且把这些宣传机构公司、媒体伪装成独立组织、独立内容。

这些组织成立之后，啥也不做，它就往下再通过这些组织把它的钱再传到它在全球各地资助的各种各样的革命单位去。在美国它成立了一些智库；在南非成立了一个政党；在印度、巴西成立了很多媒体，有的媒体已经相当大了，做到在脸书上的订阅就将近四百万人；还包括在伦敦成立了“不要冷战”（no cold war）组织，攻击在英国的香港人就他们搞出来的名堂；还有包括加纳之类的，就是在很多国家，遍布全球。

2023年《纽约时报》记者顺着线索找到上海市中心时代广场18楼一间红黄装修的办公室，即辛汉姆落脚点。与他共用办公室的是中国传媒公司“玛酷”，口号是“讲好中国故事”，招聘广告明确写着为全球流行媒体网络和进步智库生产文字、音频与视频，输出中国好故事，属中共外宣。《纽约时报》称其公司与上海一档YouTube节目合作，部分资金来自上海市委宣传部。2023年7月，他参加中共培训班，主题是如何在国际上宣传中国共产党。2025年11月，他在上海举办的全球南方学术论坛上说：“如果我们想要建立一个在多边主义基础上的新世界秩序，就像习主席、中国共产党和中国所提出的那样，我们就必须消除二战叙事造成意识形态伤害。”当《纽约时报》问他说，你跟中（共）国是不是穿一条裤子？他却断然否认，说我完全是以我的信仰为指导，这些信仰是我长期坚持的个人观点。

至此，这位曾在底特律汽车厂流水线上向工友宣讲毛泽东思想的少年，已在五大洲铺开一张网络，等待一场“火”的到来。2026年秋天，这场火在法国燃起。

辛汉姆的妻子、同时也是由其资助的极左翼团体“**粉红代码**”（CodePink）联合创办人朱迪‧埃文斯（Jodie Evans），在接受纽约媒体“突破新闻”（BreakThrough News）采访时，明确引用了法国、西班牙和印度的青年示威，作为呼吁美国民众走上街头的范例。那就是说要想他们看齐，也要在美国发动了。这显示出相关组织如何跨国串联，利用各地冲突推动其全球政治主张。

目前调查尚未发现辛汉姆的钱直接进入法国打砸抢者手中的证据。但比对幕后推手与资金图可见：与抗议组织方巴黎印度联盟关联的人民论坛是辛汉姆资助的；为暴乱剪正面宣传片的BreakThrough是辛汉姆资助的；在X上喊“让愤怒主宰此刻”的普拉沙德研究所是辛汉姆资助的；号召美国人上街的埃文斯及其粉红代码与辛汉姆有直接关联。他没有直接付钱给打砸抢的人，但台子是他出钱搭的，喇叭是他出钱买的，吹号的人是他出钱招的。

因为他给外国政府代言、办事，却没有在美国政府做任何的登记，美国已开始调查。今年夏天，美国司法部在纽约组建联邦大陪审团，调查辛汉姆下属组织的电汇诈骗、银行诈骗和洗钱。众议院筹款委员会向其资助的三家机构发传票，三家均拒绝递交材料。委员会下最后通牒：10月20日前不交，就将21人全部召至国会宣誓作证，名单包括辛汉姆本人。21日，众议院中国问题特别委员会公开点名辛汉姆。但国会目前无法强制其作证，因此时的辛汉姆早已躲到他认为最安全的地方——上海。

那么，《纽约时报》不是左派媒体吗？怎么会登出这个报导揭极左的中共呢？把跟中共一个鼻孔出气，穿一条裤子的辛汉姆旗下经营了这么久的公司全部给挖出来？

就因为他和《纽约时报》是不同的两个版本的共产主义。辛汉姆是斯大林主义和毛泽东主义这一脉过来，就是暴力共产主义；而《纽约时报》自己也是个极左的力量，只是它是渐进性的共产主义，它会做这样的事情，现在美国民主、共和两党都反中共，虽然以前他们有的人跟中共有勾结，民主、共和两党都有勾结，但是美国整体是反中共的，因为中共是另外一派。这叫做“路线斗争”， 即使是他的同志，斗争是共产主义的家常便饭。第二个可能性，就是记者可能也真的是他有他的自由、他的意志、他的政治倾向，也有可能。但是最终怎么通过《纽约时报》总编辑让它出去，那他一定是不喜欢中共的那一套东西。所以确实，这个世界存在自由社会和中共对抗这条战线，同时也存在美国内部的文化马克思主义，或叫文化共产主义、渐进式共产主义和美国的传统理念、传统力量、传统思想文化的冲突。

而这场由共产党人辛汉姆远程操盘的欧洲革命之火，似乎才刚刚开始。那些势力已经在地图上标出了212场活动，11月20号，意大利、西班牙、葡萄牙、德国、阿尔巴尼亚、希腊等至少12个国家联动同时爆发大罢课，工会和社会组织会集体上街。他们的首都和数百大城市中心已经扎满了抗议的帐篷。店主和居民也在为应对新一轮抗议活动而准备枪支，巴黎枪店生意异常火爆，武器的销量“增长了 10 倍”。下一波骚乱已经风雨满楼，西方文明正在陷入一场前所未有的深重的危机。

## **Takeaways** by Bloomberg AI[Subscribe](https://news.google.com/subscriptions)

Chinese industrial companies saw their earnings grow at the fastest in three months, lifted by rising producer prices against the backdrop of higher energy costs.

Industrial profits climbed 14.4% in September from a year earlier, up from 4.2% in August, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics Tuesday. Bloomberg Economics had forecast a [12% jump](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/terminal/TNC7A1KJH6VH).

# 竹竹苗縣市長選舉號次抽籤出爐 數字都有好彩頭

2026/10/27 12:13（10/27 12:31 更新）

[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[![Image 17](https://imgcdn.cna.com.tw/www/website/img/support.svg)](https://cna.com.tw/donate/)

苗栗縣選舉委員會27日辦理苗栗縣長選舉號次抽籤，民進黨苗栗縣長參選人陳品安（前）抽中1號，喊出「一定勝利」。中央社記者管瑞平攝 115年10月27日

（中央社新竹苗栗27日電）九合一選舉號次抽籤結果今天出爐，苗栗縣長選舉部分，民進黨苗栗縣長參選人陳品安抽中1號，喊出「一定勝利」；國民黨爭取連任的鍾東錦為2號，他說象徵「勝利連任」繼續為鄉親打拚縣政。

原訂23日辦理的115年地方公職人員選舉候選人號次抽籤，因薔琵颱風來襲，順延至今天舉行。苗栗縣選舉委員會上午在苗栗縣文化觀光局中正堂辦理第20屆縣長、第21屆縣議員選舉號次抽籤。

苗栗縣長選舉僅陳品安與鍾東錦登記參選，兩人在準備抽籤前互相握手致意，隨後依登記順序，由陳品安先行抽籤，抽出1號，喊出「一定勝利」。她指出，選戰至今已辦理近百場說明會，讓大家認識她承諾對接中央資源、財政永續發展以及保證未來對長輩、婦幼的福利提升。

陳品安說，台北有「洋流」、苗栗有暖流，選戰進入最後階段，會用所有心力，把幸福感政策、理念傳達給更多人，凝聚更多鄉親認同，相信一定可以贏得勝利、翻轉苗栗。

由於籤筒僅剩2號籤，鍾東錦披上競選團隊備妥的2號彩帶將籤取出，妻子陳美琦隨即遞上「勝利連任」祝福標語。鍾東錦受訪表示，2號象徵勝利連任，一定會繼續認真打拚縣政，懇請鄉親繼續支持。

鍾東錦說，4年來感謝縣籍立委與議會的支持，並與18鄉鎮市橫向聯繫順暢，在營養午餐、三節禮金等社會福利政策與鄉鎮市公所做最好搭配，因苗栗縣目前仍是全國唯一財政受中央控管縣市，在推動福利措施前，一定要經過審慎評估，但是該給鄉親的福利，絕對努力做最好規劃，他要祝福自己順利當選，也希望藍白陣營參選人都能心想事成、順利當選。

[![Image 19](https://imgcdn.cna.com.tw/www/website/img/ad300x223.jpg)](https://lin.ee/tPtHlLQ)

新竹市選委會今天辦理候選人號次抽籤作業，爭取連任的無黨籍新竹市長參選人高虹安抽到1號，喊出「1棒最強棒，新竹Go Homerun」；無黨籍參選人何志勇抽出2號，喊出「讓新竹再勇敢一次」；民進黨籍參選人莊競程由妻子方心慧代抽籤抽到3號，高喊「幸福新製程」。

新竹縣長選舉號次抽籤結果，民進黨籍新竹縣長參選人鄭朝方抽中1號，他說是幸運號碼，象徵「一路向前」，讓竹北經驗，竹縣實現。國民黨竹縣長參選人徐欣瑩抽出2號隨即喊出「勝利2號」，支持者也高喊「好事成雙、迎接勝利」；無黨籍竹縣長參選人朱定瑀抽到3號。（編輯：張銘坤）1151027

# Saint Lucian prime minister in Taiwan for state visit: MOFA

10/27/2026 11:18 AM

[](jsvscript:)[](jsvscript:)[](javascript:void(0))[Listen](javascript:)

[Link](javascript:)[Whatsapp](javascript:)[Reddit](javascript:)[Line](javascript:)[Email](javascript:)

To activate the text-to-speech service, please first agree to the privacy policy below.

Saint Lucian Prime Minister Philip J. Pierre. Image taken from Pierre's Facebook page

Taipei, Oct. 27 (CNA) Saint Lucian Prime Minister Philip J. Pierre arrived in Taiwan on Tuesday morning for a five-day state visit, during which he will meet with President Lai Ching-te (賴清德) and other officials to discuss bilateral issues.

Lai will host a military honors ceremony to welcome Pierre, and Foreign Minister Lin Chia-lung (林佳龍) will host a banquet for him, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MOFA) said in a statement late Monday night.

The two sides will also engage in discussions on issues of mutual interest and prospects for future cooperation, it said.

This is the Saint Lucian leader's fourth visit to Taiwan since taking office in the summer of 2021, according to MOFA.

Joining Pierre's delegation are Saint Lucian Attorney General Leslie Mondesir, Senator Allison A. Jean, and Daryl Raymond, chairman of the Saint Lucia Development Bank.

While in Taiwan, the delegation will visit Cathay General Hospital and the iconic Taipei 101 skyscraper in Taipei and the TSMC Museum of Innovation in Hsinchu, MOFA said.

Saint Lucia is one of 12 states worldwide that recognize the Republic of China (ROC) -- Taiwan's official name -- instead of the People's Republic of China (PRC).

The two countries first established diplomatic relations in 1984, but ties were broken in 1997 when Saint Lucia switched recognition from Taipei to Beijing.

In April 2007, the ROC and Saint Lucia reestablished diplomatic relations, prompting the PRC to sever the formal ties it had with the Caribbean country.

(By Joseph Yeh)

zh_title: FSC：资产过亿的台湾银行客户达32,000家 - 聚焦台湾
summary: 中新社台北10月27日电 据金融监督管理委员会(FSC)称，截至9月底，资产超过1亿新台币(308万美元)的台湾银行客户数量超过32,000家。台湾最高金融监管机构 FSC 周末公布的数据显示，截至 9 月底，当地银行业拥有 32,326 名高资产客户，环比增加 1,730 名。虽然这些高资产客户的资产超过新台币1亿元，但由于他们的财富组合包括房地产或其他道具，因此并非所有资产都委托给银行。
content:
中新社台北10月27日电 据金融监督管理委员会(FSC)称，截至9月底，资产超过1亿新台币(308万美元)的台湾银行客户数量超过32,000家。

台湾最高金融监管机构 FSC 周末公布的数据显示，截至 9 月底，当地银行业拥有 32,326 名高资产客户，环比增加 1,730 名。

虽然这些高资产客户的资产超过新台币1亿元，但由于他们的财富组合包括房地产或其他财产持有，因此并非所有资产都委托给银行。

然而，金管会表示，截至9月底，台湾银行管理的这些富裕客户的实际资产平均仍略高于新台币1亿美元，总计3.24万亿新台币，较一个月前增加1,294亿新台币。

金融资产持有量和高财富客户的增长在一定程度上反映了股票和其他金融资产价值的持续增长，台湾证券交易所基准指数仅在 9 月份就上涨了 4%。

另一个因素可能是越来越多的银行提供越来越广泛的金融产品，使台湾成为更具吸引力的财富管理市场。

据金融服务委员会称，截至9月底，已有25家台湾银行获得向高资产客户提供服务的批准，而另一家银行的申请仍在审查中。
FSC表示，随着银行扩大金融产品供应，截至9月底，存款占高资产客户持有总资产的39.3%，低于一个月前的39.4%。

该比率是自2022年3月以来的最低水平，当时存款占总存款的38.6%。

截至9月底，共同基金投资占这些客户总资产的17.6%，高于一个月前的17.3%；保险产品占13.6%，高于8月份的13.2%。

另外14.8%的资产是债券，约8%是海外结构性产品。

金管会表示，与去年同期相比，投资于除存款以外的所有金融产品的资产比例均有所上升。

与此同时，截至9月底，金管会还批准了10家券商向高资产客户提供次级经纪服务，允许他们通过当地券商下单购买海外股票，而无需在境外开设账户。

除子经纪业务外，金管会还批准本地券商以其他资产管理产品服务其高资产客户。

金管会表示，截至9月底，本地证券业高资产客户数量达2,190家，较去年同期增加40%，投资金额同比猛增78%至新台币6,858亿元。

（苏思云、黄芳芳摄）

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 27 (CNA) The number of clients of Taiwanese banks with assets of more than NT$100 million (US$3.08 million) surpassed 32,000 at the end of September, according to the Financial Supervisory Commission (FSC).

Data released over the weekend by the FSC, Taiwan's top financial regulator, showed that the local banking sector had 32,326 high-asset clients at the end of September, up 1,730 from a month earlier.

Though these high-asset clients have assets of over NT$100 million, not all of their assets are entrusted to banks because their wealth portfolio includes real estate or other property holdings.

Yet the actual assets of these wealthy clients under management by Taiwanese banks still averaged just over NT$100 million to total NT$3.24 trillion at the end of September, up NT$129.4 billion from a month earlier, the FSC said.

The growth in financial asset holdings and high-wealth clients reflected in part a sustained increase in the values of stocks and other financial assets, with the Taiwan Stock Exchange's benchmark index up 4 percent in September alone.

Another factor may be that more banks are offering an increasingly wide range of financial products, making Taiwan a more attractive wealth management market.

According to the FSC, 25 Taiwanese banks had received approval to provide services to high-asset clients as of the end of September, while an application from another bank was still under review.

As banks expanded their financial product offerings, deposits accounted for 39.3 percent of the total assets held by high-asset clients at the end of September, down from 39.4 percent a month earlier, the FSC said.

The ratio was the lowest since March 2022, when deposits accounted for 38.6 percent of the total, it said.

Mutual fund investments accounted for 17.6 percent of these clients' total assets at the end of September, up from 17.3 percent a month earlier, while insurance products represented 13.6 percent, compared with 13.2 percent in August.

Another 14.8 percent of the assets were in bonds and about 8 percent were in overseas structured products.

On a year-on-year basis, the proportions of assets invested in all financial products other than deposits increased, the FSC said.

The FSC, meanwhile, had also approved 10 securities firms as of the end of September to provide sub-brokerage services to high-asset clients, allowing them to place orders for overseas equities through local brokerages without opening accounts abroad.

In addition to the sub-brokerage business, the FSC has also approved local securities firms to serve their high-asset clients in other asset management products.

The number of high-asset clients in the local securities industry reached 2,190 at the end of September, up 40 percent from a year earlier, while their investments surged 78 percent year-on-year to NT$685.8 billion, the FSC said.

(By Su Ssu-yun and Frances Huang)

content:
Wrongly Accused Abroad Help Me Afford Legal Defense and Survival.

Hi to everyone, my name is Julian! I'm an Italian and American national, I used to work as a substitute teacher in an Italian high school.

On 26th of August I went to China to start traveling. Some weeks later, on September 28th, I arrived in Thailand. Since then, I had been traveling mostly in northern Thailand.

It was an incredible experience — honestly, probably the best of my life.

But then… something completely unexpected happened to me.

On Wednesday, November 26th, very early in the morning around 5:30 a.m., I booked a Grab taxi from where I was staying, in Nothanburi (a province northwest of Bangkok), to go to Suvarnabhumi Airport. I had a flight with Etihad Airways at 8:55 a.m. to Italy, where I live.

I arrived at the airport two hours before departure, as recommended by the airline. The check-in process went smoothly, and everything seemed normal until I reached immigration.

There were two sections: one with officers and one automatic lane. The automatic lane was moving faster, so I chose that. When it was my turn, I tapped my passport on the scanner, but a red message appeared. I tried again—same result.

A security guard came to help me and tried scanning my passport himself, but it still didn’t work. He then told me to go to the manual lane.

The immigration officer took my passport, typed something on her computer, smiled, and said, “Sorry, just wait here for a moment.” She left and returned a few minutes later with another officer who looked serious. They escorted me to the immigration desk and told me to wait.

At that moment I started to feel anxious. I thought maybe I had overstayed my visa. My visa was expiring that same day, November 26th, so I was worried I might be in trouble.

After about 15 minutes, I approached the desk to ask what was happening, but they just told me to sit down and wait. Ten minutes later, another officer came with a paper showing a photocopy of my passport and asked me to confirm that it was mine. I said yes.

Most of the staff did not speak English, which made everything more frightening.

Then, using a translation app on his phone, the officer showed me a message saying that I was being charged with possession of indecent content and distribution of that material on websites accessible to the public.

I was completely shocked and confused. I thought there must be a mistake.

There was no opportunity to explain anything. Two immigration officers escorted me to another office inside the airport.

Inside, I was told to sign many documents, all in Thai. No one explained them to me in English. They took photos of me with officers behind me. Later, they took more photos from the front, left, and right. That’s when I realized: they were taking a mugshot.

Everything felt surreal. I was exhausted because I hadn’t slept much the night before. It felt like a nightmare.

“Did you tell your family that you have been arrested?”

That was the moment it truly hit me. I had never imagined being arrested in my life, especially not in a foreign country. I was terrified and confused.

I called my embassy, but it was still closed. Later, they contacted me and explained the situation. The embassy told me that creating and distributing certain types of videos can be a crime in Thailand, as in many countries, and that if I believed I was innocent, the Thai legal process would take its course.

They asked me for two emergency contacts and sent me a list of lawyers, advising me to find legal representation.

Eventually, we arrived at a police station in Samut Prakan province, in a town called Khlong Dan.

At that point, I was officially placed under arrest and faced the risk of jail if I was unable to pay bail.

My Italian passport was confiscated by the police and is currently being held by them. This happened on November 26th.

I am writing this today, February 24, 2026. I am creating a YouTube channel to explain in more detail what is happening to me. I am currently safe and living in a hostel in Bangkok. The last three months have been the most stressful of my life.

In December, I struggled to obtain a visa extension, which I was finally able to secure on January 8, 2026. This visa must be renewed every 45 days.

I am asking for your help to raise funds for legal fees, living expenses, and possible bail that may be requested by the judge if the case goes to court. I cannot legally work in Thailand because that requires a work visa. My family is helping me at the moment, but they cannot sustain these expenses for much longer. I do not know when I will be able to return to my country, as I must wait for the Thai legal process to run its course.

**I want to state clearly that I have never uploaded any indecent content on the internet. The accuser, a woman, has claimed to provide “evidence” of this. At the police station, I was shown the alleged evidence, which consisted of screenshots from an OnlyFans profile belonging to a couple: a Thai woman and a Caucasian man. The man’s face was blurred, and I was accused of being that person.**

The case will soon be handed over to the prosecutor, and according to police officers at Khlong Dan Police Station, it will most likely proceed to court (that's what they said). This is extremely distressing, especially because my lawyer has told me that cases with weak evidence are usually dropped by the police or the prosecutor.

Thank you for taking the time to read my story. Any help or support during this very difficult time would mean a great deal to me.

Julian

My wife Shen and I are facing one of the most difficult challenges of our lives. Shen has been scheduled for an immigration deportation hearing, and we are doing everything we can to keep our family together. Shen is not only my loving wife, but also a valued member of our community. She has worked hard to build a life here in the United States, learning English, working diligently, and always paying her taxes. Shen has never been accused of or arrested for any crime, either here or in her native China. Despite her dedication and positive contributions, we now find ourselves in a desperate situation, fighting to prevent her removal from the country.

 The funds we raise will go directly toward covering the costs of Shen's legal defense. This includes travel expenses to the court, lawyers' fees, and other related costs that are quickly adding up. We are committed to doing everything possible to help Shen continue her path to citizenship and remain with her family and friends in the country she now calls home. Your support will make a real difference in our ability to fight this battle and keep our family together.

 Please support us in our struggle to fight Shen's upcoming immigration removal hearing scheduled for May 26, 2026. Every donation, no matter the size, brings us one step closer to justice and hope. We are deeply grateful for any help you can provide, whether it's a contribution or simply sharing our story with others. Thank you for standing with us during this incredibly difficult time.

# HELP BRING MY SON BACK HOME

My name is Nelson Wells, Sr. and I write to you on behalf of my wife, Cynthia Wells, and our family, asking for your assistance in our fight to bring home our son, Nelson Wells, Jr., who has been unjustly imprisoned in China for more than eight years. We are natives of Louisiana, who have served our country for decades. I served in the United States Army for more than 20 years, and Cynthia, served at the Department of Defense for nearly 28 years. We’ve traveled all over the United States and world and have a host of extended family and friends, who join us in the fight for our son. This includes Nelson’s wife and three children, who are desperate to have him returned to our family unit. Like us, Nelson, Jr. loved to travel, and it was this love of travel that inspired him to live in Japan and visit China. Unfortunately, it was on one of these visits there that Nelson was arrested and later convicted on a drug charge with little evidence of his guilt, opportunity to defend himself, or due process prior to this conviction and incarceration. He was stripped of his freedom without the opportunity to tell his story. Indeed, it took months for us to learn what happened to him. We’ve fought for years to help our son, working behind the scenes with advocates, lawyers and diplomatic officials in the United States and China. We were told that this quiet strategy was the best strategy to keep him safe, but after nearly a decade with little progress, we’ve decided to tell our story, Nelson’s story. It breaks our heart to say it, but Nelson is now sick. The weight of incarceration has taken a toll on his physical and mental health. As you can see from the photos, our child has gone from a healthy man to an emaciated one, who has lost more than 100lbs and is in poor health. He is suffering from life-threatening medical problems in a prison in Chongqing Southwest China far from us, far from his wife and children. Indeed, we have not seen him during these eight long years. We are sustained by periodic calls from him, and for that, we are thankful to God, the United States State Department, and the Chinese government and prison officials. Still, we fear that he will not last much longer. It is time to bring Nelson home, perhaps through medical parole. Whatever the pathway, getting help for him is more urgent now than ever and so we are turning to the public for help with legal fees and welfare support on his behalf. No amount is too small, and we promise that your donations will only be used to directly secure the release and return of our son. We also invite you to leave a comment alongside your donation with a note of inspiration that we can share with Nelson, a personal reflection about Nelson for those who know him, or a testimonial about why you are deciding to join our fight. Thank you for considering this request. Thank you for your thoughts and prayers for Nelson. Thank you, in advance, for your generosity. Even the act of creating this go fund me page and sharing our story publicly has given us – including Nelson – purpose and hope for the future when we can be reunited. Until then we are heartbroken, but we fight on. Mr. Nelson Wells, Sr. and Mrs. Cynthia Wells Louisiana
