**Help for Bhujung Tamang**

Dominic and Kayla are raising funds for Bhujung Tamang, a friend they met while traveling in Nepal before/after the Langtang trek. During that trip, Dominic and Kayla stayed with Bhujung for a few days in his village of Syabru Besi. Bhujung welcomed them with kindness and gave them a truly special local experience they have never forgotten. Now, after a devastating flood destroyed Syabru Besi, Bhujung is facing an unimaginable loss. His home and hotel were destroyed, many of his friends were killed or are missing, and he lost all of his possessions in the disaster. It is estimated that Syabru Besi still has 1300 people missing.

Dominic and Kayla met Bhujung by chance while starting their 7 day hike up the Langtang Valley, one of Nepal's premier hiking destinations. They were looking for a place to stay and found the only hotel in the Old Village of Syabru Besi. Upon getting to know Bhujung, Dominic and Kayla discovered that they were the first guests Bhujung had had in almost 3 years because he was taking care of his late mother's declining health. As a token of gratitude and friendship, Bhujung gifted Dominic and Kayla a hand stitched bag his mother made pictured above.

This fundraiser is meant to provide direct relief to Bhujung as he begins the long process of recovering and rebuilding after this tragedy. The money raised will go directly to him to help support his immediate needs (food, housing, etc.) and give him a foundation to move forward after losing so much. Dominic and Kayla are asking for donations of any amount to help Bhujung through this heartbreaking time. If you are able to give, thank you for showing compassion and support to someone who once showed such generosity to travelers far from home. Please consider donating and sharing this fundraiser to help Bhujung rebuild his life.

Please Help Flood Victims at the Nepal–Tibet Border

Severe flooding has left families across the Nepal–Tibet border region without homes, food, clean water, and essential medical care. Their needs are urgent, and your support can provide immediate relief, comfort, and hope.

The Indian Association of Sacramento (IAS) based in Sacramento , California, USA has a long-standing commitment to helping families in need. We have supported more than 40 charitable causes and raised over $250,000 for those facing hardship. We have also responded to natural disasters, including supporting victims of the 2025 Nepal earthquake.

Today, we ask you to stand with flood-affected families. Please give what you can—every contribution matters, and even a small donation can help provide vital supplies and support.

Together, we can bring relief to families who have lost so much.

Momo Crawlers, we’re asking for your help.

The disaster at the Nepal-Tibet border has left thousands displaced from their homes, and the full scope of the crisis is still being realized. Many Momo Crawl vendors and volunteers remain concerned for loved ones who are still missing.

Through friends and family, we’ve established contact with mutual aid networks on the ground in Nepal. They are also providing us with live updates on the aid groups they’re seeing, what those groups are accomplishing, and where additional support is most needed.

Our plan is to allocate funds according to the feedback we receive from our contacts in Nepal. In addition to mutual aid groups and NGOs, we anticipate directing a significant portion of proceeds to the Nepali government’s [Prime Minister Disaster Relief Fund](https://pmdrf.nchl.com.np/). This fund accepts digital payments, and we encourage you to donate directly if you prefer: [](https://pmdrf.nchl.com.np/)[https://pmdrf.nchl.com.np](https://pmdrf.nchl.com.np/)

We established this GoFundMe primarily for ease of use and to help us track the impact of the Momo Crawl community. We expect to keep the drive active until Momo Crawl on September 13th, 2026, but donations received now will be allocated to relief efforts on a rolling basis. We will share updates about the use of funds as information becomes available.

With love and gratitude,

The Momo Crawl team

**Tarra Subhar Massallo**

Donation protected

After fleeing from the Chinese annexation of Tibet, many Kyirong Tibetan families crossed into Nepal believing their exile would be temporary. It was not. Syabrubesi and the Trishuli valley had become their home instead- a place where hundreds of families had to rebuild from nothing, including my grandparents. Like many Tibetan refugees, they eventually moved on to build new lives in India. However, not everyone left. Some of their family stayed behind in Syabrubesi and the Trishuli valley, carrying on the roots left behind by previous generations.

On August 26, 2026, a glacier collapse high in the Langtang Himal sent a wall of water and debris surging down the Bhote Koshi and Trishuli Bazaar: the towns where that branch of our family stayed and built their lives after losing everything once before. **Four households in our family were directly affected:**

*   **Our cousin Dawa Dakpa (confirmed deceased) leaves behind a wife and two young children.**
*   **Aku Jangchup, his wife, and child (confirmed deceased)**
*   **Nama Nangsa Ghongma's family and relatives (missing)**
*   **Nama Karmo Subhar's family and relatives (missing)**

Now, our families face rebuilding once again, with roads and homes submerged in mud. **100% of every contribution will go directly to these impacted families and the wider flood-affected communities**as they recover together. The funds will be spent on various essentials based on each family's needs (including, but not limited to: temporary shelter, food, emergency medical care, and transportation costs). We invite you to help write the next chapter of this story. Please help support this fundraiser in any way that you can.

**Who I am:**

My name is Tarra Subhar Massallo. I am the granddaughter of Tibetan refugees who fled from Kyirong during the 1959 Chinese annexation of Tibet, and the daughter of a Tibetan immigrant mother who moved from India to the United States with her family in search of a better life. Growing up in a mixed household, I am surrounded by the importance of my many cultures and giving back to my respective communities.

title: 卢拉在巴西赢得第四任期，却面临敌对国会与分裂的国家。
source: 澳洲唐人街 – Australia ChinaTown News 中文华人新闻
summary: 卢拉已赢得四届总统选举 巴西资深左翼总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦（Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva）在激烈角逐后成功连任，击败了右翼对手弗拉维奥·博索纳罗（Flávio Bolsonaro）。 这是卢拉第四次赢得总统选举，他曾于 2003 年 1 月至 2010 年 12 月担任两届总统，并于 2023 年 1 月再次就职。 但通往周日决选胜利的道路并不平坦。 博索纳罗在 10 月 4 日的初选中击败了卢拉，许多人认为他不可能在短短三周内扭转局势。
content: 卢拉已赢得四届总统选举 巴西资深左翼总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦（Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva）在激烈角逐后成功连任，击败了右翼对手弗拉维奥·博索纳罗（Flávio Bolsonaro）。 这是卢拉第四次赢得总统选举，他曾于 2003 年 1 月至 2010 年 12 月担任两届总统，并于 2023 年 1 月再次就职。 但通往周日决选胜利的道路并不平坦。 博索纳罗在 10 月 4 日的初选中击败了卢拉，许多人认为他不可能在短短三周内扭转局势。 他也在拉丁美洲更广泛的趋势中逆势而行，该地区选民往往惩罚现任领导人并转向右翼。在整个地区，像阿根廷、智利和哥伦比亚这样的大国现在都由保守派领导人执政。 卢拉在周日投票后向支持者致意 卢拉的竞选活动在其首轮失利后，受到街头示威和大规模社交媒体活动的推动而重新焕发生机。 这位前金属工人，自 1989 年首次参选总统以来一直是巴西左翼的主导人物，尽管如此，他仍面临着自 2003 年上任以来最具挑战性的政治环境。 他的新任期将于 2027 年 1 月 5 日开始，将在国内和国际面临重大限制的情况下开启，其中包括来自美国总统唐纳德·特朗普（Donald Trump）的敌意。 虽然特朗普没有直接支持卢拉的对手弗拉维奥·博索纳罗——他曾支持哥伦比亚和洪都拉斯右翼候选人赢得总统选举——但毫无疑问，他的政府会希望看到一个保守派领导人执掌这个拥有 2.13 亿人口的国家。 白宫将拉丁美洲视为美国影响力的区域，特朗普政府渴望拥有支持其政策的领导人掌权，包括在国防、安全和贸易方面。 它也渴望减少中国在西半球的影响力。 巴西是一个石油资源丰富、拥有全球第二大稀土矿藏的国家，是南美洲唯一不由右翼领导人治理的大国，卢拉很大程度上被视为亲华。 弗拉维奥·博索纳罗曾承诺让巴西更紧密地与美国对齐，而卢拉则警告美国不要干涉选举，并坚持认为巴西将“永远不会成为任何人的后院”。 但尽管白宫可能感到失望，卢拉的胜利仍会受到环保人士的欢迎，他们担心博索纳罗获胜会给巴西有影响力的农业和矿业部门带来更大权力。 他们曾指出，在其父亲雅伊尔（Jair）总统任期内，亚马逊地区的砍伐和森林火灾达到了创纪录水平，认为在年轻的博索纳罗手下，宽松的环境政策可能导致这一关键生态系统的再次破坏。 一架来自绿色和平组织的飞行器拍摄的航拍图显示，2025 年在巴西马瑙斯州（Maranhao）的塞罗·诺沃（Centro Novo）附近举行的联合国气候变化大会（COP30）期间，亚马逊雨林发生了一场火灾 虽然卢拉的支持者对他的胜利欣喜若狂，但这一结果也表明该国仍然极度分裂，超过 48% 的选民选择了博索纳罗。 除了团结这样一个极度两极分化的国家的挑战外，卢拉还将与巴西民主时代最右翼的国会共同执政。 博索纳罗的自由党（PL）是此次选举中获益最大的政党。 然而，卢拉的劳工党（Workers’ Party）在决选前成功组织了大规模集会，展示了其强大的基层支持基础。 在选举之前，卢拉将此次民调描述为“巴西的分水岭”。 他承诺通过“新的治理方式”弥合巴西对立政治两极之间的差距，并在选举前的 WhatsApp 直播中补充道：“这个国家将不再相同。” 虽然他并未详细说明这种新的治理方式将包含什么内容，但他坚持称他将“在争取一个更公正的国家、为所有人提供机会以及针对民众需求的政策方面保持坚定”。 面对一个主要敌对的国会，这位资深领导人——在他第四任期结束时将年满 85 岁——的这场斗争可能会比他此前任职的三届任期更加艰难。

summary: 支聯會案：鄒幸彤、李卓人及何俊仁被判監禁5月2月至7年3月不等 支聯會、支聯會前主席李卓人及前副主席鄒幸彤早前被裁定「煽動顛覆罪」罪名成立，連同認罪的支聯會前副主席何俊仁， 於9月11日在西九龍裁判法院（暫代高等法院）被判刑 。 鄒幸彤：監禁7年3個月 李卓人：監禁7年 何俊仁：監禁5年2月個 支聯會：罰款150萬港元 三位法官李運騰、陳仲衡及黎婉姫頒布書面判詞，解釋判刑理由。判詞指出，法官基於本案證據及事實，將案情界定為「情節嚴重」級別，以監禁7年半為量刑起點；鄒、李及何三
content: 支聯會案：鄒幸彤、李卓人及何俊仁被判監禁5月2月至7年3月不等 支聯會、支聯會前主席李卓人及前副主席鄒幸彤早前被裁定「煽動顛覆罪」罪名成立，連同認罪的支聯會前副主席何俊仁， 於9月11日在西九龍裁判法院（暫代高等法院）被判刑 。 鄒幸彤：監禁7年3個月 李卓人：監禁7年 何俊仁：監禁5年2月個 支聯會：罰款150萬港元 三位法官李運騰、陳仲衡及黎婉姫頒布書面判詞，解釋判刑理由。判詞指出，法官基於本案證據及事實，將案情界定為「情節嚴重」級別，以監禁7年半為量刑起點；鄒、李及何三人皆以支聯會常委及主要行事者的角色共同行動，因此「罪責基本相同」，但因認罪與否、過往公職、審訊延後等因素獲不同程度減刑。 關於案情嚴重程度，判詞強調，法庭沒有忽略本案不涉及暴力、被告等未有就如何實踐「結束一黨專政」提出具體執行方法或時間表、沒有足夠證據顯示被告言行導致任何實際妨害等事實；不過，判詞列出六項案情屬於「情節嚴重」級別的原因，包括被告等在動盪不安的社會氛圍下作出煽動言行，令國家安全和公眾秩序面臨更大風險；被告言行非單一事件，案發時段長達14個月；被告為社會知名人士，在港具動員和影響力；涉案活動屬全港性、接觸面廣等。 此外，法庭不接納各被告因不了解《港區國安法》而誤墮法網的說法，認定各被告在相信「結束一黨專政」的主張有可能違反中國《憲法》及《港區國安法》之下，在後者生效後仍然一意孤行，大力鼓吹推動「結束一黨專政」主張，是有預謀之舉。 2026年9月10日，香港記者協會主席鄭嘉如對《華爾街日報》母公司 Dow Jones Publishing Co. (Asia), Inc. 提私人刑事檢控一案，裁定鄭部份勝訴。攝：林振東/端傳媒 鄭嘉如控《華爾街日報》母公司，獲判部分勝訴 香港記者協會（記協）主席鄭嘉如對《華爾街日報》母公司 Dow Jones Publishing Co. (Asia), Inc. 提私人刑事檢控一案，主任裁判官張志偉於9月10日宣讀判詞，裁定鄭部份勝訴， Dow Jones 非法解僱罪名不成立、阻撓行使工會權利罪名成立 。 鄭嘉如在法院大樓外接受傳媒採訪，稱歡迎裁決。她強調，香港市民參與職工會的基本權利受法律保障，僱主無權要求僱員索取批准，但由於事實上很少應用相關法例作成功檢控，因此僱主可以肆無忌憚違反勞工法例。 鄭還稱，本案最理想的情況是由政府提出檢控，因為一般市民沒有提出私人檢控的資源。她解釋，如果要花幾百萬元去伸張一個基本權利，則可以說這個基本權利已經不受法律保護。再者，她認為相比起政府，提出私人檢控的原告之調查、搜證權力有限。因此，她希望勞工處日後能更堅決、堅定地打擊嘗試打壓職工會的行為。 本案源於2024年6月鄭嘉如當選記協主席，但在 當選後不足一個月遭《華爾街日報》以「職位重組」為由辭退 ，鄭及後對僱主提出涉及《僱傭條例》控罪的私人檢控。 2024年9月26日，「立場新聞」時任署任總編輯林紹桐被控串謀發布煽動刊物案在區域法院判刑，時任署任總編輯林紹桐即時獲釋。攝：林振東/端傳媒 《立場》前署任總編輯林紹桐提定罪上訴，上訴庭半年內裁決 《立場新聞》被控「串謀發布煽動刊物」一案，前總編輯鍾沛權及前署任總編輯林紹桐被裁定罪名成立，後者因健康情況獲判處扣除還押日子後即時釋放的刑期。林紹桐後來就定罪提出上訴， 上訴庭於9月22日開庭 ，三位法官聽畢雙方陳詞，押後於六個月內頒布裁決。 上訴人一方指出，林於2021年11月接手署任總編輯一職，案中被裁定為煽動的11篇文章當中，林只負責審批〈【中大衝突兩年】畢業生憶徒步前行護校　哀山城人文精神消逝〉一文，因此上訴方將聚焦這篇文章。 上訴人一方指，該篇文章為人物專訪，訪問兩名中文大學舊生憶述中大衝突的經歷，但原審在判斷文章內容時，以「後見之明」、「上帝視角」宏觀檢視兩名受訪者當時沒有的材料，包括影片、警方聲明等，並不恰當。上訴人一方還指，文章內容是受訪者抒發他們的主觀感受，儘管某些陳述事後被認定與事實不符，但不會引致記者需要引述事實反證受訪者有錯。 律政司一方則強調，文章內容建基於一些錯誤陳述，即使是主觀感受也不可以超過法律界線，因為法律界線是任何發布文章都不應該具煽動意圖。律政司一方重申，言論和新聞自由並非絕對權利，界線是不可發布煽動文章或刊物，而上訴庭和終審法院亦早就煽動罪是否合憲有定論。 2026年9月3日，「612 人道支援基金」五名信託人及秘書於2022年被裁定「沒有在指明時限內申請註冊或豁免註冊社團罪」罪名成立，五名信託人（陳日君、吳靄儀、許寶強、何秀蘭及何韻詩）就定罪提出上訴被駁回。攝：林振東/端傳媒 「612 基金」五名信託人提定罪上訴，被駁回 「612 人道支援基金」五名信託人及秘書於2022年被裁定「沒有在指明時限內申請註冊或豁免註冊社團罪」罪名成立，五名信託人（陳日君、吳靄儀、許寶強、何秀蘭及何韻詩）就定罪提出上訴， 但於9月3日被上訴庭駁回 。 判詞指出，各上訴人為共同目的和宗旨而成立「612 基金」，基金按信託契約管理和運作，是在香港組織和成立的、是《社團條例》下所指的本地「社團」。上訴人一直有意使用基金作為籌募及運用公眾捐款的工具，以支援「反修例運動」，因此基金並不單純「只是一筆上訴人以信託形式持有的金錢」。各上訴人就運作基金給出指示，包括如何分發捐款，屬「社團幹事」。 就上訴方爭議相關定義和註冊制度不符法例規定要求，判詞指社團註冊制度以維護國家安全、公共安全或秩序為「合法目的」，條例定明必須獲律政司司長書面同意才可作出檢控，而律政司司長必定將公眾利益納入考慮，因此已提供「額外保障」。 上訴庭駁回上訴後，大律師吳靄儀對記者表示，她認為法庭對「社團」的定義過闊，案件與全港公民尤關，表明會向終審法院提上訴。 2026年10月12日，蔡天鳳疑遭殺害及碎屍一案，蔡天鳳母親張燕花出庭作供。攝：鄧家烜/端傳媒 蔡天鳳案：控方讀出開案陳詞，指金錢似乎是本案根源 蔡天鳳疑遭殺害及碎屍一案，蔡的前夫鄺港智、前家翁鄺球及前大伯鄺港傑否認謀殺罪，鄺港智和鄺港傑承認阻止合法埋葬屍體罪。9月30日，案件開審，控方向9人陪審團讀出 開案陳詞 。 控方對9人陪審團讀出開案陳詞，指金錢似乎是本案發生的根源，蔡天鳳與伴侶譚方駿極為富有，而且有美滿關係；蔡將購入的加多利山單位登記於鄺球名下，讓鄺球、其妻李瑞香及蔡與鄺港智的兩名女兒居於該單位。控方稱，鄺球為退休警長，鄺家原本不富有，鄺球想保留蔡帶給他的奢華生活，因此於2023年蔡打算出售加多利出單位時，鄺球憂慮自己將一無所有，遂開始思考如何殺害蔡，並且與兒子合作將蔡的屍體帶到大埔龍尾村一間村屋處理。 關於本案的疑似謀殺工具，控方指是一把木手柄槌子，由鄺港傑購買，由警方在龍尾村涉事村屋找到，化驗結果顯示上面有鄺港智的 DNA。控方預告稍後將傳召專家，專家意見指該槌子與蔡頭骨傷口的情況吻合，最終將交由陪審員決定蔡的頭骨致命傷是否由該把槌子造成。 控方續指，蔡被殺害後，屍體被放入膠箱，運送到龍尾村村屋；鄺港智更換染有血跡的衣服並離開龍尾村，鄺球和鄺港傑則繼續處理屍體。控方認為，三人烹煮屍體並非為了食用，而是為了讓屍體不被認出及掩蓋氣味。控方認為，是誰真正動手殺害蔡並不重要，因為三人都知道謀殺計劃，並且都參與其中。 控方讀出控辯雙方承認的事實，指在涉案村屋內檢獲兩個煮食煲，煲內有蔡的頭和其他血肉等；CCTV 片段顯示，鄺球於2023年2月2日至21日之間曾17次到訪涉案村屋，鄺港傑則有6次到訪，鄺港智僅於案發當日到訪。然而，辯方不承認與鄺港智 DNA 相關的證物鏈。 元朗區議員施駿興被裁定非法性交罪成立，10月底判刑 元朗區議員施駿興否認一項非禮罪及一項與16歲以下女童非法性交罪，經審訊後， 於9月14日被裁定非法性交罪成立、非禮罪脫罪 。法官拒絕辯方的保釋申請，下令被告還押至10月27日求情及判刑，其間索取事主 X 的創傷報告。 就非法性交罪，法官指出事主 X 因為對第一次性行為印象深刻，因此可以詳細供述性交過程，證供屬可以理解和合情理。相反，法官認為被告的證供不盡不實，辯方呈交的照片當中，元數據資料更可能曾被更改。 就非禮罪，法官稱信納 X 曾遭被告非禮，只是根據辯方呈上的照片，案發地點高山道公園的環境與控方舉證時間的環境不同，因此裁定控方未能成功舉證，裁定被告非禮罪脫罪。 法官分析證供時還提到，X 的確於事發後多年才報警，但其報案動機並非關鍵之處，假如可以證實事件曾經發生，則不論 X 是出於「因愛成恨」、政治原因等而報警，非禮及非法性交罪名仍會成立。 2026年4月19日，古天樂出席香港電影金像獎頒獎典禮。攝：林振東/端傳媒 離岸公司入稟，向天下一及古天樂追討欠款 宣稱是在英屬處女島註冊成立的離岸公司 Sino Hero Ventures Limited 於9月2日入稟高等法院， 指控天下一電影製作有限公司及藝人古天樂欠款七年，連本帶利追討逾1.49億港元 。 原告方在入稟狀稱，被告方於2019年9月6日與原告訂立定期貸款融資協議，原告同意向被告提供7000萬港元的定期信貸，按月收取1%利息，若拖欠則按月1.5%利率計算。原告稱，被告同意於2020年9月17日還款，但經延期後依然無法償還全部款項，僅支付了1320萬港元。 天下一於9月4日發表聲明，指原告提出的案情並不完整，特別是未有披露原告曾被剔除公司註冊並解散近三年，期間天下一一直無法聯繫到原告方的授權負責人。

# Police urge extra travel time as new Huanggang Port sees heavy traffic

Hong Kong police warned of severe congestion at the new Huanggang Port on Sunday evening, with travellers facing 25-minute waits to reach drop-off zones. Crowd and traffic control measures were deployed. Traffic returned to normal by early Monday morning.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 26 Oct 2026 at 02:58 HKT · updated 26 Oct, 04:25 · 1 min read

Share:

[](https://wa.me/?text=Police%20urge%20extra%20travel%20time%20as%20new%20Huanggang%20Port%20sees%20heavy%20traffic%20https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Police-urge-extra-travel-time-as-new-Huanggang-Port-sees-hea-4d67c5 "WhatsApp")[](https://t.me/share/url?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Police-urge-extra-travel-time-as-new-Huanggang-Port-sees-hea-4d67c5&text=Police%20urge%20extra%20travel%20time%20as%20new%20Huanggang%20Port%20sees%20heavy%20traffic "Telegram")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Police-urge-extra-travel-time-as-new-Huanggang-Port-sees-hea-4d67c5 "Facebook")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Police-urge-extra-travel-time-as-new-Huanggang-Port-sees-hea-4d67c5&text=Police%20urge%20extra%20travel%20time%20as%20new%20Huanggang%20Port%20sees%20heavy%20traffic "X")[](https://clb.org.hk/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection# "Email")

Police have urged travellers heading to the new [Huanggang Port](https://clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Huanggang-Port-congestion-prompts-calls-for-staffing-review-430465) to allow extra time, with traffic at the Hong Kong-side building very busy on Sunday night.

In a social media post, police said large numbers of travellers were using different modes of transport to reach the port, causing congestion on connecting roads, and that crowd and traffic control measures were in place.

Vehicles were waiting an average of about 25 minutes to reach the port's drop-off area, police said, urging travellers to be patient, follow instructions from officers and security staff, and allow sufficient time.

In an update around 1am, police said cross-boundary vehicle traffic at the new [Huanggang Port](https://clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Huanggang-Port-sets-record-152-000-trips-on-Chung-Yeung-Fest-7b4f6b) had returned to normal by 12.50am.

summary: 香港 澳大利亚医疗科技公司 SDIP Innovations 在香港贸易发展局的支持下，利用香港作为其骨再生产品 JAZBI 的区域基地。该公司计划拓展至中国大陆和其他亚洲市场。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 26 日 04:58 香港时间 · 2 分钟阅读澳大利亚医疗科技公司 SDIP Innovations 正利用香港作为拓展其专利骨再生的启动平台
content:
香港
在香港贸易发展局的支持下，澳大利亚医疗科技公司 SDIP Innovations 正在利用香港作为其骨再生产品 JAZBI 的区域基地。该公司计划拓展至中国大陆和其他亚洲市场。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 26 日 04:58 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

澳大利亚医疗科技公司 SDIP Innovations 在香港贸易发展局 (HKTDC) 的支持下，以香港为起点，在整个亚洲推广其专利骨再生技术 JAZBI。

SDIP Innovations 成立于 2018 年，致力于开发帮助身体修复受损骨骼的先进材料。其旗舰产品 JAZBI 可吸收骨空隙填充物，当放置在受损骨骼的间隙中时，可充当临时支架，并在被患者自身的健康骨骼取代时逐渐溶解。该技术为从患者身体其他部位采集骨骼的手术提供了一种替代方案，有可能使治疗的侵入性更小。

据该公司称，全世界每年有超过 2500 万人接受修复因受伤、手术或疾病而受损或丢失的骨骼的手术，其中中国约有 250 万人。
SDIP Innovations Hong Kong 总经理 Stephanie Nemec 表示：“JAZBI 帮助身体自然修复受损的骨骼。” “我们的目标是将创新的再生技术带给更多患者并改善治疗结果。”

经过公司创始人在澳大利亚十多年的研究，JAZBI 在今年早些时候获得了美国食品和药物管理局的许可，为更广泛的商业化铺平了道路。

SDIP Innovations 的香港之旅始于 2025 年中，当时香港贸发局悉尼办事处邀请这家医疗科技公司参加亚洲全球健康峰会。此次会议将公司与主要参与者联系起来，并介绍了港深创新及科技园及其 IGNITE 孵化计划。该公司于 2025 年 12 月在香港成立了实体，随后被选为该计划的第一批成员。

从那时起，该公司与当地医院的临床医生和研究人员建立了关系，以验证其技术并探索更广泛的采用。展望未来，SDIP Innovations计划深化与医疗机构的合作，同时准备进军内地市场。 Nemec 表示：“我们将香港视为我们的战略区域总部，这是建立临床、商业和制造合作伙伴关系的门户，这将使我们能够在全球最大、增长最快的医疗保健市场之一进行扩张。”
[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
Australian medtech company SDIP Innovations is leveraging Hong Kong as a regional base for its bone-regeneration product JAZBI, with support from the Hong Kong Trade Development Council. The company plans to expand into mainland China and other Asian markets.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

26 Oct 2026 at 04:58 HKT · 2 min read

Australian medtech company SDIP Innovations is using Hong Kong as a launchpad to expand its patented bone-regeneration technology, JAZBI, across Asia, with support from the Hong Kong Trade Development Council (HKTDC).

Founded in 2018, SDIP Innovations develops advanced materials that help the body repair damaged bone. Its flagship product, JAZBI Resorbable Bone Void Filler, acts as a temporary scaffold when placed into gaps in damaged bone, gradually dissolving as it is replaced by the patient’s own healthy bone. The technology offers an alternative to procedures that involve harvesting bone from elsewhere in the patient’s body, potentially making treatment less invasive.

Every year, more than 25 million people worldwide undergo procedures to repair bones damaged or lost through injury, surgery, or disease, including around 2.5 million in China, according to the company.

“JAZBI helps the body repair damaged bone naturally,” said Stephanie Nemec, general manager of SDIP Innovations Hong Kong. “Our goal is to bring innovative regenerative technologies to more patients and improve treatment outcomes.”

Following more than a decade of research by the company’s founders in Australia, JAZBI received US Food and Drug Administration clearance earlier this year, paving the way for wider commercialization.

SDIP Innovations’ Hong Kong journey began in mid-2025, when the HKTDC’s Sydney office invited the medtech firm to join the Asia Summit on Global Health. The conference connected the company with key players and led to an introduction to the Hong Kong-Shenzhen Innovation and Technology Park and its IGNITE incubation program. The company established a Hong Kong entity in December 2025 and was subsequently selected for the program’s first cohort.

Since then, the company has built relationships with clinicians and researchers at local hospitals to validate its technology and explore wider adoption. Looking ahead, SDIP Innovations plans to deepen its partnerships with healthcare institutions while preparing to enter the mainland market. “We see Hong Kong as our strategic regional headquarters – a gateway for building clinical, commercial, and manufacturing partnerships that will enable us to scale across one of the world’s largest and fastest-growing healthcare markets,” Nemec said.

title: Interpol to push asset tracing at Hong Kong general assembly
zh_title: 国际刑警组织将在香港大会上推动资产追查
summary: 国际刑警组织秘书长瓦尔德西·乌尔基扎 (Valdecy Urquiza) 表示，国际刑警组织第 94 届大会将于 11 月 30 日至 12 月 3 日在香港举行，重点讨论追踪犯罪资产、人工智能相关犯罪和国际警务合作。 [![图片 1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 26 日 06:00 香港时间 · 3 分钟阅读国际刑警组织寻求加强追踪和扣押犯罪资产方面的国际合作，第 94 届会议将讨论一项新能力
content:
香港
国际刑警组织秘书长瓦尔德西·乌尔基扎 (Valdecy Urquiza) 表示，国际刑警组织第 94 届大会将于 11 月 30 日至 12 月 3 日在香港举行，重点讨论追查犯罪资产、人工智能相关犯罪和国际警务合作。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 26 日 06:00 香港时间 · 阅读时间 3 分钟

国际刑警组织秘书长瓦尔德西·乌尔基扎表示，国际刑警组织正在寻求加强追查和扣押犯罪资产方面的国际合作，并将在香港举行的第 94 届大会上讨论新的能力。

大会将于 11 月 30 日至 12 月 3 日在香港举行，来自 196 个成员国的 2,000 多名代表将齐聚一堂，讨论执法重点、全球挑战和国际刑警组织的未来战略。

乌尔奎扎表示：“香港是金融、贸易和数字服务的中心，也是我们将国际执法界聚集在一起的完美地点。”他形容香港是一个积极而忠诚的合作伙伴，并指出从当地警察部队借调到国际刑警组织的警官贡献了专业知识，特别是在金融犯罪调查方面。
香港警务处处长周一鸣表示，大会的筹备工作已于2025年初开始，由政务司司长担任主席的香港特别行政区督导委员会、保安局局长领导的跨部门专责小组以及警务处处长领导的警队工作小组组成三层协调架构。他表示，香港致力于确保会议安全可靠，并利用这次活动加强与海外执法机构的伙伴关系，同时展示香港的安全和举办重大国际活动的能力。

乌尔基扎引用了国际刑警组织的银色通缉令倡议作为该组织希望在大会上推进的新能力的一个例子。该计划的重点是帮助执法机构调查和追踪犯罪组织隐藏在不同司法管辖区的金融资产。国际刑警组织已对该倡议进行了为期两年的试点，并希望成员国予以支持。周还强调了金融调查和预防欺诈的重要性，称诈骗占该市 9 月份报告的犯罪案件的一半左右。他指出国际合作打击金融犯罪的重要性，并指出香港已建立反诈骗平台FRONTIER+，帮助海外合作伙伴追查资金并拦截可疑交易。
与人工智能相关的犯罪是今年大会议程上的另一个问题。乌尔奎扎表示，人工智能使犯罪环境变得更加复杂，使犯罪组织能够到达他们以前无法进入的地区，并以其他犯罪领域未曾见过的规模开展活动。他表示，国际刑警组织正在通过三个领域解决与人工智能相关的犯罪问题：了解犯罪集团如何使用人工智能、帮助执法机构利用人工智能提高调查效率和分析大量数据、以及促进警察负责任地使用人工智能。

乌尔基扎表示，国际刑警组织作为一个技术平台的作用是让其 196 个成员国的警察机构保持联系，并在政治分歧的情况下实现合作。周说香港h

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
Interpol's 94th General Assembly in Hong Kong from 30 November to 3 December will focus on tracing criminal assets, AI-related crime and international police cooperation, Secretary-General Valdecy Urquiza said.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

26 Oct 2026 at 06:00 HKT · 3 min read

INTERPOL is seeking to strengthen international cooperation in tracing and seizing criminal assets, with a new capability set to be discussed at its 94th General Assembly in Hong Kong, Secretary-General Valdecy Urquiza said.

The General Assembly will take place from 30 November to 3 December in Hong Kong, bringing more than 2,000 representatives from its 196 member countries to discuss law enforcement priorities, global challenges and INTERPOL's future strategy.

“Hong Kong is a hub for finance, trade, digital services, and is the perfect location for us to bring the international law enforcement community together,” Urquiza said. He described Hong Kong as an active and committed partner, noting that officers seconded from the local police force to INTERPOL had contributed expertise, particularly in financial crime investigations.

Hong Kong Police Commissioner Joe Chow Yat-ming said preparations for the assembly had begun in early 2025, with a three-tier coordination structure comprising the HKSAR Steering Committee chaired by the Chief Secretary for Administration, an Inter-departmental Task Force led by the Secretary for Security, and the Force Working Group headed by the Commissioner of Police. He said the city is committed to ensuring a safe and secure conference and to use the event to strengthen partnerships with overseas law enforcement agencies while showcasing Hong Kong's security and ability to host major international events.

Urquiza cited INTERPOL's Silver Notice initiative as an example of the new capabilities the organisation hopes to advance at the General Assembly. The initiative focuses on helping law enforcement agencies investigate and trace financial assets that criminal organisations hide in different jurisdictions. INTERPOL has conducted a two-year pilot of the initiative and hopes member countries will endorse it. Chow also highlighted the importance of financial investigations and fraud prevention, saying scams accounted for about half of reported crime cases in the city in September. He pointed to the importance of international cooperation in tackling financial crime, noting Hong Kong had established the anti-scam platform FRONTIER+ to help overseas partners trace funds and intercept suspicious transactions.

Artificial-intelligence-related crime is another issue on this year's General Assembly agenda. Urquiza said AI had made the criminal landscape more complex, enabling criminal organisations to reach regions they had previously been unable to access and operate on a scale not seen in other areas of crime. INTERPOL is addressing AI-related crime through three areas: understanding how criminal groups use AI, helping law enforcement agencies use AI to improve investigative efficiency and analyse large amounts of data, and promoting the responsible use of AI by police, he said.

Urquiza said INTERPOL's role as a technical platform was to keep police agencies across its 196 member countries connected and enable cooperation despite political differences. Chow said Hong Kong hoped to strengthen operational and intelligence-sharing ties with Asian counterparts while expanding training and capacity-building cooperation with other regions, including Africa. The force also hoped to provide training for overseas officers and send its own personnel to learn from international partners, he added. Chow said the Hong Kong International Academy of Policing will also be established on 11 November, with the aim of bringing international policing experience to Hong Kong and sharing local expertise with overseas partners.

title: Hong Kong tourism plan aims to boost spending, extend stays
zh_title: 香港旅游计划旨在增加消费、延长停留时间
summary: 香港文化体育及旅游局局长罗淑娜制定了一项五年计划，到2030年将旅游业的年增加值从862亿港元提高到1,260亿港元，利用文化活动、当地社区和多元化景点，将游客人数转化为经济收益。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 26 日香港时间 06:02 · 2 分钟阅读秘书文化、体育及旅游 罗淑佩认为香港
content:
香港
文化体育及旅游局局长罗姗娜制定了一项五年计划，到2030年将旅游业的年度增加值从862亿港元提高到1,260亿港元，利用文化活动、当地社区和多元化景点，将游客人数转化为经济收益。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 26 日 06:02 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

文化体育及旅游局局长罗淑佩认为，香港的鲜明对比——商务会议、乡村远足和节日——可以说服游客停留更长时间、花更多钱并返回。随着香港推出第一个五年旅游计划，罗正押注于文化活动和当地社区，以将游客人数转化为经济收益。

罗说，2026年前9个月，香港接待了4070万人次游客，其中国庆黄金周期间有141万人次内地游客。政府的目标是到2030年将旅游业的年度增加值从2024年的862亿港元提高到1,260亿港元，并希望来自中国大陆以外的游客占过夜游客的40%。
为了传播好处，罗引用了旅游局发起的“品味香港”活动，该活动推荐了所有 18 个地区的餐馆，从茶餐厅到街头小吃摊。另一项名为“Hong Kong Good Take”的活动将绘制约 100 个电影拍摄地的地图，将影迷带入不同的社区。罗说，大约五分之一的中国境外游客会继续前往大陆，但她坚称这座城市不仅仅是一个中途停留地。

香港全年都有国际艺术、中国文化节目和大型节庆活动，为您提供了不同的回归理由。罗说，中秋国际灯会吸引了约73万人次参观，而圣诞节庆祝活动和新年倒计时之后，林村许愿树和黄大仙祠将举行农历新年传统活动。她说，其目的是通过独特的、限时的体验来产生“FOMO”（害怕错过的恐惧）。

根据拟议的资金改革，主要表演艺术团体将根据其过去的出席率进行评估，而不是根据其他学科进行评估。艺术素质以及在海外或内地演出的机会也很重要。在电影方面，罗希望巩固支持计划并吸引私人投资，认为香港电影必须与电影观众重新建立联系。在体育方面，启德体育公园定期举行的国际比赛可以鼓励围绕体育赛事的旅行，而新的培训计划将帮助退休运动员追求体育管理的职业生涯。
罗透露，她把拳击作为一种爱好，定期参加课程，并称自己是一名喜欢传统中餐馆和老式面包店的美食家。她徒步旅行，回忆起穿越大屿山的六个小时的长途跋涉，并希望尝试去离岛露营或豪华露营——这是她希望实现的儿时愿望。

[![图片3：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law outlined a five-year plan to raise tourism's annual value added from HK$86.2 billion to HK$126 billion by 2030, leveraging cultural events, local neighborhoods and diversified attractions to turn visitor arrivals into economic gains.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

26 Oct 2026 at 06:02 HKT · 2 min read

Secretary for Culture, Sports and Tourism Rosanna Law Shuk-pui believes Hong Kong's contrasts – business meetings, countryside hikes and festivals – can persuade travellers to stay longer, spend more and return. As Hong Kong launches its first five-year tourism plan, Law is betting on cultural events and local neighbourhoods to turn visitor arrivals into economic gains.

Hong Kong welcomed 40.7 million visitors in the first nine months of 2026, including 1.41 million mainland travellers during National Day Golden Week, Law said. The government aims to raise tourism's annual value added from HK$86.2 billion in 2024 to HK$126 billion by 2030, and wants visitors from outside mainland China to account for 40 per cent of overnight tourists.

To spread benefits, Law cited Taste Hong Kong, a Tourism Board campaign recommending eateries across all 18 districts, from cha chaan teng to street-food stalls. Another campaign, Hong Kong Good Take, will map about 100 film locations, bringing fans into different neighbourhoods. About one in five visitors from outside China travels onward to the mainland, Law said, but she insisted the city is more than a stopover.

Hong Kong's year-round calendar of international arts, Chinese cultural programmes and festive mega events offers different reasons to return. The Mid-Autumn International Lantern Spectacular drew about 730,000 visits, Law said, while Christmas celebrations and the New Year countdown are followed by Lunar New Year traditions at the Lam Tsuen wishing tree and Wong Tai Sin Temple. The aim, she said, is to generate FOMO – fear of missing out – through unique, time-limited experiences.

Under proposed funding reforms, major performing arts groups would be assessed on their own past attendance, not against other disciplines. Artistic quality and opportunities to perform overseas or on the mainland would also count. In film, Law wants to consolidate support schemes and attract private investment, arguing that Hong Kong cinema must reconnect with moviegoers. In sports, regular international tournaments at Kai Tak Sports Park could encourage trips around sporting events, while a new training scheme would help retired athletes pursue careers in sports management.

Law revealed she has taken up boxing as a hobby, attends regular classes, and describes herself as a foodie who enjoys traditional Chinese restaurants and old-fashioned bakeries. She hikes, recalling a six-hour trek across Lantau, and hopes to try camping or glamping on an outlying island – a childhood wish she hopes to fulfil.

title: PolyU targets 50:50 overseas-mainland student split, new hostels
zh_title: 理大目标海外与内地学生比例为50:50并新建宿舍
summary: 香港理工大学校长滕锦光表示，香港理工大学的目标是将海外学生与中国内地学生的比例从40:60提高到50:50。该计划要求到2028年在九龙塘和稍后在何文田建立新的学生宿舍，并在北都大学城建立第二个校区。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 26 日 06:05 HKT · 2 分钟阅读 香港理工大学 (PolyU) 的目标是 50:50 的比例
content:
香港
香港理工大学校长滕锦光表示，香港理工大学的目标是将海外学生与中国内地学生的比例从40:60提高到50:50。该计划要求到2028年在九龙塘和稍后在何文田建立新的学生宿舍，并在北都大学城建立第二个校区。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 26 日 06:05 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

香港理工大学（理大）校长滕锦光表示，为了促进国际化，香港理工大学（PolyU）的目标是海外学生和中国内地学生的比例从目前的 40:60 提高到 50:50。理大在 2027 年 QS 世界大学排名中首次跻身前 50 名。

滕说，理大今年招收了约1,000名非本地学生，其中约600名来自中国大陆，400名来自其他国家。该目标与上个月发布的香港第一个五年计划一致，该计划的目标是到2029-30年让10万名非本地学生参加全日制专上课程，高于2024-25年的约8万名。
宿舍空间有限是一个主要障碍。理大拥有约4,000个宿舍名额，并保证所有非本地本科生可入住一年。 “由于这种安排，我们无法招收更多的非本地学生来攻读本科课程，”滕解释道。九龙塘的一间新学生宿舍预计将于 2028 年开业，稍后又在何文田开设另一间学生宿舍，以缓解瓶颈。

由于空间限制，大学纷纷迁往北方都市大学城 (NMUT)，该城占地 1,000 多公顷，横跨三个校区。滕说：“鉴于理大目前的空间限制，我们计划建设第二个校区，并将积极支持和参与NMUT。”但他没有透露更多细节。洪水桥校园的三个用地已于上个月开始申请。

滕说，奖学金仍然是从欠发达经济体（尤其是东南亚）招收“顶尖学生”的关键，并指出来自新加坡和中国大陆大学的竞争。他认为，香港留住人才的能力取决于职业前景：“这实际上取决于我们为他们提供的机会……而主要驱动力是创新和科技行业的发展。”他引用了中国移动于2024年在香港成立的研究部门，该部门招募了包括理大在内的本地毕业生。
理大正在追求以需求为导向、以问题为导向、跨学科研究和产学合作的“第四代大学”模式。最近的合作伙伴包括与天津大学的未来技术研究所以及与哈尔滨工业大学的国际设计学院，两者均位于深圳。理大在香港校园成立了理大跨学科研究学院（2022年）、理大人工智能学院（2025年）和理大航空航天研究院（2026年7月）。计划建立第四个卫生技术学院。

Hong Kong
Hong Kong Polytechnic University aims to raise its ratio of overseas to mainland Chinese students from 40:60 to 50:50, President Teng Jin-guang said. The plan requires new student hostels in Kowloon Tong by 2028 and Ho Man Tin later, plus a second campus in the Northern Metropolis University Town.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

26 Oct 2026 at 06:05 HKT · 2 min read

Hong Kong Polytechnic University (PolyU) is targeting a 50:50 split between overseas and mainland Chinese students, up from the current 40:60 ratio, to boost internationalisation, President Teng Jin-guang said. The goal follows PolyU's debut in the top 50 of the QS World University Rankings 2027.

Teng said PolyU enrolled about 1,000 non-local students this year, roughly 600 from mainland China and 400 from other countries. The target aligns with Hong Kong's first Five-Year Plan, published last month, which aims for 100,000 non-local students in full-time postsecondary programmes by 2029-30, up from about 80,000 in 2024-25.

Limited hostel space is a key obstacle. PolyU has about 4,000 hostel places and guarantees one-year residence for all non-local undergraduates. 'Because of this arrangement, we cannot have many more non-local students for the undergraduate programs,' Teng explained. A new student hostel in Kowloon Tong is expected to open in 2028, with another in Ho Man Tin later, easing the bottleneck.

Space constraints have pushed universities toward the Northern Metropolis University Town (NMUT), spanning over 1,000 hectares across three campuses. 'In view of PolyU's current space constraints, we plan to build a second campus and will actively support and participate in the NMUT,' Teng said, without disclosing further details. Applications for three sites in the Hung Shui Kiu campus opened last month.

Scholarships remain key for recruiting 'top-quality students' from less advanced economies, particularly Southeast Asia, Teng said, noting competition from Singaporean and mainland Chinese universities. Hong Kong's ability to retain talent depends on career prospects, he argued: 'It really depends on the opportunities we offer them … and the main driver is for the innovation and technology industry to be grown.' He cited China Mobile's research arm, established in Hong Kong in 2024, which has recruited local graduates including from PolyU.

PolyU is pursuing a 'fourth-generation university' model defined by demand-driven, problem-oriented, interdisciplinary research and academia-industry collaboration. Recent partnerships include the Institute of Future Technologies with Tianjin University and the International School of Design with Harbin Institute of Technology, both in Shenzhen. On its Hong Kong campus, PolyU has launched the PolyU Academy for Interdisciplinary Research (2022), the PolyU Academy for Artificial Intelligence (2025), and the PolyU Aerospace Research Academy (July 2026). A fourth academy on health technology is planned.

# 美國：已協助波灣國家經荷莫茲海峽出口15億桶原油

2026/10/26 04:46（10/26 07:27 更新）

[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[](javascript:)[![Image 21](https://imgcdn.cna.com.tw/www/website/img/support.svg)](https://cna.com.tw/donate/)

請同意我們的隱私權規範，才能啟用聽新聞的功能。

荷莫茲海峽地理位置圖。（中央社製圖）

（中央社利雅德25日綜合外電報導）美軍中央司令部今天表示，自從夏季以來，已經協助波斯灣國家經由荷莫茲海峽出口15億桶原油，成功突破伊朗封鎖。

法新社報導，美軍中央司令部（US Central Command）在社群平台X上發布聲明表示：「美軍協助波斯灣盟國自從夏季以來出口超過15億桶原油，達成重要里程碑。」

聲明指出，過去6個月在中央司令部部隊支援下，已經有超過3000艘商船順利通過荷莫茲海峽（Strait of Hormuz），強調「超過95%的船隻航行荷莫茲海峽時安全通過」。

正在荷莫茲海峽視察美軍的中央司令部司令古柏（Brad Cooper）表示：「多虧我方人員的傑出努力，今天荷姆茲海峽主要航運通道依然安全無阻，未受伊朗水雷威脅。」

自從2月28日美國和以色列對伊朗發動攻擊、中東戰事爆發以來，伊朗已經對此一關鍵水道實施控制，要求通過海峽的船隻獲得相關許可。

美國國務卿盧比歐（Marco Rubio）本月曾表示，伊朗已經「完全喪失對荷莫茲海峽的控制」，宣稱德黑蘭的經濟陷入「徹底而全面的自由落體式崩潰」之中。

他說：「荷莫茲海峽是開放的，現在流出的原油幾乎和衝突開始之前一樣多。因此他們已經完全喪失對海峽的控制。」

根據海事追蹤公司Kpler數據，原油出口量於9月已經恢復至戰爭爆發前水準，不包括伊朗，當月至少有1650萬桶原油從該地區出口。（編譯：[何宏儒](https://cna.com.tw/author/0128/)）1151026

title: Will China’s 4 peace principles for tackling African conflicts work?
zh_title: 中国解决非洲冲突的4项和平原则行得通吗？
summary: 中国国家主席习近平本月在会见来访的多哥领导人福雷·纳辛贝时，概述了北京解决非洲冲突和热点问题的方案，并围绕和平与发展的四项原则进行了阐述。这些原则侧重于由非洲主导、不受外部干预的安全；维护主权和《联合国宪章》原则；拒绝武力和制裁并支持通过对话实现停火；既着眼安全，又着眼长远发展。上周被问及这些原则是否适用于埃塞俄比亚北部
content:
中国国家主席习近平本月在会见来访的多哥领导人福雷·纳辛贝时，概述了北京解决非洲冲突和热点问题的方案，并围绕和平与发展的四项原则进行了阐述。

这些原则侧重于由非洲主导、不受外部干预的安全；维护主权和《联合国宪章》原则；拒绝武力和制裁并支持通过对话实现停火；既着眼安全，又着眼长远发展。

上周被问及这些原则是否适用于埃塞俄比亚北部以及与邻国厄立特里亚紧张局势加剧时，中国外交部发言人毛宁表示，这些原则为非洲之角提供了“实用指导”。

几天后，中国外交部长[王毅](https://www.scmp.com/topics/wang-yi?module=inline&pgtype=article)与吉布提外长阿卜杜勒卡德尔·侯赛因·奥马尔会晤后发表联合声明，表示中国将[继续发挥建设性作用]作用](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3371811/china-urges-opening-bab-al-mandeb-first-joint-statement-regional-nation?module=inline&pgtype=article)通过现有的非洲之角和平与发展倡议调解地区争端，但须遵守有关国家的意愿。
北京根据其以中国为中心的贸易和投资计划“一带一路”(https://www.scmp.com/topics/belt-and-road-initiative?module=inline&pgtype=article)为该地区的重大基础设施项目提供了资金。其中包括亚的斯亚贝巴-吉布提标准轨距铁路，以及苏丹、南苏丹、索马里和吉布提的石油、渔业和海洋利益。

亚的斯亚贝巴至吉布提标准轨距铁路于2018年投入商业运营，主要由中国进出口银行在“一带一路”倡议下提供融资。照片：黄菲利克斯

然而，北京仍然不愿直接干预，而是选择支持非洲主导的外交，以维护其长期以来的国家不干涉原则。

由于埃塞俄比亚提格雷地区的冲突威胁到非洲之角的稳定，中国寻求实现微妙的外交平衡，倡导由非洲主导、符合习近平解决冲突原则的和平解决方案。

其想法是保护中国数十亿美元的区域基础设施和经济投资，同时谨慎地维持其不干涉的核心外交政策承诺。

但专家表示，持久和平最终将取决于地区行为体解决内部派系斗争、尊重国家主权以及在更广泛的国际和平努力的同时促进包容性对话。
华盛顿智库史汀生中心高级研究员兼中国项目主任孙云表示，北京的反应反映出人们对其在非洲之角的利益可能意味着新的战斗可能意味着什么的担忧。

“我认为这首先表明了中国对不稳定的担忧和厌恶，”孙说。 “战争和冲突从根本上损害了中国的实地利益。”

她补充说，中国还面临外交限制，并称中国试图影响冲突的解决方式，但又不放弃其不干涉他国事务的既定原则。

Rather than lead a peace process itself, Beijing tends to support approaches led by countries in the region and their regional orga

【原文 English Original】
Chinese President Xi Jinping outlined Beijing’s formula for tackling African conflicts and hot-button issues during a meeting this month with visiting Togolese leader Faure Gnassingbe, framing it around four principles linking peace to development.

The principles focus on African-led security free from outside intervention; upholding sovereignty and UN Charter principles; rejecting force and sanctions and favouring ceasefires through dialogue; and focusing on both immediate security concerns and long-term development.

Asked last week whether the principles could be applied to northern Ethiopia and the heightened tensions with neighbouring Eritrea, Chinese foreign ministry spokeswoman Mao Ning said they offered “practical guidance” for the Horn of Africa.

Days later, a joint statement following a meeting between Chinese Foreign Minister [Wang Yi](https://www.scmp.com/topics/wang-yi?module=inline&pgtype=article) and his Djiboutian counterpart, Abdoulkader Houssein Omar, said China would [continue to play a constructive role](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3371811/china-urges-opening-bab-al-mandeb-first-joint-statement-regional-nation?module=inline&pgtype=article) in mediating regional disputes through its existing Horn of Africa peace and development initiative, subject to the wishes of the countries concerned.

Beijing has financed major infrastructure projects in the region under the [Belt and Road Initiative](https://www.scmp.com/topics/belt-and-road-initiative?module=inline&pgtype=article), its China-centred trade and investment scheme. These include the Addis Ababa–Djibouti Standard Gauge Railway, as well as oil, fishing and maritime interests across Sudan, South Sudan, Somalia and Djibouti.

The Addis Ababa-Djibouti Standard Gauge Railway, inaugurated for commercial operation in 2018, was largely financed by the Export-Import Bank of China under the Belt and Road Initiative. Photo: Felix Wong

Yet, Beijing remains reluctant to intervene directly, opting instead to support African-led diplomacy to preserve its long-standing doctrine of state non-interference.

As conflict in Ethiopia’s Tigray region threatens to destabilise the Horn of Africa, China seeks to strike a delicate diplomatic balance, advocating for peaceful, African-led solutions that align with Xi’s conflict-resolution principles.

The idea is to safeguard China’s billions in regional infrastructure and economic investments while carefully maintaining its core foreign policy pledge of non-interference.

But experts said lasting peace would ultimately depend on regional actors addressing internal factionalism, respecting state sovereignty and fostering inclusive dialogue alongside broader international peace efforts.

Yun Sun, a senior fellow and director of the China programme at the Stimson Centre, a Washington-based think tank, said Beijing’s response reflected concern about what renewed fighting could mean for its interests in the Horn of Africa.

“I think it first and foremost points out China’s concern and aversion to instability,” Sun said. “War and conflicts fundamentally undermine China’s interests on the ground.”

China also faced a diplomatic constraint, she added, saying it sought to influence how conflicts were resolved without abandoning its stated principle of non-interference in other countries’ affairs.

Rather than lead a peace process itself, Beijing tends to support approaches led by countries in the region and their regional organisations.

“The balance they strike is through siding [with] and supporting [a] regional approach and the involvement of regional organisations,” Sun said. “That confers legitimacy and credibility to the Chinese approach.”

Ethiopian federal forces and fighters from the Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF) are battling again in northern Ethiopia, putting a 2022 Pretoria Peace Agreement under severe strain.

The wreckage of a charred truck sits abandoned following fighting between Ethiopian federal forces and TPLF fighters in Tigray, Ethiopia, on October 15. Photo: Reuters

Ethiopian federal forces entered Mekelle, Tigray’s capital, in early October after advancing on the city and prompting TPLF fighters to withdraw.

Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed’s government has announced a six-month caretaker administration in the Tigray region to restore services, return displaced people and prepare for elections.

The conflict has also escalated Ethiopia-Eritrea tensions, with Addis Ababa accusing Asmara of backing the TPLF and occupying its territory.

Eritrea rejects the claims and accuses Addis Ababa of threatening its territorial integrity to secure Red Sea access, which landlocked Ethiopia desperately seeks to reduce its dependence on Djiboutian ports.

According to Seifudein Adem, a visiting professor at Doshisha University in Kyoto, Ethiopia must address its internal divisions if it is to resist outside intervention.

“President Xi Jinping is correct to suggest that Ethiopia should put its house in order by resolving internal disagreements through dialogue because disorder is the ultimate justification for external intervention in Africa,” he said.

Adem argued that the obstacle was not an inability to resolve disagreements peacefully.

“Rather, these disagreements often take the form of militarised factionalism,” he said. “This, in turn, is because the Ethiopian state does not enjoy a monopoly over the means of violence in the society.”

“The problem is that some of these neighbouring countries seem to view their interference as a kind of African solution to African disorder, consistent with an ‘African-led’ solution,” Adem added.

Xi’s emphasis on sovereignty shifted the focus from Africa as a whole to the rights of individual states, he said.

16:09

How China is reshaping its economic ties with Africa

According to Costantinos Berhutesfa Costantinos, a public policy expert at Addis Ababa University and former United Nations policy adviser, China has a clear stake in containing the conflict but must use its influence carefully.

“China is a friend and major trade partner and investor in the Horn,” Costantinos said, citing Beijing-backed roads, power-generation and transmission projects, and industrial estates in Ethiopia.

Those investments could not deliver their intended economic benefits without peace, he added.

Costantinos said China’s diplomatic initiative, together with its influence through the Forum on China-Africa Cooperation, had raised expectations that Beijing would engage with countries in the region to help resolve their long-standing conflicts.

China appointed [Xue Bing](https://www.scmp.com/news/china/diplomacy/article/3167984/china-appoints-new-special-envoy-turbulent-horn-africa-region?module=inline&pgtype=article) as its first special envoy for the Horn of Africa in 2022 and convened a conference on peace, governance and development in Addis Ababa that year.

Hu Changchun, who succeeded Xue last year, has continued to promote Beijing’s regional initiative.

Costantinos said governments in the Horn of Africa should put Xi’s principles into practice through diplomacy to reduce tensions, protect trade routes and secure local ceasefires.

“No conflict can be considered resolved if any group whose interests are affected has been left out of the negotiation or mediation,” he added, noting that the parties would not enter talks with equal influence.

China should work alongside existing peace efforts, Costantinos said.

“China will only add to the praiseworthy efforts by the [African Union], UN, US and [European Union],” he said.

“Its initiative will in no way gainsay the work of these venerable institutions and countries.”

title: 台风蔷琵侵袭台湾，导致全台1死616伤
summary: 今年太平洋地区最强风暴之一的台风“蔷琵”(Champi)星期六(10月24日)侵袭台湾，造成1人死亡、616人受伤。台风同时还导致树木倒塌、广告牌掉落和电力中断。 台风侵袭台湾之后，强度持续减弱，并继续向北朝中国大陆沿海方向移动，但估计可能不会在中国沿海登陆。 台湾中央气象署(CWA)报告说，蔷琵台风是今年太平洋地区最强烈的风暴之一，而且一度曾发展成为“超级台风”，但目前台风强度大幅减弱，中心附近风力约为126公里/小时。 中央气象署指出，台风于星期五午夜时分抵达台湾，紧贴台
content:
今年太平洋地区最强风暴之一的台风“蔷琵”(Champi)星期六(10月24日)侵袭台湾，造成1人死亡、616人受伤。台风同时还导致树木倒塌、广告牌掉落和电力中断。

台风侵袭台湾之后，强度持续减弱，并继续向北朝中国大陆沿海方向移动，但估计可能不会在中国沿海登陆。

台湾中央气象署(CWA)报告说，蔷琵台风是今年太平洋地区最强烈的风暴之一，而且一度曾发展成为“超级台风”，但目前台风强度大幅减弱，中心附近风力约为126公里/小时。

中央气象署指出，台风于星期五午夜时分抵达台湾，紧贴台湾的宜兰海岸线移动，风暴中心则转向南侧。蔷琵台风随即在台湾近海处出现罕见的“打转”现象，不过后来转向北面离开台湾海域。

台风侵袭台湾时，台湾部分沿海地区的阵风风速高达227公里/小时，导致部分输电线路倒塌，一些建筑物的屋顶瓦片被掀飞。

中央气象署说，星期六下午台风蔷琵已经移动至台湾东北部约170公里处。

“午夜时分最可怕，”路透社援引一位林姓退休教师的话说。这位教师台风过后正在宜兰的自家院子里查看倒塌的香蕉树。

“那是一个彻夜难眠的夜晚。我已经很多年没见过这样的景象了，”这位退休教师说。

中央气象署星期六下午解除了台风陆上警报，随后也会解除海上警报。

台湾中央灾害应变中心为应对灾情和安排善后，于星期六下午5点，在内政部长刘世芳的主持下召开第9次工作会报。

根据该中心的统计，截至星期六下午4时30分，此次台风造成台湾1人死亡。不幸遇难者是一位男子，他在屏东县琉球乡的沙滩上被海浪卷走。台风还造成616人受伤，不过大多数都是擦挫伤之类的轻伤。目前伤者中已有486人出院。

与风灾相关的案子共有9027件，正在处理中的有3146件，主要以树木倒塌、电线掉落和广告牌损毁为主。

灾害应变中心表示，台湾一共有34万户在台风期间停电，至星期六下午仍有2.2万户等待修复通电。目前仍存在停电问题的地区包括新北市、宜兰县、桃园市、台中市、云林县、台北市、嘉义县、基隆市、彰化县、新竹县、苗栗县、台南市、屏东县、南投县、花莲县。但是所有这些地区预计会在当晚11时之前修复通电。

此外，台湾在台风蔷琵肆虐期间还发布过泥石流和大规模崩塌黄色警戒，另共计疏散撤离了4960人。

台湾交通部门通报说，受台风影响，台湾星期六一共有259个航班被取消。不过与星期五将近1000个航班被取消的状况相比，情况正在迅速好转。

台湾经常遭遇台风袭击，不过大多数台风常见于夏季，秋季偶尔也会有台风来袭。

因为台风袭扰，台湾星期六继续停工停课。

尽管台湾中央气象署并不预期台风蔷琵会在中国大陆登陆，但是与台湾隔海相望的华东沿海地区早已严阵以待。

根据路透社的报道，中国应急管理部向东部的浙江省派出工作组，并发出预警，提醒当地在周日之前防范强风和大雨。据介绍，有关部门已集结400名救援人员和600台(套)救援装备，另有超过4.1万名消防救援人员处于应急值守状态。

据中国官方媒体报道，在浙江沿海城市台州，已有超过3800艘渔船回港避风，海上养殖人员被转移上岸，2084名海岛游客也被撤离。

此外，相关部门还叫停了25个海上施工作业项目，并暂停了18条客运航线。

title: Bearing Witness to the Faith: China’s Underground Catholics and the Cost of Fidelity
summary: On 15 October, Father Ignatius Ding Zuyao, of the state-administered [Chinese Catholic Patriotic Association](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Catholic_Patriotic_Association) (CCPA), was consecrated Bishop of Haimen in eastern China following
content:
On 15 October, Father Ignatius Ding Zuyao, of the state-administered [Chinese Catholic Patriotic Association](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Catholic_Patriotic_Association) (CCPA), was consecrated Bishop of Haimen in eastern China following his appointment by Pope Leo XIV on 24 August under the [provisional agreement](https://www.reuters.com/article/us-pope-china/vatican-china-sign-landmark-accord-on-appointing-bishops-idUSKCN1M20H7) signed by the Vatican and the People’s Republic of China in 2018. The agreement’s contents remain undisclosed. The episcopal consecration highlights the continuing debate over the accord, which, as far as can be ascertained, was intended to resolve disputes over episcopal appointments and promote unity among Chinese Catholics. Yet questions remain about its implications for members of the ‘underground Church’—those who refuse to submit to the CCPA and follow the guidelines set out by the Chinese Communist Party (CCP). Under Article 3 of its [General Provisions](https://www-chinacatholic-cn.translate.goog/ccic/report/2305/0365-1.htm?utm_source=chatgpt.com&_x_tr_sl=zh-TW&_x_tr_tl=en&_x_tr_hl=en-US&_x_tr_pto=wapp), the CCPA’s purpose is to unite Catholic clergy and laity under the leadership of the CCP, support the socialist system, and study and implement [Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Xi_Jinping_Thought).

For many Chinese Catholics, however, the central question remains unresolved: What becomes of those who refuse to submit to a state-controlled ecclesiastical structure? Founded in 1957, the CCPA operates under government oversight, a longstanding source of concern for Catholics who insist that communion with Rome must remain free from political interference. While the Holy See maintains that engagement with Beijing can promote ecclesial unity, critics argue that the agreement has done little to reassure members of the ‘underground Church’ who continue to face pressure for remaining faithful to Rome.

The anxiety felt by many members of the ‘underground Church’ is not without historical precedent. Throughout China’s history, Christians have often paid a heavy price for their loyalty to Christ and His Church.

Among those who suffered was [St. Francisco Fernández de Capillas](https://www.dominicos.org/quienes-somos/grandes-figuras/santos/san-francisco-fernandez-capillas/), a Dominican missionary usually regarded as the first martyr in China, who was beheaded in 1648. During the Boxer Rebellion (1899–1901), [approximately](https://sacredspace.com/commentary/f0709s-2/) 30,000 Chinese Catholics were put to death for embracing Catholicism (Orthodox Christians and Protestants were killed), together with several hundred missionaries and their families. The witness of these martyrs did not end with their deaths. In the 20th century, new forms of persecution would test the fidelity of Chinese Catholics under Communist rule.

One of the most inspiring figures in the history of the Chinese ‘underground Church’ is [Cardinal Ignatius Kung Pin-Mei](https://www.hungarianconservative.com/articles/culture_society/roman-catholic-cardinal-kung-ccp-conflict/), Bishop of Shanghai, who resisted the Communist Party’s efforts to control the Catholic Church. Consecrated a bishop in 1950, Kung spent approximately 30 years in prison for his allegiance to Rome.

I vividly recall meeting Cardinal Kung during my seminary years when he celebrated Mass in Latin, seated in a wheelchair and chanting the Mass parts texts with remarkable clarity and devotion—an inspirational example of his love for the Church and his brethren.

It was said that, during his imprisonment, Kung could have secured his release had he agreed to sing the national anthem of the People’s Republic of China. Instead, he proclaimed Christ’s words to Peter:

_‘Tu es Petrus et super hanc petram aedificabo ecclesiam meam.’_ (‘You are Peter, and upon this rock I will build my Church.’) (Matthew 16:18)

Discover more

Conservative news subscription

Political analysis reports

Current events newsletter

The story captures the defining principle of his life: political power could imprison his body, but it could not compel him to renounce his allegiance to the Church. Released and eventually exiled, Kung was elevated to the College of Cardinals by Pope St. John Paul II in 1988.

> ‘Political power could imprison his body, but it could not compel him to renounce his allegiance to the Church’

His testimony also raises enduring questions about how Catholics in China can preserve their fidelity to the Church while living under a communist regime that seeks ultimate control over religious life. His witness deserves renewed attention, particularly as Catholics continue to debate the implications of the agreement with Beijing.

The Holy See must also consider the message its policies convey to Catholics living under authoritarian governments. When believers are imprisoned, monitored, and pressured to compromise their convictions, they need more than diplomatic assurances. They need to know that the universal Church recognizes their suffering and stands with them. True ecclesial unity cannot be measured solely by administrative agreements or the regularization of episcopal appointments. It must also be reflected in respect for freedom of conscience, the protection of freedom of worship, and the courage to defend those whose fidelity puts them at risk.

The witness of Catholics who suffer for their conscience and faith did not end with Cardinal Kung. That same courage endures in [Jimmy Lai](https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/hong-kong-tycoon-jimmy-lai-sentenced-total-20-years-national-security-trial-2026-02-09/), the Hong Kong pro-democracy activist and devout Catholic who was sentenced to 20 years in prison in February 2026. His children, [Sebastien and Claire Lai](https://www.cecc.gov/events/hearings/son-and-daughters-appeal-xi-jinping-release-their-dad-jimmy-lai), have called for his release, drawing renewed international attention to his imprisonment.

_People gather in front of the Chinese Consulate General to protest the unjust conviction of media entrepreneur Jimmy Lai on 14 February 2026 in Los Angeles, California. PHOTO: Apu Gomes/Getty Images/AFP_

Yet there are so many Catholics whose stories of imprisonment and torture for refusing to compromise their faith we probably shall never know. Their sacrifices may never make international headlines, but their fidelity is no less significant.

Many of us feel not only comforted but also encouraged to continue living our Catholic faith when someone tells us: ‘I’m praying for you.’ Those simple words can help us persevere and grow in grace. Equally uplifting is Pope St. John Paul II’s [exhortation](https://www.ncregister.com/blog/43-years-ago-and-today-john-paul-ii-urges-us-be-not-afraid): ‘Do not be afraid.’

It would mean a great deal if Pope Leo XIV offered a similar public assurance to Catholics in China who continue to face pressure for their fidelity to Rome. Such words would not resolve every difficulty, but they would remind the faithful that their shepherd has not forgotten them.

Let us pray that these courageous Catholics of China’s ‘underground Church’ will receive the recognition they deserve and that those who continue to suffer will hear, from the successor of St. Peter, the words that have sustained generations of Christians: ‘Do not be afraid.’

title: Between Development and Oversight: China’s Approach to Addressing Artificial Intelligence Risks
summary: **The rapid development of artificial intelligence capabilities is broadening the way China defines the risks posed by this technology. Alongside espionage, cyber threats, and familiar national security threats, Beijing is increasingly addr
content:
**The rapid development of artificial intelligence capabilities is broadening the way China defines the risks posed by this technology. Alongside espionage, cyber threats, and familiar national security threats, Beijing is increasingly addressing the risks originating from advanced AI systems themselves—including autonomous operation and loss of control. At the same time, technological lag and dependence on foreign technologies are also perceived as risks to national security. Official publications from September 2026 show that different approaches to these risks exist within the Chinese system, but all call for continued development of domestic AI capabilities alongside expanded mechanisms for safety, oversight, and control.**

In mid-September 2026, Chinese officials issued three major statements on AI risks. On September 13, Minister of State Security Chen Yixin [published an article](https://www.secrss.com/articles/93912) addressing their implications for Chinese national security. The following day, the [Artificial Intelligence Safety Governance Framework 3.0](https://www.cac.gov.cn/2026-09/14/c_1791137092283345.htm) was released, mapping the risks and the tools for addressing them. The [Chinese Foreign Ministry also addressed](https://www.mfa.gov.cn/eng/xw/fyrbt/202609/t20260915_12022885.html) AI risks and the possibility of slowing the development of advanced models.

This sequence of statements reflects different perspectives among China’s institutional bodies. Chen’s article examines the technology through the lens of national security, while Framework 3.0, developed by cybersecurity and standardization bodies, gives greater weight to risks arising from the systems’ evolving capabilities. The Foreign Ministry connects the two dimensions, presenting risk management as compatible with continued development. In any case, the boundaries between them are not clear-cut: the Chinese term _anquan_ (安全) denotes both "safety" and "security," bringing technological safety, cybersecurity, political stability, and national security under a single conceptual framework.

## **Artificial Intelligence Through the Lens of National Security: The Minister of State Security's Article**

Chen Yixin, Secretary of the Party Committee and Minister of State Security (MSS), published his article ahead of [National Cybersecurity Awareness Week](https://www.cac.gov.cn/2026-09/14/c_1791137133265127.htm). It draws heavily on earlier ideas and formulations of the Chinese leadership. A [comparative analysis](https://markparkeryoung.net/posts/chen-ai-lineage/) by Mark Parker Young, a former CIA analyst and senior official at the US National Intelligence Council, found that a significant portion of the minister's language is based on earlier documents and statements by President Xi Jinping and other Chinese officials. However, the section on AI risks contains a high proportion of material that could not be traced to previous texts, suggesting that the innovation lies primarily in applying existing security concepts to recent developments in the field.

Chen outlines six types of risks stemming from the development of artificial intelligence. For the purposes of this analysis, they can be grouped into three spheres. The first is the political and social sphere, which includes threats to political and ideological security, as well as challenges to governance and social order. In this context, Chen warns against the use of deepfakes, AI-generated content, and automated accounts to spread disinformation, inflame disputes, and wage cognitive warfare against China. He also points to algorithmic bias, privacy violations, and the difficulty of establishing accountability for automated decisions.

The second sphere concerns cybersecurity, espionage, and information security. According to Chen, artificial intelligence lowers the cost and skill barrier for executing cyberattacks, enabling the discovery of vulnerabilities and the automation of attacks, and even “AI versus AI” confrontations. He further warns against foreign intelligence services using the technology to collect and analyze sensitive data, as well as data leakage to foreign AI products.

The third sphere is technological and military competition. Chen frames technological gaps and dependency as a risk, arguing that countries with an advantage in the field use technology restrictions, standards, and closed systems to limit other countries’ access to advanced technologies. At the same time, he points to the increasing integration of AI in intelligence, decision-making, target identification, operational support, and cognitive influence. He describes a shift of the technology from a supporting role to a "pivotal role" on the battlefield.

Equally interesting is what does _not_ feature prominently in Chen’s list of risks. While Framework 3.0 (see below) emphasizes the risk of autonomous systems exceeding their assigned tasks or escaping human control, Chen focuses on how people, states, and hostile actors use AI—and on the risks posed by technological lag. This reflects the concept of “holistic national security,” which views technology as a force multiplier for existing threats and as another arena of competition between states. Accordingly, Chen defines innovation as the "primary driving force" and security as the "bottom-line requirement," calling for the reinforcement of self-reliant AI capabilities alongside mechanisms for monitoring, early warning, and oversight.

## **Risk Management: The Artificial Intelligence Safety Governance Framework 3.0**

Framework 3.0 was developed under the guidance of the Cyberspace Administration of China (CAC) and organized by the National Cybersecurity Standardization Technical Committee (TC260), in collaboration with research institutes, professional bodies, and technology companies. The institutional response is distributed among several entities: the CAC leads regulation in the areas of services, content, algorithms, and data; TC260 handles standardization and technical tools; and the Ministry of State Security brings a national security perspective. AI providers are responsible for implementing the safety requirements, under the supervision of the relevant regulators.

This is the third version of the framework, which has been updated annually since September 2024. It is not a binding law or regulation, but rather a guiding document built around three tiers: mapping and classifying risks, using technological measures to reduce them, and establishing oversight and governance mechanisms. Among other things, the framework recommends risk assessments, monitoring and early warnings, restricting the permissions of AI agents, human involvement in high-risk operations, audits of tools and plug-ins, and mechanisms for shutting down systems that exceed their assigned tasks. One of the system's guiding principles is promoting AI development while ensuring it remains "safe and controllable" (安全可控).

The framework operates alongside a binding regulatory system that has evolved in China in recent years. This includes rules for generative AI services, registration and review procedures for services and algorithms, and requirements for labeling AI-generated content. As of late August 2026, over one thousand generative AI services have completed the national-level registration process in China. Framework 3.0 provides a risk roadmap and technical principles to guide the further development of standards and regulation, while legal obligations remain anchored in the existing regulatory system.

[According to an analysis by AI Safety in China](https://aisafetychina.substack.com/p/brief-29-what-chinas-new-ai-safety), an independent research project tracking AI policy and governance in China, the number of risks detailed in the framework grew from 30 in Version 2.0 to 54 in Version 3.0. Particular attention is given to AI agents, which can plan, perform tasks, and operate in external systems, and to embodied AI, in which a digital failure could cause physical harm. The framework also addresses systems that obtain unauthorized permissions or resources, deceive safety evaluators, deviate from their intended goal, or act autonomously in cyberspace. In [commentary published following the framework's presentation](https://www.cac.gov.cn/2026-09/17/c_1791397053329870.htm), this change was described as a shift in large models from "answering questions" to "executing tasks."

The framework also addresses open-weight models—models whose parameters learned during training are publicly available, allowing them to be run and modified independently. The framework warns that once weights have been distributed, the model can be run independently, modified, or even stripped of its safety mechanisms, making it difficult to retroactively restrict copies that have already been released. This warning is particularly noteworthy given the prominent role of Chinese open-weight models in the domestic industry. DeepSeek, for instance, [released the weights for its V4 models](https://deepseek.com/en/news/v4-preview/) and presented this openness as part of its development strategy. This creates a tension between the contribution of open weights to innovation, adoption, and China's technological influence on the one hand, and the difficulty of controlling their use after distribution on the other.

[A comparison of the document's three versions](https://www.cac.gov.cn/2026-09/17/c_1791397053329870.htm) illustrates how China’s conception of risk has expanded alongside technological developments. Version 1.0, published in 2024, focused primarily on risks stemming directly from the technology itself and its use. Version 2.0 broadened the discussion to social risks, including impacts on employment and ethics. Version 3.0 further expands the focus to risks arising from the evolving capabilities of advanced systems, such as autonomous operation and AI agents.

The difference between Chen's article and Framework 3.0 demonstrates that the concept of risk operates across multiple dimensions. Externally, Beijing is concerned about falling behind in technological competition, dependence on foreign technologies, and the use of AI by states and hostile actors for cyber operations, espionage, and influence. Within China, there are also concerns about threats to political security and social order. Framework 3.0 adds another layer: the risk posed by the behavior of advanced systems themselves. Artificial intelligence is thus viewed simultaneously as a source of national power and a potential threat.

## **Development Alongside Security: The Chinese Foreign Ministry’s Position**

On September 14, Chinese Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Guo Jiakun was asked about calls by senior US AI industry figures to slow the development of advanced AI systems, and particularly regarding [comments by Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei](https://darioamodei.com/post/we-must-pace-the-frontier), who linked the risks of advanced AI models to technological competition with China. [Guo responded that China advocates for the "open and inclusive" development](https://www.mfa.gov.cn/fyrbt_673021/202609/t20260914_12021744.shtml) of AI, and warned against threat-mongering, confrontation, and "malicious competition."

The following day, Guo clarified that China also recognizes the risks themselves. According to Guo, regulation must be adapted and safeguards strengthened to prevent the technology from spiraling out of control. He emphasized that China places "[equal emphasis on development and security](https://www.mfa.gov.cn/eng/xw/fyrbt/202609/t20260915_12022885.html)," takes both the inherent and derivative risks of AI seriously, and works to ensure that the technology remains "safe, reliable, and controllable." In this context, Guo explicitly referenced Framework 3.0, which had been published the previous day.

title: China's Communist Party Set for Biggest Leadership Shake-Up Before Xi's Fourth Term
summary: Chinese President Xi Jinping (first row, fourth from left) attends a ceremony marking the 90th anniversary of the victory of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army's Long March at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing on Oct. 22. Xin
content:
Chinese President Xi Jinping (first row, fourth from left) attends a ceremony marking the 90th anniversary of the victory of the Chinese Workers' and Peasants' Red Army's Long March at the Great Hall of the People in Beijing on Oct. 22. Xinhua-Yonhap

The fifth plenary session of the Chinese Communist Party's 20th Central Committee opens in Beijing on the 26th and runs through the 29th, bringing together the party's top leadership. Coming just one year before the 21st Party Congress, which will decide whether Chinese President Xi Jinping secures a fourth term, the meeting is expected to produce a sweeping personnel overhaul aimed at shoring up the ground for that extension.

Hong Kong's South China Morning Post reported on the 25th that the plenum, held behind closed doors over four days from the 26th, will formalize the largest reshuffle of senior party, government and military officials on record.

The Central Committee, which convenes the plenum, is the Communist Party's highest body of power, made up of 205 full members including the general secretary. Plenary sessions, held once or twice every one to two years, set major party policy and personnel decisions between the party congresses that take place every five years. Xi himself locked in his third term at the first plenum in October 2022, when he was re-elected as the committee's general secretary. Last year's fourth plenum adopted the 15th five-year plan covering 2026 to 2030 and confirmed the expulsion of 14 full and alternate members, including He Weidong and Miao Hua.

According to the SCMP, 20 full members and seven alternate members of the Central Committee are currently under investigation on corruption allegations and are awaiting formal expulsion at this plenum. They include former Jiangxi party secretary Yi Lianhong, former Jiangxi governor Ye Jianchun, former Inner Mongolia party secretary Sun Shaocheng and former Inner Mongolia regional government chairwoman Wang Lixia. Additional expulsions are also expected among the People's Liberation Army generals caught up in this year's extensive purge.

Even setting aside the purge, about two-thirds of the current Central Committee members will have reached mandatory retirement age by the time the party congress convenes in October next year. That has fueled persistent expectations that the party's seventh-generation cadres, who now account for roughly 8% of the central leadership, will emerge as the core of the next power structure. The seventh generation refers to those born from the late 1960s through the 1970s, nearly half of whom hold doctorates, making them what observers call the most highly educated group in the party's history. Many are specialists in engineering fields, giving the cohort a deep bench for the advanced technology competition with the United States. The group also carries little factional baggage, as its members belong to neither the so-called princelings nor the Communist Youth League, and built their careers during Xi's first and second terms — both advantages from the standpoint of a leader seeking a fourth term.

Seventh-generation officials have indeed taken over the top posts at local governments and central ministries one after another this year. A prominent example is Shanghai Mayor Zhu Zhongming, born in 1972, who is expected to be elevated to the Central Committee at next year's congress. Belonging to the seventh generation, however, offers no shield from the anti-corruption drive. Xia Linmao, Beijing's executive vice mayor, who was born in 1970, was placed under investigation by disciplinary authorities last week. The SCMP described the case as the latest warning that cadres singled out as rising stars face relentless scrutiny and will be judged strictly on political compliance and administrative integrity rather than on potential or promise.

Even so, the SCMP assessed that the seventh generation is a leading pool of candidates to move beyond the next leadership lineup into the top echelon after 2032. A report published in May by the Center for China Analysis at the Asia Society, a U.S.-based nonprofit organization for international exchange, concluded that Xi is diffusing immediate succession threats while building a talent base that allows him to retain control well past 2032. The SCMP said that with the countdown to the 2027 party congress underway, this plenum will provide fresh momentum to tighten party control and secure absolute loyalty ahead of the next congress.

The BRICS summit held in New Delhi in September 2026 demonstrated the organization’s gradual evolution from a forum based primarily on declarations and political and economic coordination into a framework that is also developing practical mechanisms in technology, industry, health, agriculture, and space. For China, this process carries additional significance: BRICS enables it to advance ideas and initiatives originating in Beijing within a multilateral framework it does not control, thereby contributing to the internationalization of China’s global agenda. The article examines these trends, how they were reflected at the New Delhi summit, and their potential implications for the Middle East and Israel. The 18th BRICS Summit, held in New Delhi on September 12–13, 2026, was marked by an effort to deepen cooperation among member states and give it more practical expression. Alongside familiar positions on multipolarity, strengthening the status of the "Global South," reforming international institutions, and expanding the representation of developing nations, the summit highlighted two interconnected trends. The first is BRICS’s gradual evolution from a forum for political and economic coordination into a framework that is also building professional, technological, and institutional networks in industry, technology, health, agriculture, and space. The second is China’s effort to use this process to advance ideas, areas of activity, and mechanisms that it is developing itself within a multilateral framework not under its exclusive control. Precisely because India, Brazil, South Africa, and other countries help shape the agenda and make decisions, turning ideas originating in Beijing into BRICS initiatives is intended, under this approach, to give them a broader international foundation and legitimacy. In other words, the forum can be viewed as an additional platform for internationalizing the Chinese agenda. Both trends remain a work in progress. In many instances, the summit continued trends and decisions announced at earlier summits, including in artificial intelligence, which generated considerable headlines. It is therefore important to distinguish among three stages: announcing initiatives, establishing mechanisms and institutions to advance them, and implementing them in practice. In many areas, BRICS has already advanced from the first stage to the second, but whether many of these mechanisms will be implemented and will have a practical impact remains an open question. # Jota Food chairman dies after car plunges off bridge in Hualien

10/25/2026 09:18 PM

Photo courtesy of the Hualien County Fire Department Oct. 25, 2026

Taipei, Oct. 25 (CNA) Jota Food Co. Chairman Yu Kuo-chi (余國基) died of severe injuries Sunday after the car he was driving crashed through a guardrail and plunged off a bridge in Hualien County, with the cause of the accident still under investigation, local police said.

Yu, 64, who was alone in the car, was driving north on County Road 193 when his vehicle crashed through a guardrail and fell from Guanglong Bridge in Xincheng Township for unknown reasons, according to the Hualien County Fire Department.

Department officers said they received a report of the accident at around 3 p.m., and when rescuers arrived at the scene, they found the car severely deformed with the driver trapped inside.

Rescuers used specialized equipment to cut open the vehicle and extricate the man, who was not breathing and did not have a heartbeat.

They performed cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) and rushed him to Hualien Tzu Chi Hospital, but he was later pronounced dead of the injuries he suffered, the fire department said.

The man was later identified as the chairman of the Hualien-based food company.

According to local police, they have obtained footage from surveillance cameras at intersections near the crash site, as well as recordings from the car's dashboard camera as part of the investigation that is underway.

Jota Food (宗泰食品), founded by Yu's father Yu Tsung-po (余宗柏) in 1970, operates four brands: Amis Mochi (阿美麻糬), the Chihsing Tan Katsuo Museum (七星柴魚博物館), the Taitung Amis Custard Apple Mochi Museum (台東阿美釋迦麻糬館), and Digenwei-Wanwei Fan Paradise (地耕味-玩味蕃樂園).
