CNA file photo

Taipei, Oct. 24 (CNA) If deaths from cancer are excluded, Taiwan's average life expectancy in 2025 would be raised by 3.7 years, the Ministry of the Interior (MOI) said on Saturday.

In a news release, the MOI said it calculated life expectancy after excluding deaths from each of the 10 leading causes of death in 2025 and compared the results with the overall average. The greater the difference, the greater the cause's impact on life expectancy.

According to Ministry of Health and Welfare statistics, the 10 leading causes of death in Taiwan in 2025 were cancers, heart disease, pneumonia, cerebrovascular disease, diabetes, hypertensive diseases, accidents, nephritis, nephrotic syndrome and nephrosis, chronic lower respiratory diseases, and suicide.

The MOI said cancers had been Taiwan's leading cause of death for 44 consecutive years, accounting for 54,838 deaths, or 27.48 percent of all deaths, in 2025.

Taiwan's average life expectancy was 81.27 years in 2025, but could have been higher by 3.7 years to 84.97 years if deaths from cancers were excluded, the MOI explained.

Meanwhile, excluding deaths from heart disease and pneumonia would have raised average life expectancy by 1.54 years and 1.13 years, respectively, the MOI said.

The gap between average life expectancy and the figure calculated excluding cancer deaths narrowed from 4.10 years in 2015 to 3.70 years in 2025, suggesting that cancer's impact on life expectancy had eased slightly, it added.

The MOI said men lost more years of life than women to most of Taiwan's 10 leading causes of death in 2025, except for diabetes, hypertensive diseases and kidney diseases.

Men lost 0.75 years of life expectancy to accidental injuries, compared with 0.36 years for women. It said the differences may be related to occupation, physiological factors, diet and health care, or lifestyle habits.

The MOI said the statistics help show how different causes of death affect life expectancy.

More information is available on the ministry's website under the section on "Statistics."

(By Wu Shu-wei and Ko Lin)

## Details

We use the website Chairman's Bao to provide the material for this call. The website will be shared during the call so you do not need your own subscription. We will be reading passages extracted from current newspaper articles at a level of HSK 3 and HSK 4. We will takes turns reading the sentences in Chinese and translating after reviewing a vocabulary list. Then we will listen to a native speaker read the passage and finally we will again read the article focusing on improved smoothness of our reading.

If you are studying independently, this is a great opportunity to talk with other learners and share notes. If you're looking for a structured activity, we recommend that you attend our third Tuesday events.

We make a conscious effort to balance talking about Mandarin with speaking the language. We learn the most through practice and feedback. It's the most fun to learn with other people.

## Details

Four different teachers will rotate talks with a Dharma talk, meditation, sutra, and metta practices. 🙏

>>>> ZOOM ID/Link <<<<
[https://us02web.zoom.us/j/5093952030](https://us02web.zoom.us/j/5093952030)

All are welcome to be a part of our evening service. Experience not necessary. Those of any faith or lack thereof are welcome. All that is required is an open mind to learn how to promote wellness, happiness, love, and peace to oneself and all sentient beings. Typically a service will include the following:

*   Check in. (How you’re doing.)
*   Silent meditation, seated on cushion, chair, or one of the pews.
*   Dharma talk from either Thay Kozen or one of five other teachers. (Buddhist teaching on how to alleviate suffering and promote happiness and peace.)
*   Metta practice. (Loving kindness.)
*   Sutra recitation and discussion. (Sutras are the written Dharma teachings.)
*   Much love and laughter.

**Rohan Khadka**

Donation protected

**For Geeta Shrestha**

 Geeta Shrestha is Rohan’s longtime friend from kindergarten, and today Geeta is facing a heartbreaking loss that no family should have to endure. Geeta recently lost her husband, Raj Shrestha, in the Nepal-Tibet flood. Raj worked at the Rasuwagadhi Customs Office, and his sudden passing has left Geeta grieving while also caring for their young son on her own. After just welcoming a new baby boy, Geeta is now carrying the weight of loss, motherhood, and an uncertain future all at once.

 This fundraiser is being organized so Rohan can collect support and send it to Geeta in Nepal. The funds will help cover Raj’s funeral costs and support Geeta’s son’s education and upbringing. These are not just immediate needs but ongoing ones, as Geeta now has to provide for her child over time without Raj’s support. Recurring donations can offer steady help for the continuing costs of raising her son and planning for his education, while one-time gifts will also make a meaningful difference during this painful time. Please help support Geeta, a mother of a 1-year-old baby, as she cares for her family and rebuilds after this devastating Nepal-Tibet flood loss. Every donation, share, and kind thought means so much.

title: 拉萨事件及达赖喇嘛出走真相

content: 2026-10-23   思芦随笔 李江琳的《1959 拉萨！》客观描写了1959年的拉萨事件。长期以来，中共对拉萨事件的定义是“西藏上层反动分子有预谋、有计划、有步骤”的一场叛乱、达赖喇嘛被劫持到印度。此说法在大陆是一边倒并且占统治地位的。李江琳研究了双方的资料，并做了大量采访，发现此事件确实是有组织、有计划、有步骤的，但是所有的组织、预谋和计划都在中共的这一边。本书揭示的中共的所有手段，在以后的民族冲突中不断地被重复使用。 事件的背景是：1950年10月解放军进军康区首府昌都，在昌都歼灭藏军四千余人后，继续向西藏中部地区推进。西藏噶厦政府代表团被迫前往北京进行和谈。西藏代表团与中共签订了《十七条协议》，协议规定解放军进入西藏，巩固国防；西藏实行民族区域自治；西藏现行政治、宗教制度和政权不予变更；西藏人民的宗教信仰和风俗习惯将得到尊重。 随后几年内，在中国内地，中共通过暴力完成土改，摧毁了原有的乡村自治，在数百万地主富农的鲜血和尸骨上，建立起乡村基层组织和政权机构，实现了行政上的大一统；1953年强制推行统购统销和工商业社会主义改造，完成了经济上的大一统；“反右”运动制造了意识形态上的大一统。只有西藏那个角落，没有完成红色大一统。 1998年香港回归，邓小平许诺香港制度50年不变。习近平等不及，强推国安法，改变香港制度，造成香港糜乱。网上流传一个段子：香妃回归后，乾隆垂涎三尺。约法三章后才娶进宫来，几年来倒也秋毫不犯。那一夜月黑风高，乾隆再也按捺不住，便乘夜色潜入，欲霸王硬上弓。香妃抵死不从。容嬷嬷不解：“不是说好五十年不变吗？迟早是您的人，皇上急什么呀？”乾隆含泪道：“你看朕这身子骨，还能撑到五十年吗！”毛泽东也是按捺不住的人，想找个借口，把十七条协议撕毁，将西藏纳入红色大一统的版图。 1956-1958年中共把大一统目标推进到西藏周边的四省藏区内，搞暴力土改和宗教改革运动。在四川省新龙上瞻地区，土改工作队收来到一个名叫居美的头人家，要求他们交枪。居美不在家，家里只有他的母亲妻儿和一名老管家。他们告诉工作组枪被居美带走了，家里没有武器。结果居美一家老少，包括那名管家，全部被枪杀。引发当地藏民暴动。参加者达2,787户，3,972人；占该县总农户的70%，总人口的16.7%。其中大多数是中共依靠的基本群众，即“翻身农奴”。 1958年，青海省在牧区推行社会主义改造，强办牧业合作社。根据中央的指示，为了镇压人民的抵制，青海省委采取开会学习等方式，将少数民族上层人士集中控制起来。1958年4月，班禅喇嘛的老师、循化温都寺加乃化仁波切等上层人士被请到县城去参加学习班，引发藏人暴动。4月25日拂晓，解放军聚集重兵，围歼“叛匪”。其时武装叛匪已逃走，留下的是要求释放加乃化仁波切的民众。解放军在没有遭到抵抗的情况下，攻击民众。在4小时内，民众死伤719人，其中435人被击毙。解放军没有伤亡。随即中共展开搜捕，逮捕2499人，占循化人口23%。加乃化仁波切得知消息，在学习班里悲愤自杀。 青海省兴海县的所有牧主、头人、宗教上层人物均被批斗，还把217名宗教人员关起来集训。全县饿死和被杀死的藏民达7,217人，占总人口的43.5%。被抓的人中，死亡率竟高达57.5%。1964年青海省藏人人口比1957年减少了近10万人。青海一共抓捕了52,000人。同样的事件发生在所有西藏周边的藏区。许多藏民从周边藏区逃到拉萨，把中共对藏民的暴行传布到西藏，引发了藏民的恐慌。很多难民后来参与了1959年拉萨起义。 1958年8月，中央军委向空军下达了命令：凡带枪，赶著牲畜的一群藏人，就是叛匪，格杀勿论。大部分普通藏民都符合这个描述。机翼下，游牧部落的帐篷和牲畜一览无余，于是牧场成为杀戮场。飞机朝他们倾泻子弹。 毛泽东批示支持青海省委的镇压，并要西藏准备镇压群众反抗，认为这是提早“解放”西藏人民的机会。毛泽东批示：“青海反动派叛乱，极好，劳动人民解放的机会就到来了。”讽刺的是，参加叛乱的，恰恰就是劳动人民。毛泽东指示“西藏要准备对付那里的可能的全面叛乱”，而且“乱子越大越好”。 早在1955年冬，毛泽东就给西藏工委指示，“叫西藏准备进行民主改革，并著重指出，必须在打的基础上进行准备，贵族反抗，准备打掉一部分，跑掉一部分，噶伦堡、香港多几个骂我们的人，没有什么了不起。” “几年之后，例如三、四年，五、六年，或者七、八年之后，总要来一次总决战，才能彻底解决问题。西藏统治者原有兵力很弱，现在他们有了一支斗志较强的万人叛乱武装，这是我们的严重敌人。但这并没有什么不好，反而是一件好事，因为有可能最后用战争解决问题。” 毛泽东和中共中央早已对“总决战”有所策划，目标是扫除在西藏搞土改的障碍，从而找到藉口，打破“十七条协议”中“不改变西藏现状”的约束，放手把在内地的土改等社会改造推行于西藏。 1958年8月18日，中共总书记邓小平指示西藏军区司令员张国华和副司令员邓少东：要巩固自己的阵地，维护交通，有把握的就打，没有把握的就不打；让他们闹大点，闹得愈大，改革就愈彻底。毛泽东和中共中央早就想打，而且想大打。1959年3月的拉萨藏人集会抗议，给了中共一个开打的理由。整套计划3年前已经开始制定，缺少的只是一个适当的时机，一个可以用于国内外宣传的理由，以便将这套计划付诸实施。相对于1950年，1959年中共已做好军事准备：两条公路已通车，当雄机场也已通航，韩战已结束；培养了一批藏族干部，换班的条件基本成熟。 1959年2月7日，达赖喇嘛受邀去西藏军区礼堂观看军区文工团演出。因军区内正在修筑备战工事，军区副司令员邓少东拒绝25名藏军警卫仪仗进入军区。噶厦高层官员认为此举对达赖极不尊重。鉴于青海和川边发生的喇嘛被政府邀去学习班遭诱捕的案例，3月10日各地藏民和少数藏人中下层官员蜂涌包围达赖喇嘛夏宫罗布林卡，请求达赖取消军区之行。藏民群众控制了三位噶伦，并在大街上张贴海报、呼口号，要求中共离开西藏。而噶厦政府瘫痪，大部分藏军仍在驻地，并未参加。 中共认为这次藏人的集会游行给了一个长期等待的机会，制造了开打的理由。中共最高层从一开始就无意政治解决，而打算军事解决。 3月15日，中央军委向成都、兰州、昆明军区下达入藏令。3月16日，中共军事部署已近完成。3月17日，中共中央政治局决议：“坚决平叛，全面改革。” 3月17日罗布林卡被两枚迫击炮弹轰炸，造成恐慌。达赖喇嘛请求神谕后，决定悄悄出走。达赖喇嘛出走之后，在罗布林卡墙内外的民众知情后，就失去了聚集的理由，会自动解散。3月19日中共得知达赖喇嘛出走的消息后，担心失去开打的理由，决定不再等待四川等地进藏部队合围，尽快动手。 3月20日凌晨，解放军159团副团長吳晨带一个连向拉萨河然马岗渡口进攻，首先向控制该渡口的藏军开枪，打响了第一枪。事后，中共宣传说叛乱分子向驻守渡口的解放军进攻，打响了第一枪。 解放军以猛烈炮火轰击药王山、罗布林卡和布达拉宫。使用不对称的过度武力，不惜滥杀平民和破坏西藏的宗教圣地。狂轰滥炸下，圣地下几无余生。3月22日，在解放军猛烈炮火下，拉萨城藏军据点相继被攻克，大屠杀后，拉萨一片肃静。 李江琳还揭示为了说服尼赫鲁一起来劝达赖喇嘛打消留在印度的念头，周恩来告诉尼赫鲁中国准备承认麦克马洪线。麦克马洪线是英国单方面划定的印度-西藏边界线。这条边界有利于印度，将传统上被认为属于藏区、约9万平方公里的领土划给印度和缅甸。中国国民党政府和西藏政府都不承认这条边界。而为了解决内政问题，中共不惜卖国。 拉萨起义和六四是中共执政后唯二的两次使用军队进城的大规模屠杀平民事件。

title: Typhoon Champi knocks out power to thousands in Taiwan
zh_title: 台风“占比”导致台湾数千人断电
summary: 周六，台风“占比”猛烈的狂风袭击了台湾，风暴正向中国和日本移动，紧急救援人员紧急恢复了台湾数万户家庭的供电。 2026 年 10 月 24 日，基隆为传统道教宗教仪式建造的临时建筑因台风占比的强风而倒塌。照片：I-Hwa Cheng /法新社。暴风雨导致树木倒塌、电线断电并引发短暂的洪水，当局在暴风雨来临前疏散了 5,000 多人。目前已造成1人死亡、500多人受伤
content:
周六，台风“占比”猛烈的狂风袭击了台湾，风暴正向中国和日本移动，紧急救援人员紧急恢复了台湾数万户家庭的供电。 2026 年 10 月 24 日，基隆为传统道教宗教仪式建造的临时建筑因台风占比的强风而倒塌。照片：I-Hwa Cheng /法新社。暴风雨导致树木倒塌、电线断电并引发短暂的洪水，当局在暴风雨来临前疏散了 5,000 多人。自周四政府开始发布台风即将来临的警告以来，已造成 1 人死亡、500 多人受伤。由于占比继续袭击该岛，大约 56,000 户家庭仍然断电，周六，西部苗栗县录得近 24 厘米的降雨量。随着台风逐渐远离台湾东北部并向北移动至中国和日本，台湾北部和中部的大多数商店连续第二天关门。中央气象局吴焕华在新闻发布会上表示，“虽然台风影响最严重的时期已经过去，但我们要提醒大家，随着台风北移，台湾周边海域的风浪依然强劲。”查皮是太平洋风暴季节中最新的一个，厄尔尼诺天气现象加剧了太平洋风暴季节的影响，厄尔尼诺天气现象导致赤道太平洋空前变暖。
这场风暴最近几天横渡大洋时一度短暂成为超强台风，据报道最大持续风速接近每小时300公里。根据联合台风预警中心的最新消息，周六风速达到每小时120公里。预报员称，风暴强度在一夜之间减弱，并在台湾东北部宜兰县附近盘旋，自周四以来已给该县带来了 65 厘米的降雨量。 2026 年 10 月 23 日，台风占比逼近台湾基隆，人们站在防波堤上，看着海浪拍打着防波堤。照片：I-Hwa Cheng/法新社。玛莎·王(Martha Wang)表示，周六早上，当她骑着摩托车穿过新北市的一座桥时，她害怕被风“吹走”。这位55岁的秘书告诉法新社：“我真的很害怕，因为我在桥上。我的摩托车在摇晃。”然而，余威廉对这场风暴并不担心，他说这场风暴“并不比其他台风更强”。 “我昨天（晚上）去便利店吃饭，一切都很好，”这位55岁的图书管理员说。 “强风和大雨” 据国家控制的中央电视台报道，当“强风”接近中国东海岸时，中国当局警告称，将出现“强风和大雨”。一些火车服务已暂停，数万人从上海的家中撤离。预计江苏、上海、浙江等地部分地区将出现大到暴雨。
该地区的数十架航班已被取消，其中包括日本最南端的冲绳县，政府称该县有两人在台风中受伤。石垣岛的游客正在等待航班恢复，以便可以回家。 “我们希望这是我们的最后一天，”来自波兰的 49 岁伊娃·马利克 (Eva Malek) 告诉法新社。 “掌握信息并不容易。我们不了解情况，也没想到会发生这样的事情。台风来的时候，我们没想到会那么强。”联合国说我们

【原文 English Original】
Emergency crews scrambled on Saturday to restore power to tens of thousands of homes in Taiwan after Typhoon Champi’s fierce winds battered the island, with the storm moving towards China and Japan. A temporary structure built for a traditional Taoist religious ceremony lies collapsed due to strong winds from Typhoon Champi in Keelung on October 24, 2026. Photo: I-Hwa Cheng /AFP. Authorities evacuated more than 5,000 people from their homes ahead of the storm, which toppled trees, brought down power lines, and triggered brief flooding. One person has been killed and more than 500 injured since Thursday, when the government began issuing warnings about the approaching typhoon. Around 56,000 households are still without power as Champi continues to buffet the island, with nearly 24 centimetres of rain recorded in the western county of Miaoli on Saturday. Most shops across northern and central Taiwan were closed for a second day, as the typhoon gradually moves away from the island’s northeast and heads north towards China and Japan. “Although the period of the typhoon’s most severe impact has passed, we would like to remind everyone that winds and waves in the waters around Taiwan remain strong as the typhoon moves northwards,” the Central Weather Administration’s Wuu Woan-hwa said at a briefing. Champi is the latest in a busy Pacific storm season turbocharged by the El Nino weather phenomenon that has caused unprecedented warming in the equatorial Pacific. The storm was briefly a super typhoon as it crossed the ocean in recent days, with reported maximum sustained wind speeds of nearly 300 kilometres per hour. It was packing wind speeds of 120 kph on Saturday, according to the latest update from the Joint Typhoon Warning Center. The storm’s intensity weakened overnight as it made a loop off Taiwan’s northeastern county of Yilan, where it has dumped 65 cm of rain since Thursday, the forecaster said. People stand on a breakwater as waves crash against it as Typhoon Champi approaches Taiwan, in Keelung on October 23, 2026. Photo: I-Hwa Cheng/AFP. Martha Wang said she was afraid of being “blown away” by the wind as she rode her scooter across a bridge in New Taipei City on Saturday morning. “I was really scared because I was on the bridge. My scooter was shaking,” the 55-year-old secretary told AFP. William Yu, however, was unfazed by the storm, saying it “wasn’t any stronger than other typhoons.” “I went to the convenience store to eat yesterday (evening) and everything was fine,” the 55-year-old librarian said. ‘Strong winds and heavy rain’ Authorities in China warned of “strong winds and heavy rain” as Champi approaches the country’s east coast, state-controlled broadcaster CCTV said. Some train services have been suspended and tens of thousands evacuated from their homes in Shanghai. “Some areas of Jiangsu, Shanghai, Zhejiang, and other regions are expected to experience heavy to torrential rainfall,” it said. Dozens of flights have been cancelled in the region, including in Japan’s southernmost prefecture of Okinawa where the government said two people were injured in the typhoon. Tourists on Ishigaki island waited for flights to resume so they could return home. “We hope it’s our last day,” Eva Malek, 49, from Poland told AFP. “It’s not easy to have information. We were not aware of the situation and didn’t expect something like this to happen. When the typhoon arrived we didn’t think it would be that strong.” The United Nations said Wednesday that the El Nino system gripping the planet is heading off the charts and that countries should take urgent action to prepare for the worst. El Nino is expected to peak in December, but the human impact is set to last into 2027 and beyond. The warming phase of a natural climate cycle, El Nino temporarily raises sea temperatures in the tropical Pacific, triggering changes in weather that can increase the risk of drought and flooding and exacerbate human-caused global warming.

title: Everest Win Sparks Debate Over Stewarding and Rematch Prospects
zh_title: 珠穆朗玛峰的胜利引发了有关管理和复赛前景的争论
summary: 香港嘉英瑞星在兰德威克珠穆朗玛峰上以微弱优势落败，引发了有关管理人员差距的争论。练马师托比·埃德蒙兹向骑师透露了提早发牌的指示，而香港投注者的赌注则创纪录的 1.13 亿港元。明年的比赛可能会进行三局两胜的决胜局。 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 24 日香港时间 08:21 · 2 分钟阅读《珠穆朗玛峰》跑完了 68.21 秒，一周后，比赛继续在 Austral 中占据主导地位
content:
香港
嘉英瑞星在兰德威克珠穆朗玛峰上以微弱优势落败，引发了有关管理人员差距的争论。练马师托比·埃德蒙兹向骑师透露了提早发牌的指示，而香港投注者的赌注则创纪录的 1.13 亿港元。明年的比赛可能会进行三局两胜的决胜局。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 24 日 08:21 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

珠穆朗玛峰跑完了 68.21 秒，一周后，这场比赛继续主导澳大利亚赛马新闻。大多数评论都集中在前20秒，当时嘉英瑞星在没有掩护的情况下被撞出边线，五匹马在他体内全力以赴。据报道，骑师扎克·珀顿在伤害最小化模式下仅以微弱优势落败。

干事们的珠穆朗玛峰报告大约有100字，没有提到被击败的热门嘉英崛起，只给了辣味马提尼一句台词。练马师托比·埃德蒙兹后来告诉《X》记者史蒂夫·休利特，骑师泰勒·马歇尔被指示要跳得快，让他外面的马匹发挥作用。当嘉英崛起返回时，这匹母马被贴在 Ninja 外三边，用埃德蒙兹的话说，“在她的巅峰状态太久了”。
香港投注者在比赛中投入了创纪录的1.13亿港元。消息人士询问，对于这么大的池子，管家的报告是否应该不仅仅确认没有任何不妥之处，还应该解释为什么会发生这样的事情，以帮助分析师审视有关珀顿骑行的问题。悉尼长期以来一直是管家标准的制定者，曾培养过移居香港的官员，其中包括现任首席管家马克·范·格斯特尔(Marc Van Gestel)。

新南威尔士州赛马会前任老板彼得·维兰迪斯 (Peter V'landys) 建造了珠穆朗玛峰，以吸引人们对摇摆不定的悉尼春天的关注。第 10 场比赛顺利完成，而同一天的考菲尔德杯却因摔倒而蒙上阴影，奥霍普·温斯 (Ohope Wins) 失去了生命。墨尔本春季面临压力，其主要赛事已成为动物权利辩论的避雷针。

目前，Tempted 与 Ka Ying Rising 之间的比分是一比一。两人都有机会在接下来的 12 个月内保持不败，并抵达兰德威克进行三局两胜的决胜局，这是赛车界很少有的事情。诱惑的表现，与模式赛跑并坚持下去，是非凡的，但她是否能重复这一点还有待观察。

Hong Kong
Ka Ying Rising's narrow loss in the Everest at Randwick has sparked debate over stewarding gaps. Trainer Toby Edmonds revealed jockey instructions to push early, while Hong Kong punters bet a record HK$113 million. The race sets up a potential best-of-three decider next year.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

24 Oct 2026 at 08:21 HKT · 2 min read

The Everest took 68.21 seconds to run, and a week later the race continues to dominate Australian racing's news cycle. Most commentary has focused on the first 20 seconds, when Ka Ying Rising was caught wide without cover, with five horses going flat out inside him. Jockey Zac Purton, in harm-minimisation mode, lost only narrowly, according to reports.

The stewards' Everest report, running to about 100 words, did not mention beaten favourite Ka Ying Rising, and gave only one line to Spicy Martini. Trainer Toby Edmonds later told journalist Steve Hewlett on X that jockey Taylor Marshall was instructed to jump fast and make horses outside him work. When Ka Ying Rising went back, the mare was posted three wide outside Ninja and, in Edmonds's words, 'at her top for too long.'

Hong Kong punters poured a record HK$113 million into the race. The source asks whether, with pools this big, a stewards' report should do more than confirm nothing was untoward, and should explain why things happened to help analysts look past questions about Purton's riding. Sydney has long been the standard setter for stewarding, having produced officials who moved to Hong Kong, including current chief steward Marc Van Gestel.

Former Racing NSW boss Peter V'landys built The Everest to drag attention to a wavering Sydney spring. The 10th running delivered, while the same day's Caulfield Cup was overshadowed by a fall that cost Ohope Wins her life. The Melbourne spring is under pressure and its major races have become lightning rods for the animal rights debate.

The score between Tempted and Ka Ying Rising is now one-all. There is a chance both go unbeaten for the next 12 months and arrive at Randwick for a best-of-three decider, something racing rarely offers. Tempted's performance, racing against pattern and holding on, was extraordinary, but whether she can repeat it remains to be seen.

zh_title: 恒基兆业地产首次亮相香港美酒佳肴巡礼五十周年
summary: 香港恒基兆业地产首次亮相香港美酒佳肴巡礼，并以 2,000 平方英尺的展馆作为其 50 周年庆典的一部分。该展示中心设有 12 家餐厅和酒吧，由扎哈·哈迪德建筑事务所 (Zaha Hadid Architects) 设计，并与合作伙伴将废食用油转化为可持续能源 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), 主编 2026 年 10 月 24 日 08:30 HKT · 阅读 2 分钟 恒基地产首次亮相香港葡萄酒及烈酒展
content:
香港
恒基兆业地产首次亮相香港美酒佳肴巡礼，并以 2,000 平方英尺的展馆作为其 50 周年庆典的一部分。该展示中心设有 12 家餐厅和酒吧，由扎哈·哈迪德建筑事务所 (Zaha Hadid Architects) 设计，并与合作伙伴将废食用油转化为可持续能源。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 24 日 08:30 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

恒基兆业地产首次亮相香港美酒佳肴巡礼，推出“恒基兆业 50A • Taste The Finest”，展示美食、鸡尾酒、建筑和设计，作为恒基地产 50 周年庆祝活动的一部分。该节于10月29日至11月1日在中环海滨举行，聚集了超过300个餐饮摊位，以香港旅游发展局的“品味世界最佳”为主题。
这座占地 2,000 平方英尺的展馆汇集了来自集团旗下酒店和合作伙伴的 12 家餐厅和酒吧，每家餐厅和酒吧均提供专为周年纪念打造的限量版菜肴或饮品。恒基地产再次与扎哈·哈迪德建筑事务所合作，将展馆转变为其设计语言的延伸，其灵感来自恒基兆业的流畅轮廓，并使用曲线和开发项目的标志性调色板，与中环地标顶部的鸡尾酒和餐饮目的地橄榄石建立视觉联系。

Peridot 入选 2026 年凡尔赛奖全球最美丽餐厅，为节日带来了三款饮品：Henderson Green、The 3 A.M.威士忌和激情帕洛玛。恒基翠绿是一款无酒精鸡尾酒，混合了菠萝、柠檬、香兰、乳清、桃子和茉莉汽水，其亮绿色源自恒基兆业地产的视觉形象。凌晨 3 点威士忌将单一麦芽威士忌与黑苹果汁、昆布和甜苦艾酒混合在一起，而Passion Paloma则带来了龙舌兰酒、百香果利口酒、酸橙和柚子苏打水。
食品包括用 50 年陈皮和普洱茶调味的鸡蛋仔，将街头小吃变成周年纪念菜肴。 CulinArt 1862 提供三款色彩缤纷的迷你汉堡，里面填满了澳大利亚 M9 和牛，而 SAYA 则将泰式罗勒和牛三明治搭配宣纸包裹的芒果糯米和 Peridot's Henderson Green。 Diplomat 餐厅提供爱尔兰咖啡，由詹姆森爱尔兰威士忌、马爹利 VSOP 干邑白兰地、德梅拉拉糖、热咖啡和冷奶油制成，而 Birdie 则提供不含酒精的 Early Birdie。其他周年纪念菜肴包括以鲍鱼和扇贝为基础的小吃以及素食惠灵顿和伊比利亚叉烧。

由恒基兆业地产主席李家杰家族办公室创办的可持续燃料生产商EcoCeres首次与香港旅游发展局合作，收集节日期间使用过的食用油，并将其转化为可持续航空燃料。对于恒基地产来说，这个节日是一种将建筑、酒店、生活方式和可持续发展与维多利亚港天际线融为一体的方式。

Hong Kong
Henderson Land makes its first appearance at the Hong Kong Wine & Dine Festival with a 2,000-square-foot pavilion as part of its 50th-anniversary celebrations. The showcase features 12 restaurants and bars, a Zaha Hadid Architects design, and a partnership to convert used cooking oil into sustainabl

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

24 Oct 2026 at 08:30 HKT · 2 min read

Henderson Land is making its first appearance at the Hong Kong Wine & Dine Festival with Henderson Land 50A • Taste The Finest, a showcase bringing together food, cocktails, architecture and design as part of its 50th-anniversary celebrations. The festival runs at the Central Harbourfront from October 29 to November 1, gathering more than 300 food and drink stalls under the Hong Kong Tourism Board's “Taste the World's Best” theme.

The 2,000-square-foot pavilion brings together 12 restaurants and bars from across the group's properties and partner portfolio, each offering limited-edition dishes or drinks created for the anniversary. Henderson Land has again worked with Zaha Hadid Architects to turn the pavilion into an extension of its design language, inspired by the flowing silhouette of The Henderson and using curved lines and the development's signature palette to create a visual link with Peridot, the cocktail and dining destination at the top of the Central landmark.

Peridot, selected among Prix Versailles' World's Most Beautiful Restaurants for 2026, brings three drinks to the festival: Henderson Green, The 3 A.M. Whisky and Passion Paloma. Henderson Green is an alcohol-free cocktail combining pineapple, lemon, pandan, whey, peach and jasmine soda, taking its bright green colour from Henderson Land's visual identity. The 3 A.M. Whisky blends single malt whisky with black apple reduction, kombu and sweet vermouth, while Passion Paloma brings tequila, passion fruit liqueur, lime and grapefruit soda.

Food offerings include an egg waffle flavoured with 50-year-aged dried tangerine peel and pu'er tea, turning a street snack into an anniversary dish. CulinArt 1862 offers three colourful mini burgers filled with Australian M9 Wagyu, while SAYA pairs a Thai basil Wagyu sandwich with mango sticky rice wrapped in rice paper and Peridot's Henderson Green. The Diplomat serves an Irish Coffee made with Jameson Irish whiskey, Martell VSOP cognac, demerara sugar, hot coffee and cold cream, and Birdie serves its alcohol-free Early Birdie. Other anniversary dishes range from abalone and scallop-based bites to vegetarian Wellington and Iberico char siu.

EcoCeres, the sustainable fuel producer incubated by the family office of Henderson Land chairman Peter Lee Ka-kit, is working with the Hong Kong Tourism Board for the first time to collect used cooking oil from the festival and convert it into sustainable aviation fuel. For Henderson Land, the festival serves as a way of bringing together architecture, hospitality, lifestyle and sustainability against the Victoria Harbour skyline.

summary: 香港运输局长表示，政府将审查巴士公司8.1%至17.7%的加价申请。她还计划在 11 月之前透露如何公平分配 10,000 个叫车牌照，并可能优先考虑那些已经通过测试或持有私人牌照的人 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026年10月24日 09:54 HKT · 2分钟读懂香港运输及物流局局长陈美宝誓言
content:
香港
香港运输局长表示，政府将审查巴士公司8.1%至17.7%的加价申请。她还计划在 11 月之前透露如何公平分配 10,000 个叫车牌照，可能会优先考虑那些已经通过测试或持有私人牌照的人。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 24 日 09:54 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

香港运输及物流局局长陈美宝誓言，政府将在审查三个专营巴士运营商的加价申请方面发挥把关作用，这些运营商正在寻求加价8.1%至17.7%。陈在香港电台周六问责节目中表示，公众可能会认为这些要求对政府讨价还价的期望很高，但他强调，这个过程是一个互动过程，政府会严格处理此事。
陈指出，巴士公司几个月前提交了申请，当时全球油价波动，使得成本、收入和客运量预测充满挑战。她表示，政府不仅会考虑眼前的因素，还会考虑一系列长期的宏观指标，包括未来一两年的旅客人数预测、工资和油价预测，并将进行独立、专业的审查。

这位交通局长还表示，她希望协助和鼓励公交运营商开发非门票收入来源。其中包括已广为流行的巴士车身广告、在转乘站引入自动售货机等零售设施，甚至便利店，以及允许非专营巴士和商用车辆在日间在巴士站充电。

在网约车服务方面，陈女士表示，很高兴网约车司机综合笔试反应热烈，通过率超过60%，表明评估工作正在得到认真对待。她说，官员们一直在考虑如何最好地利用这10,000张车辆牌照，旨在为那些愿意并有能力提供服务的人建立一个公平公正的分配制度。分配计划的细节预计将于11月公布。
陈说，如果申请人数超过10,000人，抽签制度将是最公平的方法，但政府愿意听取关于应纳入哪些额外因素的不同意见。她建议，那些在新规定生效之前提前报名、完成考试、甚至参加出租车司机笔试的人，已经表明了他们对提供点对点服务的承诺。她还考虑在抽签中给予年轻人、来自其他行业寻求兼职工作的人以及拥有私家车至少一年的个人的额外重视。

Hong Kong
Hong Kong's transport chief says the government will scrutinise bus companies' fare-rise applications of 8.1 to 17.7 per cent. She also plans to reveal by November how to allocate 10,000 ride-hailing licences fairly, with possible preference for those who have already passed tests or held a private

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

24 Oct 2026 at 09:54 HKT · 2 min read

Hong Kong's Secretary for Transport and Logistics, Mable Chan, has vowed that the government will play a gatekeeping role in reviewing fare-rise applications from three franchised bus operators, which are seeking increases of 8.1 to 17.7 per cent. Speaking on RTHK's programme Saturday Accountability, Chan acknowledged that the public might see the requests as starting high in expectation of government bargaining, but stressed that the process is an interactive one and the government will handle the matter rigorously.

Chan noted that the bus companies submitted their applications several months ago, when global oil prices were volatile, making cost, revenue and passenger-traffic forecasts challenging. She said the government will consider not only immediate factors but also a series of long-term, macro indicators, including projected passenger numbers over the next one to two years, as well as wage and oil-price forecasts, and will conduct an independent, professional review.

The transport chief also said she hopes to assist and encourage bus operators to develop non-ticket revenue streams. These include the already popular bus-body advertisements, introducing retail facilities such as vending machines or even convenience stores at interchange stations, and allowing non-franchised buses and commercial vehicles to charge at bus depots during daytime hours.

On ride-hailing services, Chan said she was pleased that the comprehensive written test for ride-hailing drivers had received an enthusiastic response, with a pass rate of over 60 per cent, indicating that the assessment is being taken seriously. She said officials have been considering how best to utilise the 10,000 vehicle licences, aiming for a fair and equitable allocation system for those willing and able to provide services. Details of the allocation plan are expected to be announced in November.

Chan said that if the number of applicants exceeds 10,000, a lottery system would be the fairest approach, but the government is open to hearing different opinions on what additional factors to incorporate. She suggested that those who registered early, completed the test, or even took the taxi-driver written exam before the new regulations took effect, have demonstrated their commitment to providing point-to-point services. She is also considering giving extra weight in the lottery to younger people, those from other industries seeking part-time work, and individuals who have owned a private car for at least one year.

title: Hong Kong seeks HK$27.2bn for San Tin Tech City phase, wetland park
zh_title: 香港寻求272亿港元兴建新田科技城期、湿地公园
summary: 香港 香港政府将寻求立法会财务委员会批准拨款272亿港元，用于新田科技城第一期第二期工程、三宝石湿地公园第一期工程和一个新的清洁水设施。科技城工程涉及收购 120 公顷私人土地 [![图片 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk) 作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编 2026 年 10 月 24 日香港时间 10:53 · 2 分钟阅读 香港政府将寻求立法会财务委员会
content:
香港
香港政府将寻求立法会财务委员会批准拨款272亿港元，用于新田科技城第一期第二期工程、三宝石湿地公园第一期工程以及一个新的清洁水设施。科技城工程涉及收购120公顷私人土地

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

香港时间 2026 年 10 月 24 日 10:53 · 阅读时间 2 分钟

香港政府于2026年10月24日宣布，香港政府将寻求立法会财务委员会批准拨款近272亿港元，用于新田科技城第一期第二阶段、三宝石湿地保育公园第一期第一阶段以及兴建新的净水设施。

新田科技城一期二期工程预计耗资约165.5亿港元，开发面积175公顷。该项目需要收回私人土地120公顷，搬迁206户、约91家经营者，影响鱼塘约79公顷。
为加快北领地发展，土木工程建设部对该项目采用了“新工程合同”框架合同制度结合“目标价格合同模式”。提交立法机关的文件指出，框架合同可以灵活应对实际现场情况，有效降低风险和控制成本，而目标价格合同模式则包括成本节省或成本超支的共享机制，建立成本控制的共同目标。这是政府首次将这种采购模式应用于大规模工地平整和基础设施工程，鼓励双方共同控制建设成本。

若财务委员会批准拨款，土木工程建造署将于2026年底至2027年初展开工程，目标是由2028/29财政年度起逐步完成土地平整及释放创科用地。

至于三宝石湿地保育公园第一期的第一期，占地约132公顷。当局计划将分散的小鱼塘合并成更大的水体，并安装人工栖息地岛和其他生态增强措施。深圳河附近现有或废弃的鱼塘将被改造成具有生态价值的“智慧基围”（传统潮汐鱼塘）。

【原文 English Original】
Hong Kong
Hong Kong's government will seek Legislative Council Finance Committee approval for HK$27.2 billion for the second stage of San Tin Tech City's first phase, the first stage of Sam Po Shek Wetland Park and a new clean-water facility. The tech city works involve acquiring 120 hectares of private land

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

24 Oct 2026 at 10:53 HKT · 2 min read

The Hong Kong government will seek Legislative Council Finance Committee approval for nearly HK$27.2 billion for the second stage of the first phase of the San Tin Tech City, the first stage of the first phase of the Sam Po Shek Wetland Conservation Park, and the construction of a new clean-water facility, the government announced on 24 October 2026.

The San Tin Tech City first-phase second-stage works are estimated to cost about HK$16.55 billion and cover a development area of 175 hectares. The project requires the resumption of 120 hectares of private land, the relocation of 206 households and about 91 business operators, and will affect about 79 hectares of fish ponds.

To accelerate the development of the Northern Territories, the Civil Engineering and Construction Department has adopted a “new engineering contract” framework contract system combined with a “target price contract model” for this project. Documents submitted to the legislature state that the framework contract can flexibly respond to actual site conditions, effectively reduce risks and control costs, while the target price contract model includes a mechanism for sharing cost savings or cost overruns, establishing a common goal for cost control. This is the first time the government has applied this procurement model to large-scale site formation and infrastructure works, encouraging both parties to jointly control construction costs.

If the Finance Committee approves the funding, the Civil Engineering and Construction Department will begin works from the end of 2026 to early 2027, with a target of gradually completing land formation and releasing innovation and technology land from fiscal year 2028/29 onwards.

As for the first stage of the first phase of the Sam Po Shek Wetland Conservation Park, it covers an area of about 132 hectares. The authorities plan to merge small, scattered fish ponds into larger water bodies and install artificial habitat islands and other ecological enhancement measures. Existing or abandoned fish pond sites near the Shenzhen River will be converted into ecologically valuable “smart gei wai” (traditional tidal fish ponds).

content:
香港
香港计划以新的产学合作模式设立海事学院，扩大学校海事教育，并与中国商飞合作开发C919培训课程。运输及物流司司长公布了今年施政报告中的措施。

[![图片1：Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

作者：[Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)，主编

2026 年 10 月 24 日 11:04 香港时间 · 阅读 2 分钟

正如今年施政报告所述，香港运输及物流局局长陈美宝宣布，计划以新的“产学合作”人才培养模式成立香港海事学院。该计划将与领先的海事学术机构和全球航运企业合作，旨在创造跨界别的职业发展道路，吸引年轻人才加入该行业，从而巩固香港作为国际航运枢纽的地位。

陈在社交媒体上写道，政府还将海事和物流行业信息带入学校。 2025年3月，政府推出“校本物流课程”，并于2026年10月扩展到海事领域，设立“海事专业教育资源中心”，加深中小学生对现代物流和航运业的了解。
陈先生还谈到了航空人才培训。她表示，香港国际航空学院将于2026/27年度迈入第十学年。自2017年4月推出以来至2026年8月，已有超过45万名学员参加了涵盖机场管理、安保和航空服务等领域的专业培训课程。

学院正在与中国商飞公司及相关维修机构合作，开发C919国产飞机的飞行、维修、航空管理等专业课程。这些课程旨在支持 C919 的全球推广。大约40名当地维修技术人员已具备C919飞机维修资格。

政府于2014年设立海事及航空培训基金，经过多年注资，承诺总额已达5亿港元。截至2026年9月，该基金已惠及超过24,000名学生和在职人员，并吸引超过14万名参与者参加各类行业推广活动。

Hong Kong
Hong Kong plans to set up a maritime college with a new industry-academia collaboration model, expand maritime education in schools, and develop C919 training courses with Comac. The transport and logistics secretary announced the measures under this year's policy address.

[![Image 1: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

24 Oct 2026 at 11:04 HKT · 2 min read

Hong Kong's Secretary for Transport and Logistics, Mable Chan, has announced plans to establish a Hong Kong Maritime College under a new "industry-academia collaboration" talent training model, as outlined in this year's policy address. The initiative will involve partnerships with leading maritime academic institutions and global shipping enterprises, aiming to create cross-sector career development paths and attract young talent to the industry, thereby strengthening Hong Kong's position as an international shipping hub.

Writing on social media, Chan said the government is also taking maritime and logistics industry information into schools. In March 2025, the government launched a "school-based logistics curriculum", and in October 2026 it expanded into the maritime field with a "Maritime Professional Education Resource Centre" to deepen primary and secondary school students' understanding of the modern logistics and shipping industries.

Chan also addressed aviation talent training. She noted that the Hong Kong International Aviation Academy will enter its tenth academic year in 2026/27. Since its launch in April 2017 until August 2026, more than 450,000 participants have taken professional training courses covering airport management, security and aviation services.

The academy is working with China's Commercial Aircraft Corporation (Comac) and relevant maintenance organisations to develop professional courses for the C919 domestic aircraft, covering flight, maintenance and aviation management. These courses are intended to support the global rollout of the C919. Around 40 local maintenance technicians are already qualified to service the C919 aircraft.

The government established the Maritime and Aviation Training Fund in 2014, with total commitments reaching HK$500 million after years of injections. As of September 2026, the fund had benefited more than 24,000 students and in-service workers, and attracted over 140,000 participants to various industry promotional activities.

# Hong Kong Customs seizes over 600m illicit cigarettes in first three quarters

Hong Kong Customs seized over 600 million illicit cigarettes in the first nine months of 2026, similar to the 2025 annual total. More than 200 million were in transit. Commissioner Chan Tze-tat addressed criticism over low prosecution rates, noting most cases involved travellers with undeclared ciga

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

Hong Kong Customs Commissioner Chan Tze-tat said on 24 October that the department seized more than 600 million illicit cigarettes in the first three quarters of 2026, roughly the same as the total for the whole of last year. Of these, more than 200 million were not destined for Hong Kong but were being transhipped to other regions.

Responding to criticism that the prosecution rate for cigarette smuggling cases is low, Chan said the criticism reflected a misunderstanding. He said Customs had detected more than 18,000 cigarette-related cases this year. Of those, more than 16,000 involved travellers who failed to declare bringing more than 19 cigarettes into Hong Kong. These cases were handled by on-the-spot fines, which he described as “prosecution with a price”.

Chan stressed that the approach was intended to reduce the workload of frontline officers and avoid the heavy social costs of court proceedings. He insisted it had nothing to do with lax enforcement or whether the Department of Justice was lenient in deciding whether to prosecute.

Customs will prosecute in full all cases involving illicit cigarette warehouses uncovered in the community or travellers caught smuggling large quantities of cigarettes in multiple suitcases, Chan said. He added that the courts treat such cases seriously, typically imposing several months’ imprisonment. He said this sends a clear message to criminals not to smuggle cigarettes.

title: Joburg failed Slovo Park and residents have lost hope in elections
summary: Tshediso Moses Poshodi was 35-years-old in 2016 when he sat in the Johannesburg High Court, nervously awaiting the fate of Slovo Park, the informal settlement he had called home for more than 15 years. The air was thick with anticipation. S
content:
Tshediso Moses Poshodi was 35-years-old in 2016 when he sat in the Johannesburg High Court, nervously awaiting the fate of Slovo Park, the informal settlement he had called home for more than 15 years. The air was thick with anticipation. Seated with bated breath, Poshodi and his fellow Slovo representatives listened tensely to the judge’s verdict.

“We were from squatter camps and we were fighting with the City of Joburg,” he says, explaining how the City had previously rejected their pleas for development and was planning on evicting them to the city’s outskirts.

“We were fighting with the people that have money and are capable of hiring expensive lawyers to fight against us, so we didn’t expect anything good coming from the judge.”

However, contrary to the community’s fears, a historic turning point was made on April 6, 2016. Rather than being relocated outside the city, residents won a [monumental order](https://www.saflii.org/za/cases/ZAGPJHC/2016/55.html) for in-situ upgrading to develop their settlement right where it stood.

Tshediso Moses Poshodi, a Slovo Park resident of 25 years, in front of his home. (Photo: Jamie Ho)

Finally, Slovo Park was on the path to transformation. Poshodi remembers how the courtroom erupted into joy. People were cheering, others were crying, some were praying.

“We didn’t even know how to celebrate,” Poshodi recounts, a flicker of joy still lingering in his voice. “It was a miracle.”

### 10 years later

Poshodi is now 45-years-old. He lives right on the border of Slovo Park, south of Soweto, near Nancefield and Olifantsvlei, where mountains of rubbish are the only thing separating his home from the N12 highway.

The roads are long stretches of dusty, red craters and children play alongside open sewer pits. Countless corrugated iron shacks rust, waiting for the upgrading that was promised all those years ago.

A decade has passed since the monumental 2016 ruling, yet Slovo Park remains a forgotten corner of the city. The community has seen little progress beyond the installation of electricity and non-functional [smart poles](https://www.dailymaverick.co.za/article/2026-03-10-we-want-houses-not-wifi-say-soweto-informal-settlement-residents/) that fail to provide Wi-Fi.

The legal victory never translated into reality. With every new election season come and gone, the promises flood in, but the community stays the same.

As the 4 November local elections loom closer, Poshodi feels completely divided. In the beginning, like many residents in Slovo Park, he was a proud ANC loyalist. He was even a member of the party at one point.

But after countless broken promises, Poshodi decided to change his party affiliation.

“I wanted to punish the ANC,” he admits.

Little did he know, switching political allegiances would only reveal a more troubling landscape.

“All the political parties are the same,” he states, with a painful chuckle.

“Even if I go to EFF, Mayibuye or Inkatha, they are the same. They are going to do the same thing. They are going to delay, sit down and eat the money, thinking about their families rather than thinking about the communities.”

Poshodi’s home is on the periphery of Slovo Park, where the surrounding land has become an illegal dumping site. (Photo: Jamie Ho)

Poshodi’s disillusionment reflects a broader trend among many Slovo Park residents who have lost faith in political parties bringing any change to their community.

Cecilia Hlongwane is a 58-year-old pensioner who has lived in Slovo Park for 26 years.

“We were very excited,” she says, recalling the day their community won the Melani case.

“Lawyers also came. They made a meeting for us. They told us they’re going to build our houses. They told us they’re going to make a rail this side. We’re going to have a train,” she chuckled

“Everything was going to be alright.”

She pauses for a moment and looks down. “But they only came that day, those people. After that, we never saw them again.”

Hlongwane remarks on the worsening conditions in Slovo Park.

“We’ve got a lot of rats here,” she says. “You can clean your place, but sometimes you’ll find a small rat because the place is dirty.”

She motions to the surrounding land piled high with waste and rubbish. “And the people are dumping everywhere.”

“And also the toilet,” she grimaces, gesturing to the pit latrine outside.

“They said it was temporary for four to five years, but I think this toilet is going for 15 years. The flies go inside there. When it’s raining, the toilet gets full and floods out on to the land.”

Cecilia Hlongwane reflects on more than two decades of hardship in Slovo Park, where she has lived since 2000. (Photo: Hannah Brown)

Hlongwane has supported the ANC since 1994. However, the upcoming November elections will mark the first time she changes her vote.

“I still have hope, but in my mind I see what’s going on in South Africa,” she says. “I think we must also change. The government must change. They had a lot of time to do things for us, but they didn’t do it.”

### The youth disconnect

For 20-year-old Kgopotso Moloi, the November elections will mark her first opportunity to vote.

“I feel excited. Confused at the same time, because I don’t know which one I will vote for,” she says.

“Voting, it brings change. As youth, we are promised if we vote, we will get jobs. That’s what we’re also hoping will happen.”

However, Moloi’s decision to vote stands out as uncommon. As much as political cynicism appears to be the trend among the older generation living within Slovo Park, much of the settlement’s youth are alienated from politics altogether.

Regina Shomang is 19 years old and finds voting meaningless.

“I would say most of my peers don’t believe in voting,” Shomang admits. “Each and every year, the parties always promise us stuff, but then there’s still no change, so there isn’t any use [in] believing in them any more.”

For others, matters of politics are secondary to their immediate survival. In the absence of formal economic pathways and institutional support, socioeconomic pressures have driven many of the youth into substance abuse, gangsterism and petty crime.

Vuyo Tsatsi (18) attests to this, observing how substance abuse and crime have swallowed up most of his peers. Yet, rather than viewing this purely as reckless behaviour, he sees it as a tragic coping mechanism for young people who feel entirely trapped by systemic neglect.

“I feel like as a young person, you choose to dwell in those challenges,” he states, pointing to how lack of opportunity leaves the youth with little else to turn to.

The open, neglected roads that wind through Slovo Park. (Photo: Jamie Ho)

### Fighting to be heard

Slovo Park’s decades-long struggle for basic dignity has not had any success. Since the 2016 high court ruling, the community has routinely blockaded the N12 highway with burning tyres and rubble, a message to the government not to forget about the promises made to Slovo Park.

“Instead of helping us, they send the police to come and shoot us,” Poshodi remarks.

“Every time we try to close the freeway and say: ‘City of Joburg, please help us’, they send the police.”

During a strike in 2023, the confrontation turned deadly. Karabo Chaka (16) was shot and killed by police. “After the strike, Slovo Park was in red blood,” Poshodi recalls.

The fact that even bloodshed wasn’t enough to make the City act has left Poshodi defeated.

“There’s no hope that we’re going to get any development here in Slovo Park,” he states solemnly. “There is no hope.”

However, for some residents, change is still possible.

After more than three decades in the informal settlement, Fezeka Kobo holds on to hope for Slovo Park’s development. (Photo: Jamie Ho)

Fezeka Kobo has lived in the settlement since 1994 and refuses to give up on the future of Slovo Park.

“Some people say: ‘Why must I vote? Because I voted previously, but I see no difference,’” she says. “But I’m voting because that’s where I feel I’m gonna get an opportunity for my vote to count. There’s still hope.”

“It seems as if we are the forgotten place,” Kobo adds. “I just hope Slovo Park can become a developed area just like Freedom Park. Our hearts are so painful because we were here first, but then Freedom Park got developed before us. So my wish and my prayers [are] that Slovo Park gets proper housing, proper sanitation, proper schooling. Proper everything, like any other place.”**DM**

title: Land warning for Typhoon Champi expected to be lifted Saturday evening: CWA - Focus Taiwan
zh_title: CWA：台风“占比”陆地警报预计将于周六晚上解除 - 聚焦台湾
summary: 中新社台北10月24日电 据中央气象局消息，台风“占比”陆地警报预计将于周六晚上解除，因为风暴将远离台湾。中国气象局天气预报中心副主任伍婉华对记者表示，“占比”可能会在周六下午减弱为热带风暴。她说，风暴海上警报预计将于周六晚上解除。 CWA 于周三晚间向 Champi 发布了海上警告，并于周四上午发布了陆地警告。随着风暴减弱，其半径缩小至250公里。
content:
中新社台北10月24日电 据中央气象局消息，台风“占比”陆地警报预计将于周六晚上解除，因为风暴将远离台湾。

中国气象局天气预报中心副主任伍婉华对记者表示，“占比”可能会在周六下午减弱为热带风暴。她说，风暴海上警报预计将于周六晚上解除。

CWA 于周三晚间向 Champi 发布了海上警告，并于周四上午发布了陆地警告。

吴说，随着风暴减弱，过去几个小时内其半径从280公里缩小到250公里，伴随的云系统也变得更加分散。

她补充说，周六早上风暴带来的降雨将继续减弱。

根据 CWA 的数据，截至周六上午 10 点，“占比”以台湾东北部宜兰县东北偏东约 170 公里处为中心，以每小时 21 公里的速度向北移动。

数据显示，台风最大持续风速为每小时126公里，阵风高达每小时162公里。

据中央紧急行动中心（CEOC）称，截至周六上午，占比强风和暴雨已造成台湾1人死亡、527人受伤。

屏东县琉球乡周四发生一例死亡事件，一名男子在海滩上被暴风浪卷走，伤者多发生在台北市和台中市。
CEOC补充说，受伤主要是由倒下的树木、掉落的电缆和广告牌以及损坏的水管造成的。

吴说，虽然台风最严重的影响已经过去，但台湾西部的迎风地区仍然遭遇大雨，特别是北部苗栗县的山区。

台北市、新北市、桃园市山区，以及台湾北部的新竹县、苗栗县等山区，发布特大暴雨警告或暴雨警告。

基隆市及北岸、台北市、新北市、桃园市、新竹市、新竹县、苗栗县、中部台中市、南投县、云林县、嘉义县、屏东县山区、高雄市、台南市山区、宜兰县也发布大雨特报。

据CWA称，特大雨预警意味着24小时内降雨量预计将超过200毫米，三小时内降雨量将超过100毫米，而大雨预警意味着24小时内降雨量预计将超过80毫米，一小时内降雨量将超过40毫米。

预计从周六晚上到周日清晨，降雨量将逐渐减少，台湾南部、东南部和东部地区的降水可能会在周日早上逐渐停止。

预计由 Champi 引发的风力也会减弱。她说，周五深夜，台湾最东端新北的三雕岬录得超过221公里/小时的阵风。
吴说，尽管占比强度减弱，但风暴产生的波浪仍然很高，特别是在台湾北部和东部海域，据报道波浪超过了六米。

（黄娇文、刘建鹏、黄芳芳撰文）

Enditem/吉隆坡

【原文 English Original】
Taipei, Oct. 24 (CNA) The land warning for Typhoon Champi is expected to be lifted Saturday evening as the storm moves away from Taiwan, according to the Central Weather Administration (CWA).

Speaking to reporters, Wu Wan-hua (伍婉華), deputy director of the CWA's Weather Forecast Center, said Champi was likely to weaken into a tropical storm Saturday afternoon. The sea warning for the storm was expected to be lifted Saturday night, she said.

The CWA issued a sea warning for Champi late Wednesday and a land warning Thursday morning.

As the storm weakened, its radius shrank to 250 kilometers from 280 km over the past few hours, while its accompanying cloud system became more scattered, Wu said.

Rainfall brought by the storm would continue to ease Saturday morning, she added.

As of 10 a.m. Saturday, Champi was centered at about 170 km east-northeast of Yilan County in northeastern Taiwan, moving north at 21 kph, according to CWA data.

The typhoon had maximum sustained winds of 126 kph, gusts of up to 162 kph, the data shows.

According to the Central Emergency Operations Center (CEOC), the strong winds and heavy rains of Champi had left one person dead and 527 injured in Taiwan as of Saturday morning.

The death was reported in Liuqiu Township, Pingtung County, where a man was swept away by storm-driven waves on a beach Thursday, and the injuries mostly occurred in Taipei and Taichung cities, the CEOC said.

The CEOC added the injuries were largely caused by downed trees, falling electricity cables and billboards and damaged water pipes.

Although the worst of the typhoon's impact was over, windward areas in western Taiwan were still experiencing heavy rain, particularly in mountainous areas of Miaoli County in northern Taiwan, Wu said.

An extremely heavy rain advisory or a heavy rain advisory was in effect for mountainous areas of Taipei, New Taipei and Taoyuan cities, as well as Hsinchu and Miaoli counties in northern Taiwan.

A heavy rain advisory was also in effect for Keelung and the north coast, Taipei, New Taipei and Taoyuan cities, Hsinchu City, Hsinchu and Miaoli counties, Taichung City and Nantou County in central Taiwan, mountainous areas of Yunlin, Chiayi and Pingtung counties and Kaohsiung and Tainan cities in southern Taiwan, as well as Yilan County.

An extremely heavy rain advisory means rainfall is expected to exceed 200 mm in 24 hours or 100 mm in three hours, while a heavy rain advisory means rainfall is expected to exceed 80 mm in 24 hours or 40 mm in one hour, according to the CWA.

Rain is expected to taper off from Saturday night through early Sunday morning, with precipitation likely to gradually stop in southern, southeastern and eastern Taiwan on Sunday morning.

Winds triggered by Champi are also expected to weaken. Late Friday night, Sandiao Cape in New Taipei, Taiwan's easternmost point, recorded a gust exceeding 221 kph, she said.

Despite Champi's weakening, waves generated by the storm remained high, particularly in waters north and east of Taiwan, where waves exceeding six meters were reported, Wu said.

(By Huang Chiao-wen, Liu Chien-pang and Frances Huang)

Enditem/KL

# Magnitude 5.0, 4.8 earthquakes rattle eastern Taiwan

10/24/2026 08:17 AM

Taipei, Oct. 24 (CNA) Two earthquakes measuring magnitude 5.0 and 4.8 struck off eastern Taiwan 10 minutes apart early Saturday, according to the Central Weather Administration (CWA).

There were no immediate reports of damage or injuries.

The magnitude 5.0 temblor occurred at 4:48 a.m. Its epicenter was about 31.2 kilometers east-southeast of Hualien County Hall, at a depth of 15.4 km, according to the administration.

The earthquake's intensity was highest in Hualien County, where it measured 3 on Taiwan's 7-tier intensity scale.

The quake also measured an intensity of 2 in Yilan County and Nantou County, the CWA said.

The magnitude 4.8 earthquake occurred at 4:58 a.m. Its epicenter was located about 30.4 km east-southeast of Hualien County Hall, at a depth of 16.8 km, according to the administration.

The earthquake's intensity was highest in Hualien County and Nantou County, where it measured 3 on Taiwan's 7-tier intensity scale.

The quake also measured an intensity of 2 in Yilan County, the CWA said.

title: SI爆发与对美出口飙升，台湾经济双位数奇迹增长
summary: 台北 — 台湾2026年经济成长率在超级智能(SI, 通常称人工智能或AI)热潮与出口强劲带动下大幅上涨，多间智库与国际机构预估全年GDP成长率将达全球先进经济体中少见的双位数成长。 根据国际货币基金组织(IMF)最新全球经济预测，台湾今年GDP成长率预估达10.7%，中国则为4.5%。对台湾而言，这波强劲的经济成长势头带来的不仅是财富的快速累积，更是通过对美出口的增加，降低过去对中国市场的高度依存。 **吴钊燮：中国通货紧缩输出 台湾受其产能过剩影响有限** 台湾国安会秘书
content:
台北 —

台湾2026年经济成长率在超级智能(SI, 通常称人工智能或AI)热潮与出口强劲带动下大幅上涨，多间智库与国际机构预估全年GDP成长率将达全球先进经济体中少见的双位数成长。

根据国际货币基金组织(IMF)最新全球经济预测，台湾今年GDP成长率预估达10.7%，中国则为4.5%。对台湾而言，这波强劲的经济成长势头带来的不仅是财富的快速累积，更是通过对美出口的增加，降低过去对中国市场的高度依存。

**吴钊燮：中国通货紧缩输出 台湾受其产能过剩影响有限**

台湾国安会秘书长吴钊燮10月在一场研讨会上表示，中国正将其“通货紧缩”问题输出其他国家，而台湾自2016年起便采取降低对中国依赖的措施，如今受到中国产能过剩的影响较小，经济也因此更加稳健。

自民进党政府执政以来，台湾对中国大陆(含香港)的出口总额虽然持续成长，但是比重却出现显著下降。

根据台湾经济部国贸署统计，2016年台湾对中国出口金额1119.86 亿美元，占总出口比重 40.1%；不过到了2025年，台湾对中国出口金额增加到1704.62 亿美元，占总出口比重却降到 26.7%。

反观对美国出口，受惠于美方对SI伺服器与半导体的强劲需求，今年第一季美国正式超越中国，跃升为台湾第一大贸易国；今年前三季，台湾对美顺差已突破1633亿美元 ，超越2025年全年水平。

分析人士说，台湾亮眼的经济成长及出口比重的改变，一来是在SI伺服器等高单价货物产线上占据关键地位，二来也是因为美国主导的全球供应链转移背景下的必然结果。

**台湾对中出口占比明显下降**

台湾经济研究院院长张建一指出，中国还是占台湾半导体出口市场一定程度比重，低阶晶片仍得以销往中国，只是出口美国的SI伺服器单价非常高，一个机柜就要几百万美金，因此出现近年来台湾对美国贸易顺差飙涨的情形，相较之下即便出口到中国的总价值不变，权重却是减少。

张建一向美国之音表示：“因为AI(SI)伺服器更贵，当然现在主要就是美国四大CSP(云端服务供应商)或是OpenAI他们在建Data Center(资料中心)，所以他们需要更多的伺服器，那伺服器价格就非常的高，所以你出口值到美国就拉抬得非常高；你算那个出口比重的话，当然美国就往上，但是其实出口到中国大陆没有减少。”

台湾资策会产业情报研究所指出，台厂在全球SI伺服器代工的市占率已高达九成。在全球算力竞赛中，台湾凭藉深厚的资通讯产业基础与完整的供应链体系，成为支撑全球SI伺服器生产的关键枢纽。

其中鸿海科技集团表现最为抢眼，2025年SI伺服器相关业务营收突破3000亿美元，市占率超过40％，稳居全球领先地位。

亚太商工总会执行长邱达生接受美国之音采访时表示，全球晶片龙头台积电的前五大客户分别为辉达(NVIDIA)、苹果、超威(AMD)、高通、博通，全都是美国厂，这就是很明显的供应链转移现象。

**美国供应链移转 台厂跟着跑**

邱达生补充说，台湾出口美国最大宗的就是电子产品跟资通讯产品，其中又有超过九成属于SI相关产品。

他说：“美国的贸易政策，供应链已经有移转，再加上美国现在对这种洗产地的要求非常严格。像我们过去可能有卖很多的中间财到中国大陆的部分， 这个可能转向到东南亚，或是南亚，或是甚至直接前往美国。”

对于台湾过去所谓经贸依赖中国，淡江大学产业经济学系合聘教授蔡明芳强调，这是一种被简化的误解。

他表示，台湾曾经有将近80%的出口都是所谓的中间财，即在生产过程中被当成原料、零组件或服务，用来制成其他产品的财货。由于中国本身就是世界工厂，所以台湾的中间财必然是卖到中国的工厂，不见得是依赖中国的市场。

蔡明芳告诉美国之音：“所以它(台湾中间财)不是卖到中国的市场，它卖到中国的工厂去，那是因为全世界的品牌厂商都把它的工厂设在中国。当然你这些产品就要卖到中国的工厂，再生产到其他国家。所以事实上如果你要讲台湾的依赖，它是依赖在美国的品牌而不是中国，那当美国的品牌供应链在重组的时候，就会使得台湾的厂商也就会跟着移动。”

蔡明芳指出，台湾的优势在于资通讯产品完整生态系，只是过去很长一段时间面对中国“红色供应链”的削价竞争，而现在全球趋势是所谓的“非红供应链”，此消彼长下自然促成台湾经济的黄金时期。

title: “中华民国不存在”：东沙会是下一个金门吗？
source: 新闻汇总 - 茉莉花新闻网
summary: 茉莉花深度报道 文 / 孙亦然 中国政情撰稿人 10月20日，一艘中国海警船关掉船舶自动识别系统驶进东沙限制水域，在无线电里对台湾海巡说“你所谓中华民国不存在”。海巡署说，今年已在东沙驱离中国海警船12次；国台办说，海警在东沙执法巡查是“依法履职”。 原始文件 网页 台湾海巡署10月20日新闻稿：中国海警3102关闭AIS侵扰东沙限制水域 cga.gov.tw 打开 网页 《台湾地区与大陆地区人民关系条例》全文 law.moj.gov.tw 打开 网页 《中华人民共和国海警法
content: 茉莉花深度报道 文 / 孙亦然 中国政情撰稿人 10月20日，一艘中国海警船关掉船舶自动识别系统驶进东沙限制水域，在无线电里对台湾海巡说“你所谓中华民国不存在”。海巡署说，今年已在东沙驱离中国海警船12次；国台办说，海警在东沙执法巡查是“依法履职”。 原始文件 网页 台湾海巡署10月20日新闻稿：中国海警3102关闭AIS侵扰东沙限制水域 cga.gov.tw 打开 网页 《台湾地区与大陆地区人民关系条例》全文 law.moj.gov.tw 打开 网页 《中华人民共和国海警法》全文 xinhuanet.com 打开 要点 查明 中国海警和海事局船只在东沙岛周边的活动天数，从2024年的25天增加到2025年的60天，都在10月1日的水炮之前。 查明 2024年2月14日金门快艇翻覆、2人死亡后，中国海警宣布常态化执法巡查，2月19日登上金门观光游轮检查。 还不知道 中国海警会不会像在金门那样，在东沙登上台湾的船只检查。 我们的判断 到2026年12月31日，中国海警不会在东沙海域登检台湾的船只。这是因为，东沙的水炮没有伤人，渔船由中国的船拖回，不像金门那次有人死亡。 10月20日清晨5时许，台湾海巡署东沙指挥部在东沙海域东南方发现中国海警3102没有开启船舶自动识别系统（AIS），以“暗船方式”驶向限制水域；8时许，3102进入东沙岛东北方的限制水域，海巡台中舰并航监控，多次用中、英文广播驱离。海警船在无线电里说“你所谓中华民国不存在”，称台中舰为“中国台湾台中舰”。海巡署说，今年以来已在东沙水域驱离中国海警船12次、共15艘次。中国海警船一再开进台湾在东沙划定的限制水域，东沙是不是在走金门的路？ 从目前公开的情况看，东沙正在走金门的路，而且顺序和金门相反。在金门，中国海警是在一场快艇事故之后才宣布常态化执法巡查；在东沙，海警船早在10月1日的水炮之前就一再进出限制水域，水炮不是起点。国防大学政战学院中共军事事务研究所副教授陈育正在詹姆士敦基金会的文章里写道，中国海警和海事局船只在东沙岛周边的活动天数，从2024年的25天增加到2025年的60天。国台办发言人张晗10月21日被问到大陆加大在东沙海域巡航是否受水炮事件影响时说，中国对东沙群岛及其附近海域拥有“无可争辩的主权”，大陆海警在相关海域执法巡查是“依法履职，保障正常的航行和作业秩序”。 海警船比水炮来得早 海巡署统计，从2025年2月到今年5月28日，中国海警船侵扰东沙海域共12船、39艘次。据中央社报道，海委会主委管碧玲4月2日对外国媒体说，以东沙海域为例，过去台湾在这一区域强势执法时，中方并没有以此为由发动袭扰，近年相关行动增加并非单一事件驱动。8月18日8时42分，海警3303和3107驶入东沙限制水域，海巡云林舰并航监控、广播驱离；3303在广播里称云林舰为“中国台湾海巡署云林舰”。 10月1日，海巡云林舰在东沙岛东方27浬、限制水域内8浬处，发现中国渔船“金鲨”违法下锚；“金鲨”拒不起锚，云林舰连续广播驱离3次无效后，在200公尺外先向上空喷水30秒，再逐渐靠近，向驾驶舱喷水90秒；“金鲨”失去动力，海巡用小艇送去35份热食，第二天早上把它交给中国籍工作船拖回。 国台办发言人陈斌华10月14日说，民进党当局“以危险方式粗暴对待大陆船舶”，“必须承担由此引发的一切后果”；陈斌华没有说后果是什么。中国外交部发言人毛宁10月19日被问到东沙的水炮时，只说了一句“这不是外交问题”。 水炮之后，10月16日15时34分，海警3301和3303驶入东沙限制水域，海巡旗津舰和巡防艇一对一并航监控、广播驱离，双方在现场对峙；10月18日，中国在花莲东方、屏东南方、高雄西南外海和东沙周边海域，用海警船、科研船等12艘船舶和4艘渔船同时侵扰，海巡署说船舶数量异常增加；在东沙，3301和3303“绕岛对开”，12时许被驱离到限制水域外。 时间线：东沙：海警船比水炮来得早——2025年2月起，到2026年5月28日，中国海警船侵扰东沙海域共12船、39艘次；2026年8月18日，海警3303、3107驶入东沙限制水域，3303称云林舰为“中国台湾海巡署云林舰”；2026年10月1日，海巡云林舰对拒不起锚的中国渔船“金鲨”使用水炮；2026年10月14日，国台办发言人陈斌华：民进党当局“必须承担由此引发的一切后果”；2026年10月16日，海警3301、3303驶入东沙限制水域，与海巡对峙；2026年10月18日，16艘中国船只同时侵扰台湾周边，3301、3303在东沙“绕岛对开”；2026年10月20日，海警3102关闭AIS驶入，在无线电里说“你所谓中华民国不存在”；2026年10月21日，国台办发言人张晗：海警执法巡查是“依法履职”。 对谁有权在东沙执法，两边各说各话。海巡署10月20日说，台湾对东沙环礁及其周边海域享有无可争辩的主权，中方是企图以“假执法、真扩权”塑造管辖权假象；按台湾国防部2004年的公告，东沙禁止水域是领海基线起12浬，限制水域是24浬；按《两岸人民关系条例》第32条，大陆船舶未经许可进入，台湾主管机关可以驱离或扣留船舶、留置人员。海巡署从去年2月起，把东沙越界作业的中国小舟由驱离改为强势扣留并依法没入，今年到9月23日已查扣8案、9艘。中国的《海警法》则规定，海警机构在“我国管辖海域”开展海上维权执法活动，适用这部法律；国家主权、主权权利和管辖权在海上“正在受到外国组织和个人的不法侵害”时，海警机构有权“采取包括使用武器在内的一切必要措施”。 金门走过同一条路 2024年2月14日，一艘中国快艇越界进入金门北碇岛东方海域，在海巡执法时翻覆，2人死亡；2月17日，国台办说两岸渔民自古以来在厦金海域作业，“根本不存在所谓‘禁止、限制水域’一说”；2月18日，中国海警宣布在厦金海域开展常态化执法巡查；2月19日，中国海警人员强制登上金门一艘观光游轮检查。今年9月29日，中国海警在官网上说，“9月以来，福建海警组织舰艇编队位金门附近海域依法开展常态执法巡查”；海巡署回应说，中国海警船去年借“执法巡查”名义穿越金门限制水域46次，今年到那时已有35次，已是“常态骚扰”、绝非“执法巡查”。 詹姆士敦基金会的这篇文章，还把金门的这套做法归纳为四个部分：事件、执法、宣传和常态化，并认为北京正把它推向东沙和太平岛。拿这四个部分对照东沙，四样都已出现：事件是10月1日的水炮，执法是海警船一次次进出限制水域，宣传是国台办的说法和海警船在无线电里的喊话，常态化是中国海警和海事局船只在东沙越来越多的活动天数。金门的常态化里还有两样东西：中国海警登船检查，以及中国海警一再公开宣布的“常态执法巡查”；海巡署公布的东沙事件，到现在都是海警船进出、对峙，再被驱离。 黄岩岛和钓鱼岛：谁一直守着 中国海警的“执法”在别处有过两种结局，黄岩岛是一种。2012年，菲律宾海军官兵登上停在黄岩岛潟湖里的中国渔船检查，两艘中国海监船随后赶到，双方由此对峙；两个多月后，菲律宾撤出了留在黄岩岛的两艘公务船；中国船只没有离开（也可能离开后又回来了），此后黄岩岛由中国实际控制。 钓鱼岛是另一种。日本海上保安厅统计，中国海警船在由日本管辖的钓鱼岛（日本称尖阁诸岛）毗连区出现的天数，2023年是352天，2024年是355天，2025年是357天，是日本把岛屿国有化以来最多的一年；中国海警船每次进入日本所称的领海，日本海上保安厅都当场要求离开，日本政府再经外交渠道抗议。两处的差别在于有没有船一直守着。东沙现在的情形更接近钓鱼岛。这是因为，海巡署公布的几次海警船进入东沙限制水域，都有海巡的船在旁边并航、广播驱离。 海委会副主委宋承恩说，中国对金门、东沙的施压确实升级且“例行化”，但因为地缘情势完全不同，把金门模式复制到东沙有相当困难。东沙岛东北距高雄约438公里，岛上没有永久居住的平民，2000年2月起由海巡署接替国军驻防。我们同意，东沙的地缘和金门不同，北京在东沙很难找到像金门观光游轮那样的台湾民船来登船检查。但地缘不同并没有让常态化停下来。这是因为，宋承恩说的“例行化”趋势，正是詹姆士敦基金会那篇文章所说金门模式的第四个部分。 接下来看什么 如果中国海警船从此不再进入东沙限制水域，北京也不再说海警在东沙执法巡查，本文“东沙在走金门的路”的判断就错了。 第一，中国海警若在东沙海域登检台湾的船只，说明东沙走到了金门的最后一步，海警开始在东沙行使检查权；若没有，说明北京在东沙仍停在派船进出和喊话。我们判断，到2026年12月31日，中国海警不会在东沙海域登检台湾的船只。这是因为，金门的登船检查是在快艇事件之后五天；东沙这次的水炮没有伤人，渔船由中国的船拖回。 第二，海巡署若继续在东沙查扣越界的中国船只，说明国台办要台湾“承担由此引发的一切后果”的警告没有改变台湾在东沙的执法；若停止查扣，说明台湾在压力下放松了执法。我们判断，到2026年12月31日，海巡署还会在东沙海域查扣至少一艘越界的中国船只。这是因为，海巡署今年已在东沙查扣8案，平均每月约一案；行政院长卓荣泰10月5日也说，发射水炮是“不得不为”，侵犯主权时执法人员要保卫国家安全。 东沙已经在走金门的路，最要紧的一步还没有走：在金门，中国海警登上了台湾的观光游轮；在东沙，今年被海巡扣下、没入的，是越界的中国小舟。 茉莉花深度报道独立调研、撰写。 参考报道：台湾新闻（2月16日） · 星条旗报（1月5日） · 自由时报（10月14日） · 中央社（10月20日） · 中央通讯社（台湾）（10月21日） · 法国国际广播电台 RFI 中文（10月21日） · # Hong Kong to hold three district flag-selling days on Saturday

Hong Kong's Social Welfare Department announced three district flag-selling days on 24 October. Permits and details are available online. The public is advised to report suspicious collections to police.

[![Image 4: Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/static/img/editors/clb-adam-192.png)](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk)

 By [Adam](https://clb.org.hk/en/desks/clb-desk), Editor in Chief

 24 Oct 2026 at 06:00 HKT · 1 min read

Share:

[](https://wa.me/?text=Hong%20Kong%20to%20hold%20three%20district%20flag-selling%20days%20on%20Saturday%20https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-to-hold-three-district-flag-selling-days-on-Saturd-5d7c1b "WhatsApp")[](https://t.me/share/url?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-to-hold-three-district-flag-selling-days-on-Saturd-5d7c1b&text=Hong%20Kong%20to%20hold%20three%20district%20flag-selling%20days%20on%20Saturday "Telegram")[](https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-to-hold-three-district-flag-selling-days-on-Saturd-5d7c1b "Facebook")[](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-to-hold-three-district-flag-selling-days-on-Saturd-5d7c1b&text=Hong%20Kong%20to%20hold%20three%20district%20flag-selling%20days%20on%20Saturday "X")[](mailto:?subject=Hong%20Kong%20to%20hold%20three%20district%20flag-selling%20days%20on%20Saturday&body=Hong%20Kong%20to%20hold%20three%20district%20flag-selling%20days%20on%20Saturday%0Ahttps%3A//clb.org.hk/en/hong-kong/Hong-Kong-to-hold-three-district-flag-selling-days-on-Saturd-5d7c1b "Email")

The Social Welfare Department (SWD) of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region Government has announced arrangements for three district flag-selling days to be held simultaneously on Saturday, 24 October. The department said it has coordinated with the participating charitable organisations to ensure the smooth running of the events and to help the public identify the three separate flag-selling activities taking place that day.

According to the SWD, details of all charitable fundraising activities licensed to take place in public places, including any updates, have been published on the Hong Kong Government's one-stop portal (www.gov.hk/tc/theme/fundraising/search). In addition, the permits for the flag-selling days have been uploaded to the SWD website (www.swd.gov.hk/tc/ngo/controlofc/flagdays), where the public can find contact information for the flag-selling organisations and the approved flag-day activities.

Members of the public with enquiries can call the SWD hotline at 2343 2255 or the 1823 call centre at 3142 2678.

A department spokesman added: 'If members of the public have any suspicions about a flag-selling activity, please do not donate and immediately notify the police.'

**Help Me Study Abroad in Taiwan – A Journey of Language, Culture & Growth**

Hi everyone,

I’m excited to share that I’ve been given an incredible opportunity to study abroad in Taiwan (June 3 - July 1)! This program will allow me to fully immerse myself in a new culture while studying Mandarin Chinese and engaging in meaningful cross-cultural experiences.

Studying abroad in Taiwan is more than just travel for me — it’s a chance to grow academically, professionally, and personally.

Why Taiwan?

Taiwan is known for its rich history and welcoming communities. By living and studying there, I will:

Strengthen my Mandarin Chinese language skills

Build cross-cultural communication skills

Study alongside local and international students

Experience Taiwanese traditions, festivals, and daily life firsthand

Develop independence, adaptability, and global awareness

**Why I’m Fundraising**

While I’ve worked hard to prepare for this opportunity, studying abroad comes with significant expenses, including:

Program tuition and fees

Housing

Flights

Cultural excursions and educational activities

Any contribution — big or small — will help make this life-changing experience possible.

**Your support is not just helping me travel — you are investing in my education, personal growth, and future.** I’m so grateful for any encouragement, donations, or shares. I can’t wait to share updates, photos, and stories from Taiwan along the way! Thank you for being part of this journey with me!

title: Donate to Rebekah's Car- Road to Independence, organized by Rebekah Wyse
summary: I have a condition called Osteogenesis Imperfect (OI Brittle Bones). When I was younger I would break my bones all the time. They would break so easily that the I would cough or sneeze my ribs would break. Each year, my bones became stronge
content:
I have a condition called Osteogenesis Imperfect (OI Brittle Bones). When I was younger I would break my bones all the time. They would break so easily that the I would cough or sneeze my ribs would break. Each year, my bones became stronger because of all the medication and rodding surgeries. Thanks to Shriners Children’s Hospital. I have not broken anything since I was in 8th grade. My parents Keith and Cheryl Wyse adopted my twin and me from Taiwan. I was 21 months old when we came to the United States. When I was little doctors told my parents that I would not be able to sit up, walk with crutches, or do anything for myself. Today I am able to do all those and even drive. I am grateful they gave me a second chance at a wonderful life.

Being able to drive to work and drive to school independently is one of my many dreams I wish to achieve. Right now I am trying to finish off my general classes at Northwest Community College. Then I will transfer to Wright State University. My main goal is to receive my Master’s Degree in Social Work. I would like to eventually be able to work at a hospital, an adoption agency, or a grief and loss counseling facility. My father had passed away January 2017 and I want to be there for others and their loved ones in their time of need.

In order to buy my vehicle, I need to follow all the state requirements. Which is why it cost $20,000.
1) Has to be under 3 years old
2) Has to be under 3,600 miles
3) Has to be bought from a dealership
4) Has to be a certain type of car
A) Dodge Caravan
B) Town and Country
C) Honda
D) Toyota
*If these requirements are not met
then the state will not pay for my
vehicle modification which cost an
additional $30,000.

With your help, I can accomplish my dreams and hopefully be an inspiration to other people.

[Article on New York Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2021/01/16/world/asia/hong-kong-us-asylum.html?smid=url-share)

In 2020, five of us—young protesters from Hong Kong—made the difficult decision to flee our home by boat, seeking safety and freedom. Our journey took us to Taiwan, where we were detained for half a year before finally arriving in the United States to seek asylum. This experience changed our lives in ways that are hard to imagine, shaping who we are and how we see the world.

Now, living in the US, we each face new challenges and opportunities. Some of us are optimistic about the future, while others struggle with the heavy toll of exile. Through our documentary, 'A Toll,' I want to capture the difference between our lives then and now, and reveal the emotional and personal costs of leaving everything behind. The title holds special meaning for us—not only does it reflect the price we pay for freedom, but it also connects to the Dongsha Atoll, the first place we reached after leaving Hong Kong.

Your support will help us complete this important project. The funds raised will go directly toward equipment, travel across the country to film each participant, and sharing our story through film festivals and other platforms. We are far from home and resources are limited, but with your help, we can bring this story to life. Any contribution, big or small, will make a real difference. Thank you for standing with us and supporting our journey.

We have a state of emergency declared in Virginia!

And right now we’re seeing what looks like a massive police state closing in on the state capitol where there will be a huge rally on Monday.

This is a very divisive issue that’s generating a lot of media spin and disinformation. And chaos could break out in Richmond.

It is crucial that there be independent, on-the-ground reporting in Richmond, especially given what happened in Charlottesville — where many people argue police actually instigated some of the violence and things definitely got out of hand.

In the past, when massive Yellow Vests protests were taking place in Paris, I was there [reporting on the ground](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hTzwJqUPeqk) and risking safety as protesters were losing eyes due to police brutality. I have also been to places like [Somalia,](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UooepLs3Fqs)[Venezuela](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UOQb7Y5QVO8) and[Cheran](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r3qRm3sXVRU), once the most violent, dangerous area in Mexico. And more recently, I reported on the ground amid huge protests in Hong Kong.

Now lots of people are asking me to go to Richmond, so they can get the truth about what’s happening there.

So I’ve decided to go, if we can raise enough funds for it.

A trip to Virginia isn’t as expensive as going to Hong Kong, where I provided you in-depth, on-the-ground reports on one of the world’s most important protest movements.

But it’s not free either. I still need to cover airfare/gas, hotel and equipment expenses. And I’m planning on hiring a cameraman and video editor. I estimate this will cost around $1,500.

If you value reporting on the events in Virginia that is free of spin and manipulation and provides a real, honest look at what is happening, then your support is essential.

Thank you so much for funding independent media and for allowing me to continue doing the job I love!

# Legal Defense for Hong Kong Democracy Activists

The Lantos Foundation for Human Rights & Justice stands with the people of Hong Kong on the front lines of the fight for freedom & democracy.Courageous Hong Kong democracy activists have been protesting for months against a dangerous Chinese extradition bill that would have undermined their independence and freedom. Though the bill has now been formally withdrawn, the fight is not over. Since June, thousands of protesters have been attacked and injured by police and mainland gangs and over 1,100 people have been detained. Those arrested for peacefully protesting have been charged with offenses that could put them in jail for many years.Hong Kong Democracy protesters have won the first huge victory in the court of public opinion, but the next victories will need to be won in the courts of law.Just a few months ago, the Lantos Foundation was proud to give our highest award to the most recognizable leader of the democracy movement – Joshua Wong. While such leadership is important, all of the brave democracy crusaders deserve more than our admiration. We must equip them to defend themselves against the crushing apparatus of the Chinese communist state. This legal defense fund aims to support Joshua and his compatriots as they defend themselves against false accusations that could land them in prison for years to come.Our hope is that we can match their courage and determination in the form of financial support that will ensure they have fair representation. It is critical that the rule of law be upheld at this pivotal moment in Hong Kong's history. The eyes of the world may be on Hong Kong, but the eyes of history will be on those of us enjoying our own freedom and democracy - let us match our words and good wishes with the resources to defend those on the front lines of this fight for freedom.These legal defense funds will be officially disbursed through the Lantos Foundation's Front Line Fund grant program.

# Fund Independent Reporting In HONG KONG

Fund Independent Reporting In HONG KONG You know something big is happening in Hong Kong!! The protests have been massive, and they may be the biggest geopolitical event of the year. Will China get its way and stomp out dissent? Might covert U.S. aid allow the protesters to sustain their momentum? Needless to say, there is a lot at stake and lots of speculation!!And because of that it’s important for there to be independent, on-the-ground reporting about the events in Hong Kong. When massive Yellow Vests protests were taking place in Paris, We Are Change was there reporting on the ground and risking safety as protesters were losing eyes due to police brutality. In the past we have also been to places likeSomalia, Venezuela and Cheran, once the most violent, dangerous area in Mexico. As for Hong Kong, it’s very expensive to fly and stay there. This mission will involve spending a week or more investigating, reporting and live-streaming.So if you value reporting on the events in Hong Kong that is independent and free of spin and manipulation, then your support is crucial! By contributing to this campaign, you will help fund the cost of the flight, safety precautions and live reporting at events like the upcoming Civil Human Rights Front March on August 31 and the student strike that is set to take place on September 2, the first day of secondary school.Our $2,700 goal is the bare minimum it will take to fund this trip. If we surpass the goal due to your support, which is so greatly appreciated, the funds will go toward other journalistic endeavors. Thank you so much! Your support means the world to us!

# Unite for Digital Fearlessness

Abhaya: The Fearless Network "Use what's in your hand" - Adam Clayton Powell Jr. We Already Have Everything We Need Your phone isn't just for posting stories and playing music. That little computer in your pocket has more power than entire governments had 20 years ago. Like the ancient Abhaya Mudra - the fearless hand gesture that banishes fear and offers protection from the "Evil Eye" - we're transforming these devices into something that helps communities meet the coming challenges with a sense of fearlessness, rooted in Free Collaboration and Privacy. Abhaya started as disaster recovery - how do communities rebuild communication when the towers are down and the power's out? But we realized something profound: the same tools that help neighborhoods coordinate after a hurricane are exactly what we need when authoritarians try to silence us. Like the protective Abhaya Mudra, this system creates a shield against the "evil eye" of surveillance while becoming a helpful digital companion that guides and empowers our communities. Drawing inspiration from Buckminster Fuller's vision of global cooperation for humanity's benefit, Abhaya is designed as the foundation for communities to work together toward a more equitable future. The ecosystem operates through five interconnected elements: The Five Core Components: • Tor + Mobile based Mesh Networks: Messages that flow around censorship like water • Mesh Based Distributed Storage: Truth that lives everywhere so it can't be destroyed • Mesh Based Distributed Computation Service: AI-capable shared processing power for communities to solve their own challenges • Sensor/Peripheral IO: User Controlled Eyes and ears embedded in the network • Mesh Federation: Connecting local networks into unstoppable global resistance History demonstrates the need "The ultimate measure of a man is not where he stands in moments of comfort and convenience, but where he stands at times of challenge and controversy." - MLK Jr. After Hurricane Katrina, communities learned they couldn't wait for official help. Hong Kong protesters used mesh networks when the government tried to cut them off. Iranian women shared videos of police brutality when the state blocked social media. Puerto Ricans coordinated mutual aid through amateur radio when Maria destroyed the grid. The pattern is clear: when systems fail - whether from natural disasters or deliberate suppression - communities need tools to build their own infrastructure. Communities united in purpose and vision can be powerful. Your Support = Digital Fearlessness When you contribute to Abhaya, you're investing in infrastructure that makes communities fearless. No CEO can sell it. No government can buy it. No algorithm can suppress it. No storm can wash it away. Every dollar helps us turn individual devices into collective power. Like Powell said - we're not waiting for someone to save us. We're using what's already in our hands to build the infrastructure of fearlessness. Fund the network that makes communities fearless. Join the Build: Technologists Wanted We're assembling an international team of developers and engineers who understand that code is power, and power should belong to the people. If you're a technologist looking to put your skills toward meaningful resistance, this is how you push back against authoritarianism and corporate overreach. We need volunteers with expertise in: • Android & iOS Development • Onion Router, I2P, Freenet protocols • DevOps/SecOps fluent in Dark Web technologies • Distributed Systems Design • AI Systems Engineering This is open-source work with no revenue model - Abhaya is designed to be free for all communities. For technologists feeling the weight of current events, it's a concrete way to turn skills into direct action and fulfill civic duty through code. Ready to put your shoulder to the wheel of progress? Reach out. Because true community care means building the infrastructure that makes us all fearless.

Five years have passed since Hong Konger's last attempt to maintain their freedom, and it seems that all dust has settled. However, some people still choose not to forget.

經過多方努力，我們在Yermo的自由雕塑公園（Liberty Sculpture Park）建立起了香港地，用藝術去銘記香港人的意志不滅。

After many efforts, we have established Hong Kong Corner in the Liberty Sculpture Park in Yermo, using art to remember the unyielding will of the Hong Kongers.

香港地的維護和創作需要長期的投入，我們亟需你的支持。不論捐款多少，都代表著你對香港所出的一分力。

The maintenance and creation of Yermo's "Hong Kong Corner" requires long-term investment, and we urgently need your support. Any donation, no matter the amount, represents your contribution to the undying spirit of Hong Kongers.

希望有一日我們能在自由的香港相見！

We hope to meet in a free Hong Kong someday.

捐款用途有三

Donation serves 3 main purposes.

1. 現時香港地有四件展品，沙漠氣候極端，冬寒夏焰，烈日風沙，我們要定期維修，提供防曬材料予連儂牆， 令他們可以日久維新。

1. Currently, Hong Kong Corner has four exhibits. We need to perform regular maintenance for some of the art works and provide sun & water protection sealants in the harsh desert weather condition.

2. 香港抗爭者的雕像現時沒有任何解釋。 在我們維修的過程當中，經常見到美國本地人到訪，但他們對於2019抗爭一事並不了清楚。希望可以籌款建立一塊金屬牌匾， 刻上中英文描述，令到到訪者了解究竟發生了什麼事。

2. The statues of Hong Kong Protesters currently have no explanations. During our maintenance work, we often see local Americans visiting, but they are not familiar with the 2019 protests. We hope to raise funds to establish a metal plaque with descriptions in both Chinese and English to help visitors understand what happened.

3. 自由雕塑公園的創辦人陳維明老師亦為香港地建立了新牆，我們希望可以籌款聘請來自香港的專業藝術家，以壁畫描繪出香港的景況。

3. Mr. Chen Wei Ming, the art creator of Liberty Sculpture Park, has also built a new wall for Hong Kong Land. We hope to raise funds to pay for the expenses of hiring a professional artist from Hong Kong to depict the situation in Hong Kong with a mural.
